words.ex_cn: 他的悲观主义让他总是预期最坏的结果。
words.en: Pessimism is the belief that bad things are going to happen or that something is going to turn out badly.

words.tr: phrase. 负担不起做某事；无法承受做某事的后果
words.ex: He cannot afford to buy new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他买不起新鞋。
words.en: If you cannot afford to do something, you do not have enough money to be able to pay for it, or you cannot allow it to happen because it would cause you too many problems or harm.

words.tr:
n. 野蛮人
adj. 野蛮的
words.ex: The barbarian attacked the village with a sword.
words.ex_cn: 野蛮人用剑袭击了村庄。
words.en: A barbarian is a person who is considered to be uncivilized or uncultured.

words.ex: The settlers moved westward to find new land.
words.ex_cn: 定居者向西迁移以寻找新土地。
words.en: Toward the west.

words.ex: He does not want to intrude on their conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他不想插话他们的谈话。
words.en: To intrude means to enter somewhere or become involved in a situation where you are not wanted or are not supposed to be.

words.tr: phrase. 继续做；持续做；不断做
words.ex: He keeps doing his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都坚持做作业。
words.en: To continue doing something without stopping.

words.ex: The monk meditates every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位僧侣每天早上冥想。
words.en: A monk is a member of a religious community of men who live by certain vows and usually wear a habit.

words.ex: The microscope can magnify small objects.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜可以放大微小的物体。
words.en: To magnify something means to make it appear larger than it is, especially by using a lens or microscope. It can also mean to exaggerate or make something seem more important or serious than it really is.

words.tr: v. 导航；应付（复杂情况）；
words.ex: He uses a map to navigate the city.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图来导航这座城市。
words.en: To navigate is to plan and direct the route or course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments or maps.

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道将地球分为两半。
words.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth, equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole, dividing the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

words.tr:
n. 晒成棕褐色的肤色
adj. 棕褐色的；棕黄色的
v. 将皮肤晒成棕褐色
words.ex: He has a deep tan after spending the week at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩度过一周后，皮肤晒成了深棕色。
words.en: If you tan, or if the sun tans you, your skin becomes darker because you spend time in the sun.

words.tr: 短语动词. 晒黑，使皮肤因日晒而变褐色
words.ex: I want to get a tan before the summer ends.
words.ex_cn: 我想在夏天结束前晒黑。
words.en: To become darker in skin color due to exposure to the sun.

words.ex: They will nominate her for the award.
words.ex_cn: 他们将提名她获得这个奖项。
words.en: If someone is nominated for a job or position, their name is formally suggested as a candidate for it.

words.ex: He is a sophomore at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的二年级学生。
words.en: A sophomore is a student in the second year of college or high school.

words.ex: His deficiency in math made him struggle in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的缺乏让他在课堂上很吃力。
words.en: A deficiency is a lack or shortage of something that is needed.

words.ex: Mother's milk nourishes the baby.
words.ex_cn: 母乳滋养婴儿。
words.en: To nourish someone or something means to provide them with the food and other substances they need in order to live, grow, and be healthy.

words.ex: The new regime changed the tax laws.
words.ex_cn: 新的管理制度改变了税法。
words.en: A regime is the set of rules or the way that a country or organization is governed, especially when it is considered to be strict or unfair.

words.ex: The king oppresses the poor people.
words.ex_cn: 国王压迫穷人。
words.en: If someone oppresses people, they treat them cruelly or unfairly and prevent them from having the same rights as other people.

words.ex: The car crash was a serious collision.
words.ex_cn: 那场车祸是一次严重的碰撞。
words.en: A collision occurs when two or more objects come into contact with each other, often resulting in damage or a change in direction.

words.tr:
v. 推翻；颠覆；打倒
n. 推翻；颠覆；打倒
words.ex: The court will overturn the old law.
words.ex_cn: 法院将推翻这项旧法律。
words.en: If a decision, result, etc. is overturned, it is officially changed so that it becomes the opposite of what it was before.

words.ex: The freight train carried boxes to the city.
words.ex_cn: 货运列车把箱子运到了城市。
words.en: Freight refers to goods transported in bulk by truck, train, ship, or aircraft. It can also mean the charge for such transportation.

words.tr: phrase. 两者都（用于指两个人或事物中的每一个）
words.ex: Both of them are excellent students.
words.ex_cn: 他们两个都是优秀的学生。
words.en: Used to refer to two people or things, regarded and identified together.

words.ex: The manager will delegate the task to her assistant.
words.ex_cn: 经理将把这个任务委派给她的助手。
words.en: A delegate is a person who is chosen or elected to vote or make decisions on behalf of a group of people, especially at a conference or a meeting. As a verb, to delegate means to give a task or responsibility to another person, especially someone who is less senior than you.

words.ex: He will partake in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To partake in something means to take part in or experience it.

words.ex: He wore a ceremonial robe for the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他为婚礼穿了一件仪式性的长袍。
words.en: relating to or used in a ceremony; formal

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for my cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了治疗感冒的药。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.ex: The clergy prayed in the church every morning.
words.ex_cn: 神职人员每天早上在教堂祈祷。
words.en: The clergy are the official leaders of religious activities in certain religions, especially in Christianity.

words.tr: v. 主持；指挥；担任会议主席
words.ex: He presides over the meeting every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一主持会议。
words.en: To preside means to be in charge of a formal meeting, ceremony, or other event.

words.ex: He bought timber to build a fence.
words.ex_cn: 他买了木材来建篱笆。
words.en: Wood prepared for use in building and carpentry.

words.tr:
n. 支撑物；支柱；道具
v. 支撑；靠
words.ex: He uses a prop to support the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个道具来支撑架子。
words.en: A prop is an object or piece of furniture that is used in a play or film to make a scene look more realistic, or something that is used to support or hold up another object.

words.tr:
n. 兵营；棚屋；临时工房
v. 喝倒彩；起哄
words.ex: The soldiers live in a barrack near the base.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们住在基地附近的一个兵营里。
words.en: A barrack is a building or group of buildings where soldiers live. It can also mean to provide such accommodation or to cheer someone on enthusiastically.

words.ex: She ate a prune for a healthy snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一颗梅干作为健康零食。
words.en: To prune means to cut off some of the branches of a tree or bush to make it grow better. It can also mean to reduce the extent of something by removing superfluous or unwanted parts.

words.ex: A bird built a nest on a small twig.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟在一根小嫩枝上筑了巢。
words.en: A twig is a very small thin branch that grows out from a main branch of a tree or bush.

words.tr: v.  合理化； 使合理
words.ex: He tries to rationalize his bad choices.
words.ex_cn: 他试图为自己的错误选择找借口。
words.en: To rationalize something means to try to find reasons to explain or justify it, often when these reasons are not really good ones.

words.tr:
n. 忧愁
adj.  忧郁的
words.ex: He felt melancholy after the rain stopped.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后，他感到忧郁。
words.en: A feeling of deep sadness, typically with no obvious cause.

words.tr: adj. 不确定的；不肯定的；无把握的；
words.ex: I am unsure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案不确定。
words.en: If you are unsure about something, you are not certain about it.

words.ex: He gave an intentional wrong answer to confuse the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他故意答错答案来迷惑老师。
words.en: Something that is intentional is done on purpose, not by chance.

words.tr:
n. 经常重复的评价（或抱怨）；叠句；
v. 克制；
words.ex: His constant refrain is that the food is too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他经常抱怨食物太贵。
words.en: If you refrain from doing something, you deliberately do not do it.

words.ex: Exercise can reinforce your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: He drew a loop with the pencil.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔画了一个圈。
words.en: A loop is a shape produced by a curve that bends round and crosses itself, or a piece of wire, string, etc. that has this shape. It can also refer to a repeated sequence of operations or events in a computer program or in a process.

words.tr: v. 重新组织；改组；整顿
words.ex: He will reorganize his desk tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会重新整理他的书桌。
words.en: To reorganize something means to change the way in which it is organized, arranged, or structured.

words.ex: The big company owns a subsidiary that makes phones.
words.ex_cn: 这家大公司拥有一家生产手机的附属公司。
words.en: A subsidiary is a company which is part of a larger and more important company.

words.ex: He graduated in 2020, and thereafter he moved to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他2020年毕业，之后搬到了纽约。
words.en: After a particular event or time.

words.tr:
v. 重印；再版
n. 重印本；再版本
words.ex: The book was reprinted with additional illustrations.
words.ex_cn: 这本书再版时增加了插图。
words.en: To print again or in a different form; a new printing of a book or other publication.

words.tr: 短语动词. 被改编成电影
words.ex: The novel is going to be made into a film next year.
words.ex_cn: 这部小说明年将被拍成电影。
words.en: To be adapted into a movie; to have a story, book, or other material turned into a film.

words.ex: The fence safeguards the garden from animals.
words.ex_cn: 围栏保护花园免受动物侵扰。
words.en: A safeguard is a measure taken to protect someone or something from potential harm or danger.

words.ex: The aggression of the army caused many deaths.
words.ex_cn: 军队的侵略导致了许多人死亡。
words.en: Aggression is a violent or hostile behavior towards another person or country.

words.ex: The stone skimmed over the water.
words.ex_cn: 石头掠过水面。
words.en: To remove a substance from the surface of a liquid, or to read or consider something quickly in order to understand the main points, without studying it in detail.

words.tr:
n. 社论；
adj. 编辑的；
words.ex: The newspaper published an editorial about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 报纸发表了一篇关于气候变化的社论。
words.en: An editorial is an article in a newspaper which gives the opinion of the editor or publisher on a topic or item of news.

words.tr: n. 外交；外交手腕；交际手段
words.ex: He uses diplomacy to solve the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 他用外交手段解决冲突。
words.en: Diplomacy is the activity of managing relations between the governments of different countries, especially in the context of international relations, negotiations, and treaties.

words.tr: v. 杀死；杀害；残害；宰杀
words.ex: He slayed the monster in the dark forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑暗的森林里杀死了怪物。
words.en: To kill someone or something in a violent way.

words.ex: He works on a large ranch in Texas.
words.ex_cn: 他在德克萨斯州的一个大牧场工作。
words.en: A ranch is a large farm, especially in the western United States and Canada, where cattle or other animals are bred and raised.

words.ex: They met at a saloon to discuss art and music.
words.ex_cn: 他们在一个沙龙里讨论艺术和音乐。
words.en: A saloon is a public room or building used for a specified purpose, especially a bar in the western U.S. in the 19th century.

words.ex: He is on his way back from school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在从学校回来的路上。
words.en: While returning from a place or after completing an activity.

words.ex: The rebellious boy refused to follow the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个叛逆的男孩拒绝遵守规则。
words.en: If you think someone is rebellious, you mean that they are deliberately not obeying people in authority or rules of behaviour.

words.ex: The police tried to subdue the angry man.
words.ex_cn: 警察试图制服那个愤怒的人。
words.en: To subdue someone or something means to bring them under control by using force or persuasion.

words.ex: The tyrant ruled the country with fear.
words.ex_cn: 暴君用恐惧统治国家。
words.en: A tyrant is a ruler who has complete power in a country and uses it in a cruel and unfair way.

words.ex: The captive man sat quietly in his cell.
words.ex_cn: 那个被监禁的人安静地坐在牢房里。
words.en: A captive is someone who is being kept as a prisoner or in a confined space, or something that is held or confined.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.ex: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 从10中减去5得到5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.ex: Can you summarize the story in one sentence?
words.ex_cn: 你能用一句话总结这个故事吗？
words.en: If you summarize something, you give a brief description of its main points.

words.ex: He gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他给了一个口头警告，而不是书面的。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of words.

words.ex: The teacher supervises the students during the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师在实验期间指导学生。
words.en: If you supervise an activity or a person, you make sure that the activity is done correctly or that the person is doing a task or behaving correctly.

words.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。
words.en: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

words.ex: She added sugar to sweeten the tea.
words.ex_cn: 她加了糖来使茶变甜。
words.en: To make something sweet or sweeter, especially by adding sugar.

words.tr:
n. 栗子；栗子树；栗色马；栗色
adj. 红棕色的
words.ex: He ate a roasted chestnut from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了火上烤的栗子。
words.en: A chestnut is a kind of nut that grows on a tree and is often eaten roasted. It can also refer to the tree itself, the color of the nut, or an old joke or story that has been told many times.

words.ex: He scooped soup with a spoon.
words.ex_cn: 他用勺子舀汤。
words.en: A scoop is a tool like a large spoon which is used for picking up substances such as ice cream or an amount of a substance that is held in a scoop. It can also refer to an important or exciting news story that is reported in a newspaper, magazine, or news broadcast before anyone else reports it.

words.ex: They laid new tile in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们在厨房铺了新的瓷砖。
words.en: A tile is a flat piece of baked clay, carpet, cork, or other material, used especially for covering roofs and floors.

words.tr:
v. 费力地做；苦干；跋涉
n. 苦工；劳累的工作
words.ex: He toils in the field every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在田里辛苦劳作。
words.en: If you toil, you work very hard doing something that is difficult or tiring.

words.ex: His tolerance for different opinions is impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他对不同观点的宽容令人印象深刻。
words.en: The ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behaviour that one dislikes or disagrees with.

words.ex: The cows trample the grass in the field.
words.ex_cn: 牛在田野里践踏草地。
words.en: If someone tramples something or tramples on it, they step heavily and carelessly on it and damage it.

words.tr: n. 仓库管理员；零售商店店主
words.ex: The storekeeper greeted each customer with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 店主微笑着迎接每一位顾客。
words.en: A storekeeper is a person who owns or manages a store or is responsible for the goods in a store.

words.ex: He faced imprisonment for stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷钱而面临监禁。
words.en: The state of being confined in prison; the act of putting someone in prison or the condition of being kept in prison.

words.ex: The judge will uphold the law.
words.ex_cn: 法官将维护法律。
words.en: If you uphold something such as a law, a principle, or a decision, you support and maintain it.

words.ex: The prophet told the people about the coming storm.
words.ex_cn: 预言者告诉人们即将到来的风暴。
words.en: A prophet is a person who is believed to be chosen by God to lead the people and to tell them what God wants them to do.

words.ex: The bridge can withstand strong winds.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥能经受住强风。
words.en: If something or someone withstands a force or action, they survive it or do not give in to it.

words.tr: adj. 侮辱的； v. “insult”的现在分词；
words.ex: His insulting words made her cry.
words.ex_cn: 他侮辱的话让她哭了。
words.en: If you describe someone's remarks or actions as insulting, you mean they are rude and offensive.

words.ex: He gave a scornful look when she spoke.
words.ex_cn: 当她说话时，他投去轻蔑的一眼。
words.en: If you are scornful of someone or something, you show contempt or disdain for them.

words.ex: The fishermen feared the tempest at sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔民们害怕海上的暴风雨。
words.en: A tempest is a violent and windy storm.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.ex: The tanker carried oil across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘油轮将石油运过了大海。
words.en: A tanker is a ship, airplane, or truck designed to carry liquids, especially oil, in large quantities.

chapters.name: Level 7 认知•思考类动词

words.ex: He is zealous about helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他热心帮助别人。
words.en: If someone is zealous, they are enthusiastic and eager about something, especially something they believe in very strongly.

words.ex: A snake is a reptile.
words.ex_cn: 蛇是一种爬行动物。
words.en: A reptile is a cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia, including snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles, and tortoises. They are characterized by their scaly skin and the fact that they lay eggs on land.

words.tr: n. 热心者；热衷于…的人
words.ex: He is an enthusiast of basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球的爱好者。
words.en: An enthusiast is a person who is very interested in a particular activity or subject and who spends a lot of time on it.

words.ex: She adores her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她非常喜爱她的弟弟。
words.en: If you adore someone, you feel great love and admiration for them.

words.ex: The lizard sits on the rock in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 蜥蜴趴在阳光下的石头上。
words.en: A lizard is a reptile with a long body, four legs, a long tail, and rough, scaly skin.

words.ex: Behold the beautiful sunset.
words.ex_cn: 看那美丽的日落。
words.en: To see or observe (someone or something, especially something remarkable or impressive).

words.tr: adj. 可怕的；讨厌的；非常的
words.ex: The storm made a frightful noise.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨发出可怕的噪音。
words.en: If you describe something as frightful, you mean that it is very unpleasant or shocking.

words.tr: adj. 可怜的；悲哀的；差劲的；令人生厌的
words.ex: The little dog looked pathetic in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那只小狗在雨中看起来很可怜。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as pathetic, you mean that they are sad and weak or inadequate, and you feel contempt or pity for them.

words.ex: The occurrence of rain surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 下雨这件事让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: An occurrence is something that happens or takes place.

words.tr:
n. 元帅；高级军官；典礼官；消防局长
v. 整理；集结
words.ex: The marshal led the army into battle.
words.ex_cn: 元帅率领军队上战场。
words.en: A marshal is a high-ranking officer in the armed forces, especially in the army or air force, or a person who arranges or directs a public event.

words.ex: The child clings to his mother's leg.
words.ex_cn: 孩子紧贴着妈妈的腿。
words.en: If you cling to someone or something, you hold onto them tightly.

words.tr: adj. 教条的；武断的；固执己见的
words.ex: He is dogmatic about his beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己信念非常固执。
words.en: If you say that someone is dogmatic, you are critical of them because they are convinced that they are right, and refuse to consider that other opinions might also be justified.

words.ex: From my point of view, this is the best choice.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这是最好的选择。
words.en: A particular attitude or way of considering a matter.

words.ex: The admiral gave orders to the navy.
words.ex_cn: 海军上将向海军下达了命令。
words.en: An admiral is a senior officer in the navy, in particular the commander of a fleet or a high-ranking officer.

words.tr: v. 考虑；深思；凝视；思考…的可能性
words.ex: He contemplates quitting his job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在考虑辞去工作。
words.en: If you contemplate an action, you think about whether to do it or not.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.ex: The village by the lake is picturesque.
words.ex_cn: 湖边的村庄如画般美丽。
words.en: A picturesque place is attractive and interesting, especially in a way that is old-fashioned or unusual.

words.ex: He saw a beautiful panorama from the mountain top.
words.ex_cn: 他从山顶看到了美丽的全景。
words.en: A panorama is a view of a wide area, or a description or study that presents all the different parts or aspects of a particular subject.

words.tr:
v. 使目眩；使眼花；使惊叹
n. 耀眼；眩惑；灿烂
words.ex: The stars dazzle at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的星星闪耀夺目。
words.en: If something dazzles you, it is so bright that you cannot see properly for a short time. It can also mean to greatly impress someone.

words.ex: They deem this plan too risky.
words.ex_cn: 他们认为这个计划太冒险了。
words.en: If you deem something to be the case, you consider that it is the case.

words.ex: The alteration of the dress made it fit better.
words.ex_cn: 这件衣服的修改让它更合身了。
words.en: An alteration is a change in or to something.

words.ex: The company built a pipeline to carry oil.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司建造了一条输送石油的管道。
words.en: A pipeline is a long pipe, often underground, through which a liquid or gas is carried over a long distance.

words.ex: Can you differentiate between the two colors?
words.ex_cn: 你能区分这两种颜色吗？
words.en: To differentiate means to recognize or express the difference between things or people.

words.ex: The letter 'b' is a consonant.
words.ex_cn: 字母 'b' 是一个辅音。
words.en: A consonant is a speech sound that is articulated with complete or partial closure of the vocal tract.

words.tr:
n. 英语；英文；
adj. 英格兰的；英格兰人的；英语的；
words.ex: He speaks English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天说英语。
words.en: English refers to the language spoken in Britain, the United States, and many other parts of the world, as well as to the people of England.

words.tr: adj. 不断的；不停的；连续的
words.ex: The baby cried with incessant noise.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿不停地哭闹。
words.en: If you say that something is incessant, you are emphasizing that it continues without stopping.

words.ex: The loud music distract me from my homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我无法专心做作业。
words.en: If something distracts you or your attention, it makes you stop concentrating on what you are doing.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.ex: I cannot foresee what will happen tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我无法预知明天会发生什么。
words.en: If you foresee something, you expect and believe that it will happen.

words.ex: The Industrial Revolution was a new epoch in history.
words.ex_cn: 工业革命是历史上一个新时代。
words.en: An epoch is a period of time in history or a person's life, typically one marked by notable events or particular characteristics.

words.ex: He loves archaeology and digs old artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱考古学，挖掘古代文物。
words.en: Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: The colonel gave orders to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 上校向士兵下达了命令。
words.en: A colonel is a senior officer in the army, air force, or marines, ranking above a lieutenant colonel and below a brigadier or brigadier general.

words.ex: The glare of the sun made it hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的刺眼使我看不清。
words.en: If you glare at someone, you look at them with an angry expression on your face. Glare is also a very bright light that is uncomfortable to look at.

words.ex: The seaman sailed the boat across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 水手驾船横渡大海。
words.en: A seaman is a sailor, especially one who is not an officer.

words.ex: He felt indignant when they blamed him for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 当他们把错误归咎于他时，他感到愤愤不平。
words.en: If you are indignant, you are shocked and angry, because you think that something is unjust or unfair.

words.ex: He went to a clinic to treat his alcoholism.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所治疗自己的酒精中毒。
words.en: Alcoholism is the condition of being addicted to alcohol.

words.tr:
v. 注意；留心
n. 注意；留心
words.ex: He did not heed the warning.
words.ex_cn: 他没有理会那个警告。
words.en: If you heed someone's advice or warning, you pay attention to it and do what they suggest.

words.tr: phrase. 再三地；反复不止地
words.ex: He tried again and again to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地尝试解决这个问题。
words.en: Repeatedly; many times.

words.tr: n. 大量同时出现的事件；
words.ex: There was a rash of burglaries last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月发生了一连串的盗窃案。
words.en: If someone is rash or does rash things, they act without thinking carefully first, and therefore make mistakes or behave foolishly.

words.tr:
n. 痒；渴望
v. （使）痒；渴望
words.ex: The mosquito bite caused an itchy on my arm.
words.ex_cn: 蚊子叮咬让我的手臂发痒。
words.en: If you have an itch, you have an unpleasant feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch. If you itch to do something, you are very eager or impatient to do it.

words.ex: She puts lotion on her hands after washing them.
words.ex_cn: 她洗手后在手上涂乳液。
words.en: A lotion is a liquid that you use to clean, improve, or protect your skin or hair.

words.ex: She lamented the death of her dog.
words.ex_cn: 她哀悼她狗的去世。
words.en: If you lament something, you express your sadness, regret, or disappointment about it.

words.tr: n. 中士；巡佐；军士；警官
words.ex: The sergeant gave orders to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军士向士兵们下达了命令。
words.en: A sergeant is a non-commissioned officer in the army or marines ranking above a corporal and below a lieutenant, or a police officer ranking below an inspector.

words.ex: The earthquake was a terrible calamity.
words.ex_cn: 这场地震是一场巨大的灾难。
words.en: A calamity is an event that causes great harm or damage, such as a flood or a fire.

words.tr: n. 社会学家；社会学者；
words.ex: The sociologist studied how people live in cities.
words.ex_cn: 这位社会学家研究了人们在城市中的生活方式。
words.en: A sociologist is someone who studies or is an expert in sociology, which is the study of society and social behavior.

words.tr: v. 沉思；冥想；考虑；仔细计划
words.ex: He meditates every morning to feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冥想以保持平静。
words.en: To meditate means to spend time in quiet thought for religious purposes or relaxation.

words.tr:
adj. 交替的；轮流的；间隔的；
v. （使）交替；（使）轮流；
words.ex: We take alternate days off work.
words.ex_cn: 我们隔天休息一次。
words.en: If something alternates between two things, it repeatedly changes from one to the other and back again.

words.ex: The government used propaganda to influence people's opinions.
words.ex_cn: 政府使用宣传来影响人们的观点。
words.en: Information, especially of a biased or misleading nature, used to promote a political cause or point of view.

words.tr:
v. 沉思
n. （作家、画家等的）灵感；缪斯
words.ex: He often muses about the meaning of life.
words.ex_cn: 他常常沉思生命的意义。
words.en: In Greek mythology, the Muses are the goddesses of the inspiration of literature, science and the arts. As a verb, to muse means to think about something carefully and for a long time.

words.tr:
adj. 热诚的；友好的
n. 甜露酒
words.ex: He gave a cordial smile to his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他对着邻居露出了热情的微笑。
words.en: warm and friendly

words.tr: n. 律师；辩护律师；代理人
words.ex: The attorney helped the man with his case.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助那个人处理了他的案件。
words.en: An attorney is a lawyer who is qualified to represent a client in court.

words.ex: The two events happened simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件同时发生了。
words.en: Happening, existing, or done at the same time.

words.tr: v. 使麻痹；使瘫痪；使无效；使停止活动
words.ex: The accident paralyzed his leg.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故使他的腿瘫痪了。
words.en: If someone is paralyzed by an accident or an illness, they have no feeling in their body, or in part of their body, and are unable to move.

words.ex: I presume he will arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假设他明天会到。
words.en: If you presume that something is the case, you think that it is the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: There is friction between the two neighbors over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居因为篱笆问题产生了不和。
words.en: The resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

words.ex: The rain was a hindrance to the game.
words.ex_cn: 雨水对比赛造成了妨碍。
words.en: A hindrance is a person or thing that makes it difficult for you to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 贸易摩擦；指国家或地区之间在贸易政策、关税、市场准入等方面产生的争端或冲突
words.ex: The trade friction between the two countries has led to increased tariffs.
words.ex_cn: 两国之间的贸易摩擦导致了关税的增加。
words.en: Trade friction refers to the economic conflicts that arise from trade policies and practices between countries, often leading to disputes and the imposition of tariffs or other trade barriers.

words.ex: I reckon it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我认为明天会下雨。
words.en: If you reckon that something is true, you think that it is true.

words.ex: His assertion was simple: the project will finish on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的断言很简单：项目会按时完成。
words.en: A statement that is made with confidence but without proof.

words.ex: I can't recollect where I put my keys.
words.ex_cn: 我想不起来把钥匙放在哪儿了。
words.en: If you recollect something, you remember it.

words.ex: They parked the caravan by the lake for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们把旅行拖车停在湖边过周末。
words.en: A caravan is a group of people, especially traders or pilgrims, traveling together across a desert in Asia or North Africa.

words.ex: The birds fly eastward in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天，鸟儿向东方飞去。
words.en: Eastward means towards the east.

words.ex: The navigator helped the ship find its way.
words.ex_cn: 领航员帮助船找到了航向。
words.en: A navigator is someone who is skilled in planning and directing the route of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments and maps.

words.ex: He repents for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为对母亲撒谎而悔恨。
words.en: If you repent, you feel or express sincere regret or remorse about something wrong you have done.

words.tr: adj. 粗心大意的；欠考虑的；轻率的；自私的；不顾及他人的
words.ex: He left his coffee on the table, thoughtless and careless.
words.ex_cn: 他把咖啡放在桌子上，毫不在意且粗心。
words.en: If you describe someone as thoughtless, you are criticizing them for not thinking about the effects their actions or words might have on other people.

words.tr: n. 乘务员；管家；保护者
words.ex: The steward served drinks on the plane.
words.ex_cn: 空乘人员在飞机上提供饮料。
words.en: A steward is a person whose job is to look after the passengers on a ship, aircraft, or train and bring them meals. A steward is also a person who is in charge of the organization of a particular event, or who manages someone else's property.

words.ex: The wind stiffened the cloth on the line.
words.ex_cn: 风把晾衣绳上的布吹硬了。
words.en: to make or become stiff or rigid; to make or become more severe or strict

words.ex: The loud noise gave her a sudden fright.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让她吓了一跳。
words.en: A sudden intense feeling of fear.

words.tr: n. 射击；射程；炮击; adj. 射击的；枪炮射击所致的
words.ex: The gunshot echoed through the valley.
words.ex_cn: 枪声在山谷中回荡。
words.en: The sound made when a gun is fired.

words.ex: He wavers when choosing between two jobs.
words.ex_cn: 他在两个工作之间摇摆不定。
words.en: If you waver, you cannot decide about something or you are uncertain about what you should do.

words.tr: n. 半决赛；半决赛阶段; adj. 半决赛的；参加半决赛的
words.ex: He reached the semifinal of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他进入了网球锦标赛的半决赛。
words.en: A semifinal is one of the two matches or races in a competition that are held to decide who will compete in the final.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 生物

words.ex: The canary sings beautifully in the cage.
words.ex_cn: 金丝雀在笼子里唱得非常动听。
words.en: A canary is a small yellow bird which is known for its singing.

words.ex: He caught a crab at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上抓到一只蟹。
words.en: A crab is a sea creature with a flat round body covered by a shell, and five pairs of legs with large claws on the front pair. Crabs usually move sideways.

words.ex: The leopard runs fast in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 豹在野外跑得很快。
words.en: A large wild cat that has a yellowish-brown or brown coat with black spots, found in Africa and southern Asia.

words.ex: The rooster crows every morning.
words.ex_cn: 公鸡每天早上打鸣。
words.en: A rooster is an adult male chicken.

words.tr:
n. 蛞蝓；懒汉；重击；一大口；金属块；子弹
v. 动作迟缓；偷懒；重击
words.ex: A slug crawled slowly across the wet grass.
words.ex_cn: 一只鼻涕虫在湿草地上缓慢爬行。
words.en: A slug is a small, slow-moving creature with a soft body, often found in gardens. It can also refer to a bullet or a lazy person. As a verb, it means to hit hard or to move slowly or lazily.

words.ex: The snail moves slowly across the garden.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛慢慢地爬过花园。
words.en: A snail is a small creature with a soft, wet body and a spiral shell. It moves very slowly.

words.tr:
n. 群；蜂群
v. 云集；充满
words.ex: Bees swarm around the flower.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂围绕着花朵成群飞舞。
words.en: A swarm is a large group of insects, especially bees, moving together. As a verb, it means to move in or form a swarm.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 动作•运动

words.ex: He showed avoidance of difficult math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他回避困难的数学问题。
words.en: The act of keeping away from or preventing something from happening.

words.ex: The continuity of the story made it easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的连续性让它容易理解。
words.en: Continuity is the fact that something continues to happen or exist, with no great changes or interruptions.

words.ex: The contraction of the muscle helps you move your arm.
words.ex_cn: 肌肉的收缩帮助你移动手臂。
words.en: A contraction is a process of becoming smaller or shorter, or a word that is made shorter by leaving out some letters.

words.ex: The conversion of water into steam takes heat.
words.ex_cn: 水变成蒸汽需要热量。
words.en: The process of changing or causing something to change from one form to another.

words.ex: The disappearance of the keys confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙的消失让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: The act of disappearing or the state of having disappeared.

words.ex: The emergence of new technology changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 新技术的出现改变了我们的生活。
words.en: The process of coming into view or becoming exposed after being concealed.

words.ex: The factory reduces emission to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 工厂减少排放以保护环境。
words.en: An emission is the production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.

words.ex: The omission of his name was an accident.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字被漏掉是无意的。
words.en: An omission is something that has not been included or has not been done, either deliberately or accidentally.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.ex: The rotation of teachers helps the school run smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 教师的轮换有助于学校顺利运行。
words.en: Rotation refers to the action of rotating around an axis or center.

words.ex: The two boys were wrestling on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 两个男孩在地上扭斗。
words.en: Wrestling is a physical contest between two people in which each tries to throw or hold the other down on the ground.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 身体•疾病•药物

words.ex: She pointed to her belly-button as a sign of her vulnerability.
words.ex_cn: 她指着自己的肚脐，表示她的脆弱。
words.en: The small, round, and often slightly protruding scar on the abdomen that marks the former attachment of the umbilical cord.

words.tr:
n. 胸；怀；（女性的）乳房
adj. 亲密的；知心的
words.ex: She held the baby close to her bosom.
words.ex_cn: 她把婴儿紧紧抱在胸前。
words.en: Your bosom is the front part of your chest, especially the part that is covered by your clothes and where your breasts are.

words.ex: His disposition is calm and kind.
words.ex_cn: 他的性情平静而善良。
words.en: Someone's disposition is the way that they tend to behave or feel.

words.ex: She blinked and her eyelash touched her cheek.
words.ex_cn: 她眨了眨眼，睫毛碰到了脸颊。
words.en: An eyelash is one of the short hairs that grow from the edge of your eyelids.

words.ex: He blinked and touched his eyelid.
words.ex_cn: 他眨了眨眼，摸了摸眼皮。
words.en: The eyelid is a thin fold of skin that covers and protects the eye.

words.ex: His eyesight is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的视力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

words.ex: The incidence of flu increased last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天流感的发生率上升了。
words.en: The incidence of something is the frequency with which it occurs or the rate at which it happens.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an injection for the pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他打了一针来缓解疼痛。
words.en: An injection is the act of putting a liquid, especially a drug, into a person's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.tr:
n. 指关节
v. 用指关节…；屈从
words.ex: He cracked his knuckles before the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛前掰响了指关节。
words.en: The knuckles are the joints of the fingers, especially where they join the hand.

words.tr: n. 中毒； v. “poison”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child suffered from poisoning after eating the berries.
words.ex_cn: 孩子吃了这些浆果后中毒了。
words.en: The act or process of administering poison or becoming poisoned.

words.ex: He is learning about sexuality in health class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在健康课上学习关于性的问题。
words.en: Sexuality refers to a person's capacity for sexual feelings and their sexual orientation.

words.tr: v. 膨胀；肿胀；“swell”的现在分词；
words.ex: The wound is swelling after the injury.
words.ex_cn: 受伤后伤口在肿胀。
words.en: An abnormal enlargement of a part of the body, typically as a result of an accumulation of fluid.

words.ex: He hurt his thigh while running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步时伤了大腿。
words.en: The part of the human leg between the hip and the knee.

words.ex: The doctor checked the vein in his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他手臂上的静脉。
words.en: A vein is a tube in your body that carries blood towards your heart. It can also refer to a thin layer of a mineral in rock, or a particular style or mood in writing or speech.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 感情•感觉

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.ex: She felt pure bliss when she held her newborn baby.
words.ex_cn: 当她抱住新生儿时，感受到了无上的幸福。
words.en: Bliss is a state of complete happiness.

words.ex: The hard chair caused him discomfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把硬椅子让他感到不舒适。
words.en: Discomfort is a feeling of slight pain or physical unease, or a feeling of worry or embarrassment.

words.tr: n. 气馁；挫折；劝阻；沮丧
words.ex: He felt discouragement after failing the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试不及格后感到沮丧。
words.en: A feeling of despair in the face of obstacles.

words.ex: He felt dismay when he saw the low grade.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到低分时，感到沮丧。
words.en: Dismay is a feeling of unhappiness and disappointment.

words.ex: The magic show had a strange fascination for children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演对孩子们有一种奇特的迷惑力。
words.en: A fascination is a very strong interest or attraction for someone or something.

words.tr: v. 同意；赞成；“agree”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 已一致的；同意的；
words.ex: We agreed to meet at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们同意下午五点见面。
words.en: If people are agreed, they have reached a joint decision on something or have the same opinion about something.

words.ex: He showed humility after winning the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他在赢得奖品后表现出了谦逊。
words.en: Humility is the quality of being humble and not thinking that you are better than other people.

words.ex: He suffered an indignity at the hands of the guards.
words.ex_cn: 他受到了守卫的羞辱。
words.en: An indignity is a situation or event that causes you to feel ashamed or embarrassed because it involves something that is unfair or insulting.

words.ex: The child's innocence showed in his honest smile.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的无罪体现在他诚实的微笑中。
words.en: the state or quality of being innocent, especially freedom from sin, moral wrong, or guilt through lack of knowledge of evil

words.ex: He acted out of malice, not mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他是出于恶意，而不是错误。
words.en: Malice is behavior that is intended to harm people or their reputations, or cause them embarrassment and upset.

words.ex: He does meditation every morning to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冥想以放松。
words.en: Meditation is the act of remaining in a silent and calm state for a period of time, as part of a religious training, or so that you are more able to deal with the problems of everyday life.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.ex: His negligence caused the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他的疏忽导致了事故。
words.en: Negligence is failure to take proper care over something that you are responsible for, which might cause damage or loss.

words.ex: The unfair verdict caused public outrage.
words.ex_cn: 不公正的判决引发了公众的愤怒。
words.en: An outrage is an extremely strong reaction of anger, shock, or indignation.

words.ex: He showed reluctance to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他表现出不愿意在全班面前讲话。
words.en: Reluctance is an unwillingness to do something.

words.tr:
v. 责备；指责
n. 责备；指责
words.ex: She reproached him for being late.
words.ex_cn: 她责备他迟到了。
words.en: To express disapproval or disappointment towards someone because of their actions or behavior.

words.ex: He showed reverence for his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他对祖父表示尊敬。
words.en: A feeling of profound respect for someone or something.

words.ex: He faced ridicule for wearing old clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为穿旧衣服而遭到嘲笑。
words.en: To ridicule someone or something means to make fun of them in an unkind way.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.ex: He showed great zeal in helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他在帮助他人时表现出极大的热情。
words.en: Zeal is great enthusiasm, especially in connection with work, religion, or politics.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 艺术•娱乐•出版

words.ex: The adaptation of animals to cold weather is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 动物对寒冷天气的适应令人惊叹。
words.en: An adaptation is a film, television drama, or stage play that is based on a written work.

words.tr:
n. 试听；试唱；试演；听力
v. 试听；试音；试镜；让…试演
words.ex: He went to an audition for the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加学校话剧的试听。
words.en: An audition is a short performance given by an actor, dancer, or musician so that someone can decide if they are good enough to be in a play, film, or orchestra.

words.ex: He wrote his autobiography when he was 70.
words.ex_cn: 他70岁时写了自传。
words.en: An autobiography is a book about the life of a person, written by that person.

words.tr:
n. 插图说明；标题；字幕
v. 加上说明；加上标题；加上字幕
words.ex: The photo has a caption that says 'Happy birthday'.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片有一个标题，写着‘生日快乐’。
words.en: A caption is a short piece of text under a picture in a book, magazine, or newspaper that describes the picture or explains what is happening in it.

words.tr: n. 再来一个；重演的节目
words.ex: The crowd shouted for an encore after the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会结束后，观众大声要求再演一场。
words.en: An encore is a short extra performance given by musicians or actors after the main performance has ended, usually in response to the audience's applause.

words.ex: This movie is a horror genre film.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部恐怖类型影片。
words.en: A genre is a particular type of literature, painting, music, film, or other art form which people consider as a class because it has special characteristics.

words.ex: The projection of the movie started at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 电影的放映晚上8点开始。
words.en: A projection is an estimate or forecast of a future situation or trend based on a study of present ones.

words.ex: The movie is a satire about politicians.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部关于政治家的讽刺作品。
words.en: A way of criticizing people or ideas in a humorous way, especially in order to make a political point, or a piece of writing that uses this style.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 语言•学问•宗教

words.ex: He used an abbreviation for 'company' in his note.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记中用了'company'的缩写。
words.en: An abbreviation is a shortened form of a word or phrase.

words.ex: The advancement of technology helps people live better.
words.ex_cn: 技术的进步帮助人们生活得更好。
words.en: The process of promoting a cause or plan; the act of moving forward or making progress.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: They maintain correspondence through letters.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过信件保持通信联系。
words.en: Communication by exchanging letters with someone; a close similarity, connection, or equivalence.

words.ex: He speaks a local dialect in his village.
words.ex_cn: 他在村子里说一种地方方言。
words.en: A dialect is a form of a language that is spoken in a particular area and that uses some of its own words, grammar, and pronunciations.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: He is an expert in the domain of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 他是人工智能领域的专家。
words.en: A domain is a particular field of thought, activity, or interest, especially one over which someone has control, influence, or rights.

words.ex: He shouted an exclamation of surprise.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地喊了一声。
words.en: An exclamation is a sound, word, or sentence that is spoken suddenly, loudly, or emphatically and that expresses excitement, admiration, shock, or anger.

words.ex: He sings gospel music every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日唱福音音乐。
words.en: The teachings of Jesus and the apostles, especially as contained in the first four books of the New Testament, known as the Gospels.

words.ex: His handwriting is very neat.
words.ex_cn: 他的笔迹非常工整。
words.en: Handwriting is the style of writing that someone uses when they write with a pen or pencil.

words.ex: The report gives an overview of the project.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告对项目进行了概述。
words.en: An overview is a general summary or review of a subject.

words.ex: He used 'she' as a pronoun in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他在句子中用'she'作为代词。
words.en: A pronoun is a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase. Pronouns refer to either a noun that has already been mentioned or to a noun that does not need to be named specifically.

words.ex: He asked for a quotation for the new computer.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了新电脑的报价。
words.en: A quotation is a sentence or phrase taken from a book, poem, play, etc., which is repeated by someone else, or a statement of the current price of something.

words.ex: His decision shows clear rationality.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定显示出清晰的理性。
words.en: Rationality is the quality or state of being rational, based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: He had a realization that he needed to change his life.
words.ex_cn: 他领悟到自己需要改变生活。
words.en: The act of becoming fully aware of something as a fact; the achievement of something desired or anticipated.

words.tr: n. 修辞学；花言巧语；华丽的文辞；
words.ex: He studied rhetoric to improve his speaking skills.
words.ex_cn: 他学习修辞学以提高自己的演讲能力。
words.en: Rhetoric is the art or study of using language effectively and persuasively.

words.ex: He uses a lot of slang when talking with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时用很多俚语。
words.en: Slang refers to a type of language that consists of words and phrases that are regarded as very informal, are more common in speech than writing, and are typically restricted to a particular context or group of people.

words.ex: His utterance made everyone silent.
words.ex_cn: 他的话让所有人都沉默了。
words.en: An utterance is a word, statement, or sound that someone says.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 时间

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.ex: He always shows up on time; his punctuality is impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他总是准时到达；他的守时令人印象深刻。
words.en: Punctuality is the characteristic of being able to complete a required task or fulfill an obligation before or at a previously designated time.

words.tr: n. 时间的安排；时间的选择； v. “time”的现在分词；
words.ex: The timing of the meeting was perfect.
words.ex_cn: 会议的时间安排恰到好处。
words.en: Timing is the skill or action of judging the right moment in a situation or activity at which to do something.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 自然•植物

words.ex: Milk has a lot of calcium.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶含有大量的钙。
words.en: A chemical element that is present in teeth and bones and is necessary for their health.

words.ex: The birds flew home at dusk.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回家。
words.en: Dusk is the time just before night when the daylight has almost gone but when it is not completely dark.

words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The thermometer contains mercury.
words.ex_cn: 温度计里含有水银。
words.en: Mercury is a heavy, silvery-white metal that is liquid at room temperature. It is used in thermometers, barometers, and other scientific apparatus.

words.ex: The reed grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 芦苇长在河边。
words.en: A reed is a tall, thin plant that grows in water or marshy ground.

words.ex: The shrub grows near the fence.
words.ex_cn: 这丛灌木长在篱笆附近。
words.en: A shrub is a woody plant which is smaller than a tree and has several main stems arising at or near the ground.

words.ex: The city's skyline looks beautiful at night.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市的天际线在夜晚看起来很美。
words.en: The outline of land and buildings defined against the sky.

words.tr: n. 阳光，日光；快乐的人
words.ex: A sunbeam pierced through the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 一束阳光穿透了云层。
words.en: A sunbeam is a ray of sunlight.

words.ex: The water vapor rose into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 水蒸气升上了天空。
words.en: Vapor is a substance in the gas phase at a temperature lower than its critical temperature, which means that the vapor can be condensed to a liquid by increasing its pressure without reducing the temperature.

words.ex: The willow grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 柳树长在河边。
words.en: A willow is a type of tree with long, thin branches and narrow leaves that grows near water.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 生活

words.tr: n. 令人讨厌的或繁重的工作；
words.ex: Washing dishes is a boring chore.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗是一件烦人的琐事。
words.en: A chore is a task or piece of work that is often boring or unpleasant but needs to be done regularly.

words.ex: The old clock has a broken clockwork.
words.ex_cn: 这台老钟的钟表装置坏了。
words.en: A clockwork is a mechanism that operates in a very precise and regular way, often used in toys or small machines.

words.ex: He received a confirmation email for his flight.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了航班的确认邮件。
words.en: Confirmation is the act of confirming something or making it more definite.

words.ex: The farmer's cultivation of rice takes months.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植水稻需要几个月的时间。
words.en: The process of trying to acquire or develop a quality or skill.

words.ex: The small country has a dependency on foreign aid.
words.ex_cn: 这个小国依赖外国援助。
words.en: A dependency is a situation in which someone or something relies on someone or something else for support or existence.

words.tr: n. 吃饭；就餐； v. “dine”的现在分词；
words.ex: Dining with family is my favorite time.
words.ex_cn: 和家人一起吃饭是我最喜欢的时间。
words.en: The act of eating a meal, especially dinner.

words.ex: He practices fasting every Monday for health.
words.ex_cn: 他为了健康每周一禁食。
words.en: Fasting is the act of willingly abstaining from some or all food, drink, or both, for a period of time. It may be for medical, health, or religious reasons.

words.ex: He gave her flattery to make her happy.
words.ex_cn: 他奉承她，让她开心。
words.en: Flattery is the act of praising someone in an insincere way in order to make them feel good or to get something from them.

words.ex: They shook hands with a firm handshake.
words.ex_cn: 他们以坚定的握手示意友好。
words.en: A handshake is a gesture in which two people grasp one of each other's like hands, in most cases accompanied by a brief up and down movement of the grasped hands.

words.ex: He went to his high school homecoming last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他上周末去了他的高中返校节。
words.en: Homecoming is the act of returning to your home after being away for a long time, or a celebration at a school or college, usually once a year, for former students.

words.ex: The inclusion of all students is important.
words.ex_cn: 包含所有学生是很重要的。
words.en: The act of including or the state of being included.

words.ex: The road closure caused an inconvenience to commuters.
words.ex_cn: 道路封闭给通勤者带来了不便。
words.en: Inconvenience refers to the state or quality of being inconvenient; trouble or difficulty caused to one's personal requirements or comfort.

words.ex: The installation of the new machine took two days.
words.ex_cn: 新机器的安置花了两天时间。
words.en: The act of installing or the state of being installed.

words.tr: n. 相互作用；相互影响；互动交流；
words.ex: The interaction between the two chemicals causes a reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质之间的相互作用引起反应。
words.en: An interaction is a situation where two or more people or things communicate with or react to each other.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.ex: His mentality changed after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他的心理状态发生了变化。
words.en: Your mentality is your attitudes and your way of thinking.

words.ex: The modification improved the design.
words.ex_cn: 这个修改改进了设计。
words.en: A modification is a change or alteration made to something to improve it or to make it suitable for a different purpose.

words.ex: The refinement of the machine made it faster.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的改进使它更快了。
words.en: Refinement is the process of making a substance pure or the quality of being polite, well-educated, and able to judge the quality of things.

words.tr: n. 揭露；被揭示的真相；
words.ex: The letter was a revelation about his secret life.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他隐秘的生活。
words.en: A revelation is a surprising and previously unknown fact that has been disclosed to others.

words.tr:
n. 接缝；缝合处；矿层；煤层
v. 缝合；有裂痕
words.ex: The seam of the shirt came loose.
words.ex_cn: 衬衫的接缝松开了。
words.en: A seam is a line where two pieces of fabric are sewn together in a garment or other article.

words.ex: He changed his stance on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了对气候变化的立场。
words.en: A stance is a particular way of standing, especially in sports such as golf or baseball, or a person's attitude or opinion about something, especially when it is stated publicly.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 政治•经济•法律

words.ex: The decision was made in accordance with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定是按照规则做出的。
words.en: Agreement or harmony; conformity.

words.ex: The company made the adoption of new technology quickly.
words.ex_cn: 公司迅速采用了新技术。
words.en: The act of legally taking another's child and bringing it up as one's own, or the act of accepting something new.

words.ex: We will review the meeting agenda tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将审查会议议程。
words.en: An agenda is a list or plan of things to be done or considered, especially in a meeting.

words.tr: n. 依恋；附件；附加装置；
words.ex: The child showed strong attachment to his teddy bear.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对他的泰迪熊产生了强烈的依恋。
words.en: An attachment is a file that is sent along with an email message.

words.ex: The old painting was sold at an auction.
words.ex_cn: 那幅旧画在拍卖会上被卖出了。
words.en: An auction is a public sale where goods or property are sold to the highest bidder.

words.tr: n. 支持； v. 支持；“back”的现在分词；
words.ex: His backing helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 他的支持帮助球队赢得了比赛。
words.en: Support or help.

words.tr:
v. 进行无记名投票 
n. 无记名投票
words.ex: He cast his ballot in the election.
words.ex_cn: 他在选举中投了票。
words.en: A ballot is a process of voting, in writing and typically in secret. It is also the piece of paper on which you mark your vote.

words.tr:
n. 努力争取；出价；投标；
v. 出价；投标；
words.ex: His bid for the championship inspired everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他为冠军所做的努力鼓舞了所有人。
words.en: To bid means to offer a particular amount of money for something that is being sold, especially at an auction, or to offer to do work or provide services for a particular price.

words.ex: The government does a census every ten years.
words.ex_cn: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查。
words.en: A census is an official count or survey of a population, typically recording various details of individuals.

words.ex: He applied for citizenship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年申请了公民身份。
words.en: Citizenship is the status of being a citizen of a particular country.

words.tr: n. 联邦；共和国；联合体；
words.ex: Australia is a member of the Commonwealth.
words.ex_cn: 澳大利亚是联邦的成员。
words.en: A commonwealth is a traditional English term for a political community founded for the common good. Historically, it has been synonymous with 'republic'.

words.tr: n. 共产主义；一种主张生产资料公有、消除阶级差异的社会制度
words.ex: He believes in communism.
words.ex_cn: 他相信共产主义。
words.en: A political theory derived from Karl Marx, advocating class war and leading to a society in which all property is publicly owned and each person works and is paid according to their abilities and needs.

words.ex: He bought a concession ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了电影的减价票。
words.en: A concession is a point or principle that is granted or acknowledged in the course of an argument or negotiation, often as a compromise or to facilitate agreement.

words.ex: The army corps marched through the town.
words.ex_cn: 军队军团穿过城镇行进。
words.en: A corps is a military unit consisting of a large number of soldiers, typically organized for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The boss gave a directive to finish the project by Friday.
words.ex_cn: 老板下达了指令，要求在周五前完成项目。
words.en: An official or authoritative instruction.

words.tr: n. 裁减军备；解除武装；缴械
words.ex: The two countries agreed on disarmament to reduce weapons.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家同意进行裁军以减少武器。
words.en: The reduction or withdrawal of military forces and weapons.

words.tr:
n. 耻辱
v. 使蒙羞；使丢脸；拒付
words.ex: He dishonored his family by lying.
words.ex_cn: 他通过撒谎使家人蒙羞。
words.en: Dishonor is a state of shame or disgrace. If you were caught cheating on a test, you'd probably suffer dishonor. As a verb, dishonor means to bring shame or to disgrace.

words.ex: His dismissal made him very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的被解雇让他非常难过。
words.en: The act of officially removing someone from their job, or the act of sending someone away or allowing them to leave.

words.ex: The disposal of waste is important for the environment.
words.ex_cn: 废物的处理对环境很重要。
words.en: The act or process of getting rid of something, especially by throwing it away or selling it.

words.tr: n. 被除数；股份红利；股息
words.ex: In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, the dividend is 12.
words.en: A dividend is a sum of money paid regularly (typically annually) by a company to its shareholders out of its profits (or reserves).

words.ex: The enforcement of traffic laws keeps roads safe.
words.ex_cn: 交通法规的执行使道路更安全。
words.en: The act of compelling observance of or compliance with a law, rule, or obligation.

words.tr: n. 排除；排斥；被排除在外的事物；
words.ex: The exclusion of students from the test was unfair.
words.ex_cn: 将学生排除在考试之外是不公平的。
words.en: The act of preventing someone or something from entering a place or taking part in an activity.

words.ex: The execution of the criminal was carried out last night.
words.ex_cn: 这名罪犯的处决昨晚执行了。
words.en: The carrying out or performance of a task, plan, or order.

words.ex: The king was sent into exile after the revolution.
words.ex_cn: 革命后，国王被流放了。
words.en: Exile is the state of being sent away from one's home country or place of residence, often for political or punitive reasons.

words.ex: The family reduced their monthly expenditure.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭减少了每月的开支。
words.en: Expenditure is the spending of money on something, or the money that is spent on something.

words.ex: His inability to swim saved him from drowning.
words.ex_cn: 他不会游泳，这救了他一命。
words.en: If you refer to someone's inability to do something, you are emphasizing that they cannot do it.

words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.tr: n. 非正义；不公平；不公正
words.ex: He cried out against the injustice.
words.ex_cn: 他抗议这种不公。
words.en: Injustice refers to the lack of fairness or justice in a situation or action.

words.ex: The radio signal suffered from interference.
words.ex_cn: 收音机信号受到了干扰。
words.en: Interference refers to the action of interfering or the process of being interfered with, especially in a context where it is unwelcome or inappropriate.

words.ex: The kernel of the computer is the operating system.
words.ex_cn: 计算机的核心是操作系统。
words.en: The kernel of something such as a nut or a seed is the part inside the shell. The kernel of an idea or a theory is the central and most important part of it.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.ex: He accepted liability for the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了事故的责任。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a liability, you mean that they cause a lot of problems or embarrassment.

words.ex: He bought a lottery ticket last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一张彩票。
words.en: A lottery is a type of gambling game in which people buy numbered tickets. Several numbers are then chosen, and the people who have those numbers on their tickets win a prize.

words.ex: Pop music is part of the mainstream.
words.ex_cn: 流行音乐是主流的一部分。
words.en: The ideas, attitudes, or activities that are shared by most people and regarded as normal or conventional.

words.ex: The mantle lies below the Earth's crust.
words.ex_cn: 地幔位于地球地壳之下。
words.en: The mantle is the part of the earth between the crust and the core. It can also refer to a cloak or covering.

words.ex: He wrote a memorandum about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于会议的备忘录。
words.en: A memorandum is a written proposal or reminder, especially in a business context.

words.ex: The broken bridge is a menace to drivers.
words.ex_cn: 这座破桥对司机来说是个危险物。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a menace, you mean that they are likely to cause serious harm.

words.ex: The country still has a monarchy with a king as the head of state.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家仍然实行君主制，国王是国家元首。
words.en: A monarchy is a form of government in which a country is ruled by a monarch, such as a king or queen.

words.ex: He took out a mortgage to buy his first house.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔抵押贷款来购买他的第一套房子。
words.en: A mortgage is a loan of money which you get from a bank or building society in order to buy a house.

words.tr: n. 民族主义；国家主义；
words.ex: Nationalism made people proud of their own country.
words.ex_cn: 民族主义让人们为自己的国家感到自豪。
words.en: Nationalism is a political, social, and economic ideology and movement characterized by the promotion of the interests of a particular nation, especially with the aim of gaining and maintaining the nation's sovereignty over its homeland.

words.ex: He took an oath to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓要说出真相。
words.en: An oath is a formal promise, especially one made in a court of law or a religious ceremony, or a swear word.

words.tr: n. 压迫；压制；抑制；镇压
words.ex: The people suffered under oppression for years.
words.ex_cn: 人们多年来一直遭受压迫。
words.en: Oppression is the cruel or unfair treatment of a group of people.

words.ex: His persuasion helped me change my mind.
words.ex_cn: 他的说服让我改变了主意。
words.en: Persuasion is the act of persuading someone to do something or to believe that something is true.

words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.ex: The university has great prestige for its research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学因其研究而享有很高的声望。
words.en: The widespread respect and admiration felt for someone or something on the basis of a perception of their achievements or quality.

words.ex: The two friends reached reconciliation after talking for hours.
words.ex_cn: 两个朋友经过几个小时的交谈后和好了。
words.en: Reconciliation is the process of making two opposite beliefs, ideas, or situations agree.

words.ex: The renewal of the contract took one week.
words.ex_cn: 合同的更新花了一周时间。
words.en: The act of making something valid for a further period of time after it has expired or been canceled.

words.tr: n. 计划；组织；机构；装配
words.ex: The set-up for the party was perfect.
words.ex_cn: 派对的计划很完美。
words.en: The way in which something, especially an organization or equipment, is organized, planned, or arranged.

words.tr:
n. 陷阱；圈套
v. 用陷阱（或罗网）捕捉
words.ex: The hunter set a snare to catch the rabbit.
words.ex_cn: 猎人设了一个陷阱来抓兔子。
words.en: A snare is a trap for catching animals, especially one that uses a noose. It can also refer to a situation that tricks someone into doing something or to catch someone in such a situation.

words.ex: He believes in socialism and wants equal rights for all.
words.ex_cn: 他相信社会主义，希望所有人都享有平等的权利。
words.en: Socialism is a political and economic theory of social organization which advocates that the means of production, distribution, and exchange should be owned or regulated by the community as a whole.

words.ex: The company gave sponsorship to the local sports team.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司资助了当地的体育团队。
words.en: The support given by a sponsor; the act of sponsoring.

words.ex: His submission to the boss ended the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 他对老板的屈服结束了这场冲突。
words.en: The act of submitting something to someone for their decision or consideration; the state of being submissive or obedient.

words.ex: The government gives a subsidy to farmers.
words.ex_cn: 政府向农民提供补贴。
words.en: A subsidy is money that is paid by a government or other authority in order to help an industry or business, or to pay for a public service.

words.ex: The government tried suppression of the protest.
words.ex_cn: 政府试图压制抗议。
words.en: The act of ending something by force or preventing it from being expressed or continuing.

words.tr: n. 悬浮；暂时停职（停学、停赛）；
words.ex: The suspension of dust in the air made the sky look gray.
words.ex_cn: 空气中的尘埃悬浮使天空看起来灰蒙蒙的。
words.en: The act of temporarily stopping something from happening or being in effect, or the state of being stopped in this way.

words.tr: n. 损失；伤亡人数；通行费；
words.ex: The war caused a heavy toll on innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 战争给平民带来了巨大的损失。
words.en: A toll is a small sum of money that you have to pay in order to use a particular bridge or road. / A toll is the total number of deaths, accidents, or disasters that occur in a particular period of time. / When a bell tolls, it rings slowly and repeatedly, often as a sign that someone has died.

words.tr: n. 营业额；人员流动率；周转率；
words.ex: The store's turnover increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店上个月的营业额增加了。
words.en: The amount of money taken by a business in a particular period.

words.ex: The people rose up against the tyranny of the king.
words.ex_cn: 人民反抗了国王的暴虐。
words.en: Tyranny is cruel and unfair treatment by someone with power over other people, or a government in which a single ruler has absolute power.

words.ex: The rules show uniformity in all schools.
words.ex_cn: 这些规则在所有学校中都保持一致。
words.en: The state or quality of being uniform; consistency.

words.ex: Ancient warfare used swords and shields.
words.ex_cn: 古代战争使用剑和盾。
words.en: Warfare is the activity of fighting a war.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 食物

words.ex: He ate a small salad as an appetizer.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一小份沙拉作为开胃菜。
words.en: An appetizer is a small dish of food served before the main part of a meal to stimulate the appetite.

words.tr:
n. 鱼饵；诱惑物
v. 下诱饵
words.ex: He used bread as bait to catch fish.
words.ex_cn: 他用面包当诱饵来钓鱼。
words.en: Bait is something which is used to attract fish or animals so that they can be caught. It can also refer to something that is offered to someone to persuade them to do something.

words.ex: Farmers grow barley for animal feed.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植大麦作为动物饲料。
words.en: Barley is a cereal grain that is used as food and also in making beer and whiskey.

words.ex: He drinks a cold beverage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝一杯冷饮。
words.en: A drink, especially one other than water; a liquid for drinking.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.tr:
adj. 剩余的；
n. 残留物；
words.ex: We ate the leftover food for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我们早餐吃了剩下的食物。
words.en: Remaining after the rest has been used, consumed, or dealt with.

words.ex: We had a potluck dinner with neighbors last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们和邻居们吃了一顿家常便饭。
words.en: A potluck is a meal or party to which each of the guests contributes a dish.

words.tr:
n. 调味品；佐料
v. 给 ... 调味；适应；风干；“season”的现在分词
words.ex: She added seasoning to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她给汤里加了调味料。
words.en: Seasoning is a substance that is added to food to improve its flavor.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 程度•度量衡•单位

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: The density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter.
words.ex_cn: 水的密度是每立方厘米1克。
words.en: Density is a measure of how much mass is contained in a given unit volume of a substance.

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.ex: The magnitude of this decision will affect everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定的重要性会影响每个人。
words.en: Magnitude refers to the great size or extent of something, or the importance of something.

words.ex: He showed maturity when he apologized for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 当他为自己的错误道歉时，表现出了成熟。
words.en: Maturity is the state of being fully developed or grown, or the time when a financial arrangement becomes ready to be paid.

words.ex: The car has high mileage.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车行驶的英里数很高。
words.en: Mileage refers to the distance traveled, measured in miles, or the benefits or advantages gained from a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: He bought a quart of milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了一夸脱牛奶。
words.en: A quart is a unit of measurement for liquids, equal to two pints or approximately 1.14 liters.

words.tr:
adj. 崇高的；壮丽的；极端的；过分的
v. 变高尚；升华
n. 庄严；崇高；顶点
words.ex: The view from the mountain is sublime.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色是壮丽的。
words.en: If you describe something as sublime, you mean that it has a wonderful quality that affects you deeply.

words.tr:
n. 琐事；少量
v. 玩弄；轻视
words.ex: He threw away a trifle of money on candy.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一点钱买糖果。
words.en: A trifle is something that is considered to have little importance, value, or significance. It can also refer to a small amount of something. As a verb, to trifle means to treat someone or something without seriousness or respect.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 场所•位置

words.ex: The infection blocked his airway.
words.ex_cn: 感染堵塞了他的呼吸道。
words.en: An airway is a passage for air to flow, especially in the respiratory system, or a designated route for aircraft.

words.ex: The Earth rotates around its axis.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕其轴旋转。
words.en: An axis is an imaginary line through the middle of something, especially one that it turns around.

words.ex: This village is the birthplace of the famous poet.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄是这位著名诗人的发源地。
words.en: The place where someone was born.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.tr:
n. 旁路；
v. 绕过；
words.ex: The city built a bypass around the old town.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市建了一条绕过老城区的旁路。
words.en: If you bypass a place or a system, you avoid it or go around it instead of going through it.

words.ex: He keeps apples in the cellar.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果存放在地窖里。
words.en: A cellar is a room underneath a house, often used for storing things such as wine or coal.

words.tr: n. 教堂墓地；教堂周围的空地
words.ex: The churchyard was filled with ancient tombstones.
words.ex_cn: 教堂院落里满是古老的墓碑。
words.en: A churchyard is an area of land around a church where dead people are buried.

words.ex: Please leave your coat in the cloakroom.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的外套放在衣帽间。
words.en: A cloakroom is a room where coats, hats, luggage, or other items may be left temporarily, as in a theater, public building, or school.

words.ex: The train has a sleeping compartment for passengers.
words.ex_cn: 火车上有一个供乘客休息的隔间。
words.en: A compartment is a separate section or part of something, especially a space in a vehicle that is separated from other spaces.

words.ex: The lion returned to its den at night.
words.ex_cn: 狮子晚上回到了它的兽穴。
words.en: A den is the home of certain types of wild animals such as lions or foxes, or a place where someone feels safe and private.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: The cows graze in the enclosure.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛在围场里吃草。
words.en: An enclosure is an area that is surrounded by a barrier or fence, often used to keep animals in or to protect something.

words.tr: n. （校外）学生宿舍；旅社；招待所；
words.ex: The students live in a cheap hostel near the university.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在大学附近的一家便宜的学生宿舍里。
words.en: A hostel is a budget-oriented, shared-room accommodation that attracts a diverse clientele, including backpackers, students, and travelers seeking an economical place to stay.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.ex: He always keeps his garden trim and neat.
words.ex_cn: 他总是把花园打理得整洁有序。
words.en: To trim something means to make it tidier or more level by cutting a small amount off it.

words.ex: The coin fell into the slot.
words.ex_cn: 硬币掉进了狭槽里。
words.en: A slot is a narrow opening in a machine or container, for example a hole that you put coins in to make a machine work.

words.ex: He crossed the threshold of adulthood at 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时进入了成年的起始点。
words.en: The threshold of something is the point at which it begins or changes.

words.ex: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 销售部门有一个空缺职位。
words.en: A vacancy is a position or job that is available for someone to fill.

chapters.name: Level 7 名词 人

words.ex: The nurse is the doctor's aide.
words.ex_cn: 护士是医生的助手。
words.en: An aide is someone whose job is to help another person in their work.

words.ex: He learned about his ancestry from his grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖母那里了解了自己的血统。
words.en: Your ancestry is the series of ancestors from whom you are descended.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了计算机科学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor is a man who has never been married.

words.tr:
n. 小伙子；家伙
v. 皲裂
words.ex: The chap helped me carry the boxes.
words.ex_cn: 那个小伙子帮我搬了箱子。
words.en: A chap is a man or boy. If something chaps your skin, it makes it sore and cracked.

words.ex: The clown made the children laugh.
words.ex_cn: 小丑让孩子们笑了。
words.en: A clown is a performer, typically in a circus, who wears a traditional costume and exaggerated makeup, and entertains by performing comedic acts.

words.ex: He called his friend a comrade.
words.ex_cn: 他称他的朋友为同志。
words.en: A comrade is a companion who shares one's activities or is a fellow member of an organization.

words.ex: The controller turns the machine on and off.
words.ex_cn: 控制者打开和关闭机器。
words.en: A controller is a device or mechanism that manages or regulates the operation of a machine or system.

words.ex: The feeder gives food to the animals every morning.
words.ex_cn: 饲养员每天早上给动物喂食。
words.en: A feeder is someone or something that provides food or supplies to others, or a device that supplies material to a machine.

words.ex: Our forefather built this village long ago.
words.ex_cn: 我们的祖先很久以前建造了这个村庄。
words.en: Your forefathers are your ancestors, especially the male ones.

words.ex: The old man is the guardian of his grandchildren.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是他的孙子孙女的保护人。
words.en: A guardian is someone who has the legal authority and responsibility to take care of someone else, especially a child whose parents have died.

words.ex: The householder cleaned the yard every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位房主每天早上打扫院子。
words.en: A householder is a person who owns or rents a house; the head of a household.

words.ex: She invited all her kin to the family reunion.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请了所有亲属参加家庭聚会。
words.en: Your kin are your relatives.

words.ex: The landlord fixed the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 房东修好了破掉的窗户。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns land or property and rents it out to others.

words.ex: The mediator helped the two sides reach an agreement.
words.ex_cn: 调解人帮助双方达成了协议。
words.en: A mediator is a person who tries to end a disagreement by helping the two sides to talk about and agree on a solution.

words.tr: n. 行动的人；提议者；原动力；鼓吹者
words.ex: He is a mover who changes the world with his ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个用思想改变世界的人。
words.en: A mover is someone who moves things from one place to another, especially as their job.

words.ex: He is an optimist who believes things will get better.
words.ex_cn: 他是个乐观主义者，相信事情会好转。
words.en: An optimist is someone who always expects good things to happen or is always hopeful about the future.

words.ex: He is a true patriot who loves his country.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位真正热爱祖国的爱国者。
words.en: A patriot is someone who loves their country and is willing to defend it against enemies or detractors.

words.ex: The payer sent the money on time.
words.ex_cn: 付款人按时汇了钱。
words.en: A payer is a person or organization that makes a payment or is responsible for making payments.

words.tr: n. 悲观主义者；悲观论者
words.ex: He is a pessimist who always expects the worst.
words.ex_cn: 他是个悲观者，总是预期最坏的结果。
words.en: A pessimist is someone who always expects that bad things will happen.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.tr: n. 寻求者；追求者；搜索者
words.ex: The seeker found a hidden path in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位寻找者在森林里发现了一条隐蔽的小路。
words.en: Someone who is trying to find or obtain something.

words.ex: The striker walked out of the factory with other workers.
words.ex_cn: 这位罢工者和其他工人一起离开了工厂。
