words.en: If you make an involuntary movement or exclamation, you make it suddenly and without intending to because you are unable to control yourself.

words.ex: It's ironic that the fire station burned down.
words.ex_cn: 消防站着火了，这真是讽刺。
words.en: If you say that it is ironic that something happens, you mean that it is odd or amusing because it involves a contrast or is the opposite of what you would expect.

words.tr: adj. 充满快乐的；使人高兴的
words.ex: The children were joyous on Christmas morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在圣诞节早上非常快乐。
words.en: If you describe something as joyous, you mean that it is full of joy and happiness.

words.tr: adj. 值得纪念的；难忘的；
words.ex: That vacation was a memorable trip.
words.ex_cn: 那次旅行是一次值得纪念的旅程。
words.en: Something that is memorable is worth remembering or likely to be remembered, because it is special or very enjoyable.

words.ex: The cactus is prickly and hurts if you touch it.
words.ex_cn: 仙人掌是多刺的，碰了会疼。
words.en: Something that is prickly feels as if it has a lot of small sharp points on it, or is covered with them. It can also describe someone who is easily annoyed or offended.

words.ex: The old song is reminiscent of my childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌让人想起我的童年。
words.en: If you say that one thing is reminiscent of another, you mean that it reminds you of it.

words.tr: adj. 讽刺的；嘲讽的；挖苦的
words.ex: He gave a sarcastic laugh when she said she was perfect.
words.ex_cn: 当她说自己完美时，他讽刺地笑了一声。
words.en: If you describe someone as sarcastic, you mean that they are inclined to say things which are the opposite of what they really mean, especially in order to mock or insult someone.

words.tr: adj. 感觉上的；感官的；（引起）美感的
words.ex: She wore a sensuous silk dress.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件性感的丝绸裙子。
words.en: Relating to or affecting the senses rather than the intellect; characterized by a pleasing or luxurious quality that appeals to the senses.

words.ex: The exam was stressful for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试对所有学生来说压力很大。
words.en: If a situation or experience is stressful, it makes you feel worried and tense because of difficulties or problems.

words.tr: adj. 吸引人的；诱人的； v. “tempt”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread is very tempting.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味非常诱人。
words.en: If something is tempting, it makes you feel that you want to have it or do it.

words.tr: adj. 难以忘怀的；令人难忘的
words.ex: That summer was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 那个夏天令人难忘。
words.en: If you describe something as unforgettable, you mean that it is, for example, extremely beautiful, enjoyable, or unusual, so that you remember it for a long time. If you describe someone as unforgettable, you mean that they are, for example, extremely interesting, unusual, or attractive, so that you remember them for a long time.

words.tr: adj. 毫不怀疑的；无危险意识的；无戒备心的
words.ex: The unsuspecting man gave his wallet to the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 那个毫无戒心的人把钱包给了陌生人。
words.en: If you describe someone as unsuspecting, you mean that they are not aware of something that is happening or going to happen, especially something that will cause them harm.

chapters.name: Level 8 形容词 形状•性质•外形•状态

words.ex: Children are often adaptable to new environments.
words.ex_cn: 孩子通常能适应新环境。
words.en: If someone or something is adaptable, they are able to change their ideas or behaviour in order to deal with new situations.

words.tr: adj. 可调整的；可调节的；
words.ex: The chair has an adjustable height.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子的高度可以调节。
words.en: If something is adjustable, it can be changed to different positions or sizes.

words.tr:
n. 类似物
adj. 模拟的；指针式的
words.ex: The clock has analog hands.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟有指针。
words.en: An analog is something that is similar to something else in design, origin, use, etc., but is not exactly the same.

words.ex: He uses analytic methods to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他使用解析方法来解决这个问题。
words.en: Analytic refers to the process of breaking down complex information or substances into smaller parts in order to understand or examine them.

words.tr: adj. 分析的；善于分析的；
words.ex: He uses analytical skills to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用分析能力解决数学问题。
words.en: An analytical way of doing something involves the use of logical reasoning.

words.tr: adj. 混杂的；什锦的；各样的
words.ex: He bought assorted candies at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了各种各样的糖果。
words.en: Assorted means consisting of various kinds mixed together.

words.ex: The table is made of a composite material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由一种合成材料制成的。
words.en: A composite is something that is made up of several different parts or materials.

words.tr:
adj. 弯曲的；扭曲的；欺诈的；不老实的
v. （使）弯曲；使成钩状；“crook”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The path was crooked and hard to walk on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路是弯曲的，很难走。
words.en: If you describe something as crooked, especially something that is usually straight, you mean that it is bent or twisted.

words.tr: adj. 呈弯曲状的；弧形的； v. （使）弯成弧形；“curve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The road is curved around the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这条路沿着山呈弯曲状。
words.en: Having the shape of a curve; not straight.

words.tr: adj. 残疾的； v. “disable”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The disabled man uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 这位残疾人使用轮椅行动。
words.en: If someone is disabled, they are unable to use part of their body or mind properly, for example, because of injury or illness.

words.ex: He used a disposable cup for his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一次性杯子喝咖啡。
words.en: Something that is disposable is intended to be thrown away after use.

words.tr: v. 分裂；分割；“divide”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 分裂的；分开的；
words.ex: The team was divided over the new plan.
words.ex_cn: 团队对这个新计划意见分裂。
words.en: If something is divided, it has been separated into parts or groups which are often in conflict with each other.

words.tr: v. 驱使；驾驶；“drive”的过去分词； adj. 发愤图强的；
words.ex: Fear of failure drove him to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 对失败的恐惧驱使他更加努力工作。
words.en: If you describe someone as driven, you mean they are very strongly motivated to achieve something or to do something.

words.ex: The teacher gave an explanatory note to help students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个解释性的笔记来帮助学生。
words.en: Serving or intended to explain or make clear.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.tr: v. 渐渐消失；“fade”的现在分词； adj. 平淡的；
words.ex: The light is fading as the sun sets.
words.ex_cn: 太阳落山时，光线渐渐消失。
words.en: The process of becoming less bright, less strong, or less noticeable.

words.tr: v. 完成；“finish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 完成的；完蛋的；
words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: Having completed or concluded an activity, task, or work.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；“illustrate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有插图的；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate means to make something clear or to explain it, often by using examples or pictures.

words.ex: His silence was an implicit apology.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默是一种含蓄的道歉。
words.en: Something that is implicit is expressed in an indirect way.

words.tr: v. 暗示；“imply”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: His silence implied he disagreed.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他不同意。
words.en: Suggested or understood without being stated directly.

words.tr: adj. 不切实际的；不实用的；
words.ex: It's impractical to walk to work every day if you live 50 kilometers away.
words.ex_cn: 如果你住得离工作地点50公里远，每天步行上班是不切实际的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as impractical, you mean that they are not good at planning or organizing things in a practical way, or that their ideas or methods are not suitable for a particular situation.

words.tr: adj. 难以达到的；无法接近的；
words.ex: The mountain peak is inaccessible in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这座山峰在冬天难以到达。
words.en: If a place is inaccessible, it is very difficult or impossible to reach or enter.

words.ex: The rules are inflexible and cannot be changed.
words.ex_cn: 这些规则是不灵活的，不能更改。
words.en: If you say that someone is inflexible, you are criticizing them because they refuse to change their mind or alter their way of doing things.

words.tr: adj. 宏伟的；壮丽的；威严的；
words.ex: The majestic mountain stood above the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 那座宏伟的山峰耸立在云层之上。
words.en: If you describe something as majestic, you mean that it has a quality of greatness and impressiveness that often inspires admiration or awe.

words.ex: The mobile table can be moved easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个可移动的桌子很容易搬动。
words.en: A mobile is something that can move or be moved easily.

words.ex: The chair is movable and easy to push.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是可移动的，容易推动。
words.en: Something that is movable can be moved from one place or position to another.

words.ex: Mum made me a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈给我做了一个三明治当午餐。
words.en: A mother; silent or not speaking.

words.ex: The project is ongoing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: An ongoing situation has been happening for quite a long time and seems likely to continue for some time in the future.

words.tr: v. 提升；增加；饲养；筹募；“raise”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 凸起的；提高的；升高的；
words.ex: The company raised his salary last month.
words.ex_cn: 公司上个月提升了他薪水。
words.en: Raised is the past tense and past participle of raise. It can also be used as an adjective to describe something that has been lifted to a higher position or level, or someone who has been brought up in a particular way.

words.ex: The logo is recognizable even from far away.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志即使从远处也能辨认出来。
words.en: Able to be recognized or identified from previous encounters or knowledge.

words.tr: v. 定居；安顿；解决；“settle”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 定居的；稳定的；
words.ex: They settled in Canada last year.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年在加拿大定居了。
words.en: If you feel settled, you have become used to your new home, job, or situation, and you feel comfortable and happy about it.

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.ex: His knowledge of history is superficial.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史的了解是表面的。
words.en: If you describe someone as superficial, you disapprove of them because they do not think deeply, and have little understanding of anything serious or important.

words.tr: adj. 未破的；不间断的；未驯服的（马）
words.ex: The unbroken chain of events led to the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这一连串未被打断的事件导致了事故。
words.en: If something is unbroken, it is continuous or complete and has not been interrupted or damaged.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；潜在的； v. “underlie”的现在分词；
words.ex: The underlying cause of the problem is poverty.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的根本原因是贫困。
words.en: An underlying thing is the thing that is the most important or basic, although it is not easily noticed or stated directly.

words.ex: The cat slept undisturbed on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发上安静地睡觉，没有被打扰。
words.en: If something is undisturbed, it is not touched, moved, or used by anyone.

words.tr: adj. 不平坦的；不均匀的；
words.ex: The road is uneven and hard to drive on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路不平坦，很难开车。
words.en: Something that is uneven is not regular, consistent, or equal.

words.ex: The unfinished homework lay on the desk.
words.ex_cn: 未完成的作业放在书桌上。
words.en: Not finished or concluded; incomplete.

words.tr: adj. 不安定的；不平稳的；“unsettle”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The weather remained unsettled, with frequent rain and wind.
words.ex_cn: 天气仍然不稳定，频繁下雨和刮风。
words.en: If you describe a situation or period as unsettled, you mean that it is full of uncertainty or problems and is likely to change often.

words.ex: Children are vulnerable to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If someone or something is vulnerable, they are weak and without protection, with the result that they are easily hurt physically or emotionally.

chapters.name: Level 8 形容词 和数字相关•时间•频率

words.tr:
adj. 小数的；十进位的
n. 小数
words.ex: The decimal point separates the whole number from the decimal part.
words.ex_cn: 小数点将整数部分与小数部分分开。
words.en: A decimal is a fraction that is written in a special form. It is based on powers of ten, and it uses a decimal point to separate the whole number part from the fractional part.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；不朽的； v. 忍受；“endure”的现在分词；
words.ex: This is an enduring friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这是一段持久的友谊。
words.en: Lasting for a long time; continuing or enduring over a period of time.

words.tr:
adj. 季度的；
adv. 每季一次；
words.ex: The company releases its quarterly report every three months.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每三个月发布一次季度报告。
words.en: Something that happens quarterly happens four times a year, at intervals of three months.

words.ex: The rain was unending.
words.ex_cn: 雨下个不停。
words.en: Something that is unending seems to have no end or to last forever.

chapters.name: Level 8 形容词 性格•倾向

words.ex: It is advisable to wear a helmet when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是明智的。
words.en: If something is advisable, it will avoid problems if you do it.

words.ex: He gave an affirmative answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了肯定的回答。
words.en: An affirmative word or gesture indicates agreement or consent.

words.tr: adj. 令人信服的； v. “compel”的现在分词；
words.ex: His story was compelling and made everyone listen.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事令人信服，让所有人都认真聆听。
words.en: A compelling argument or reason is one that makes you believe it or accept it because it is so strong.

words.ex: He is a conscientious student who always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个尽责的学生，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is conscientious is very careful to do their work properly.

words.tr: adj. 考虑周到的；体贴的；
words.ex: He is considerate and always asks if others need help.
words.ex_cn: 他很体贴，总是问别人是否需要帮助。
words.en: Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people.

words.tr: adj. 可恶的； v. “curse”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This cursed rain ruined my picnic.
words.ex_cn: 这该死的雨毁了我的野餐。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is cursed, you mean that they seem to be under a curse or to bring bad luck.

words.tr: v. 设计；“design”的现在分词； adj. 蓄意的；
words.ex: He is designing a new house.
words.ex_cn: 他正在设计一座新房子。
words.en: The process of planning or creating something, such as a building, a machine, or a piece of software, in a way that is both functional and aesthetically pleasing.

words.ex: The judge was disinterested in the case.
words.ex_cn: 法官对这个案件持客观态度。
words.en: If someone is disinterested in something, they have no personal involvement or investment in it and are therefore able to judge it fairly.

words.tr:
adj. 同性恋的
n. 同性恋者
words.ex: He is homosexual and loves his partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是同性恋，爱他的伴侣。
words.en: A homosexual is someone who is sexually attracted to people of the same sex.

words.ex: He made an immoral choice to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了一个不道德的决定去偷钱。
words.en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as immoral, you believe that their behaviour is morally wrong.

words.tr: adj. 不受个人感情影响的；没有人情味的；
words.ex: The judge gave an impersonal decision based on the law.
words.ex_cn: 法官基于法律作出了不受个人感情影响的判决。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as impersonal, you mean that they do not show any emotion about the person they are dealing with.

words.ex: It is improbable that he will arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 他准时到达的可能性很小。
words.en: If you describe something as improbable, you mean it is unlikely to be true or to happen.

words.tr: adj. 纵容的；宽厚的；溺爱的
words.ex: Her parents are indulgent and let her stay up late.
words.ex_cn: 她的父母很纵容，让她熬夜。
words.en: If you are indulgent, you treat someone with special kindness, often in a way that is not good for them.

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.ex: The inventive child made a toy from cardboard.
words.ex_cn: 这个有创造力的孩子用纸板做了一个玩具。
words.en: If you describe someone as inventive, you mean that they are good at inventing things or have clever and original ideas.

words.tr: adj. 调皮的；恶作剧的；有害的
words.ex: The mischievous boy laughed and hid his sister's shoes.
words.ex_cn: 那个顽皮的男孩笑着藏起了他姐姐的鞋子。
words.en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as mischievous, you mean that they enjoy playing tricks on people or doing things to annoy or embarrass them.

words.tr: adj. 喜怒无常的；情绪多变的；
words.ex: He is moody and changes his mind often.
words.ex_cn: 他喜怒无常，经常改变主意。
words.en: If you describe someone as moody, you mean that their feelings and behavior change frequently, and in particular that they often become depressed or angry without any warning.

words.tr: adj. 疏忽的；粗心的；不在意的
words.ex: He was negligent in doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做作业时很疏忽。
words.en: If you say that someone is negligent, you mean that they do not take enough care over something that they are responsible for.

words.ex: The weather was predictable today, just like yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气和昨天一样，是可以预见的。
words.en: If you say that an event or a situation is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen or what it will be like.

words.tr: adj. 坚决的；毅然的；有决心的；
words.ex: He was resolute in his decision to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他决心戒烟。
words.en: If you describe someone as resolute, you approve of them because they are very determined not to change their mind or not to give up a course of action.

words.tr: adj. 无耻的；脸皮厚的；不知羞耻的
words.ex: He gave a shameless excuse for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他为迟到提供了一个无耻的借口。
words.en: If you describe someone as shameless, you mean that they should be ashamed of their behavior, which is unacceptable to other people.

words.tr: adj. 精明的；敏锐的；机灵的；
words.ex: He made a shrewd decision to buy the house low.
words.ex_cn: 他精明地决定低价买下这栋房子。
words.en: A shrewd person is able to understand and judge a situation quickly and to use this understanding to their own advantage.

words.ex: The treacherous road made driving very scary.
words.ex_cn: 这条危险的道路让驾驶非常可怕。
words.en: If you describe someone as treacherous, you mean that they are likely to betray you and cannot be trusted. If you say that something is treacherous, you mean that it is very dangerous and unpredictable.

words.ex: The weather was unfavorable for the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气对野餐不利。
words.en: If conditions or circumstances are unfavorable, they make it difficult for something to happen or exist.

words.ex: The neighbor gave an unfriendly look.
words.ex_cn: 邻居给了一个不友好的眼神。
words.en: If you describe someone as unfriendly, you mean that they behave in a hostile or unsympathetic way.

words.ex: The story he told was untrue.
words.ex_cn: 他讲的故事是不真实的。
words.en: If a statement or idea is untrue, it is false and not based on facts.

chapters.name: Level 8 形容词 政治•经济

words.tr: v. 声称；“allege”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 所谓的；
words.ex: He alleged that the witness lied.
words.ex_cn: 他声称证人说了谎。
words.en: An alleged fact has been stated but has not been proved.

words.ex: He wears aristocratic clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着贵族风格的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: Belonging to or characteristic of the aristocracy.

words.tr: adj. 仁慈的；慈善事业的；
words.ex: She gave charitable donations to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 她向穷人捐赠了仁慈的善款。
words.en: A charitable organization or activity helps and supports people who are ill, very poor, or who have disabilities.

words.ex: He works in a clerical job at the office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室做文书工作。
words.en: Clerical means relating to work that is done in an office, especially work that involves keeping records or accounts. It can also refer to the clergy or the religious leaders of a church.

words.tr: v. 证实；确认；“confirm”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 证实的；
words.ex: The test confirmed his illness.
words.ex_cn: 检测证实了他生病了。
words.en: If someone is confirmed in a particular position or role, they are formally given that position or role.

words.tr: adj. 全世界的；四海一家的；
words.ex: This city has a cosmopolitan population.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有着来自世界各地的人口。
words.en: A cosmopolitan place or society is full of people from many different countries and cultures.

words.ex: The school has a disciplinary policy for students who break rules.
words.ex_cn: 学校对违反规则的学生有纪律规定。
words.en: Relating to discipline; enforcing or administering discipline.

words.ex: He is a freelance graphic designer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名自由职业的平面设计师。
words.en: A freelance person is someone who does particular pieces of work for different organizations, rather than working all the time for a single organization.

words.tr: adj. 控制的；管理的； v. “govern”的现在分词；
words.ex: The governing rules are simple and clear.
words.ex_cn: 控制的规则简单而清晰。
words.en: Having the authority to control or direct the actions of a country, organization, or group.

words.ex: He has ideological beliefs about freedom.
words.ex_cn: 他有关于自由的思想信念。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with ideas, especially of a political or economic nature.

words.tr: v. 包含； adj. 股份有限的；组成公司的；组成公司( incorporate的过去式和过；
words.ex: The recipe incorporated fresh herbs for better flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱包含了新鲜香草以提升风味。
words.en: If something is incorporated into a larger group, system, or area, it becomes part of it.

words.tr: adj. 增进知识的；提供消息的；
words.ex: The documentary is very informative.
words.ex_cn: 这部纪录片非常增进了知识。
words.en: Providing useful or interesting information.

words.tr: adj. 综合的；整合的；融合的； v. 整合；结合；“integrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The school offers an integrated science course.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校提供一门综合科学课程。
words.en: An integrated system or approach combines different groups or ideas in a way that works well.

words.tr: adj. 司法的；法庭的；审判的；
words.ex: The judicial system protects people's rights.
words.ex_cn: 司法系统保护人民的权利。
words.en: Judicial means relating to the legal system and to judgments made in a court of law.

words.tr: adj. 被许可的； v. “license”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a licensed doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有执照的医生。
words.en: Officially permitted or authorized to do something.

words.tr: adj. 可出售的；适于销售的；
words.ex: This painting is marketable because many people like it.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是可以出售的，因为很多人喜欢它。
words.en: If something is marketable, it is easy to sell because people want to buy it.

words.tr: adj. 国家主义的；民族主义的
words.ex: His nationalistic views often led to conflict with other political factions.
words.ex_cn: 他的民族主义观点常常与其他政治派别发生冲突。
words.en: If you describe someone as nationalistic, you mean they are very proud of their nation. They also often believe that their nation is better than any other nation, and in this case, you can describe them as chauvinistic nationalistic.

words.ex: He chose an occupational therapy course.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了一门职业治疗课程。
words.en: Relating to a job or profession.

words.tr: adj. 压迫的；沉重的；难以忍受的；闷热的
words.ex: The oppressive heat made it hard to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 令人窒息的炎热让人难以呼吸。
words.en: If you describe a society, its laws, or customs as oppressive, you think they treat people in an unfair and cruel way and prevent them from having opportunities and freedom.

words.ex: The organizational structure is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 组织结构清晰而简单。
words.en: Relating to the way in which the different parts of something are arranged or organized.

words.tr:
adj. 待定的；即将发生的
prep. 在等待…期间；直到…为止
words.ex: The decision is pending.
words.ex_cn: 决定尚未做出。
words.en: If something is pending, it has not yet happened or been decided, and is often waiting for something else to happen first.

words.tr: adj. 务实的；实事求是的；
words.ex: He took a pragmatic approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了务实的方法来解决问题。
words.en: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet is a preventive measure.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔是一种预防性的措施。
words.en: Designed to stop something undesirable from occurring.

words.ex: The new policy is problematic for small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策对小企业来说成问题。
words.en: If something is problematic, it involves problems and is difficult to deal with or solve.

words.ex: He was triumphant after winning the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在赢得比赛后非常成功。
words.en: If you are triumphant, you have achieved a great victory or success, often making you feel very proud and happy.

chapters.name: Level 8 形容词 天气•气候•天文现象•自然

words.ex: The birds flew through the aerial sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在空中飞翔。
words.en: An aerial is a wire or rod that sends or receives radio or television signals. As an adjective, aerial describes things that are in the air or related to the air.

words.tr: adj. 无望的；凄凉的；荒凉的；
words.ex: The future looks bleak without a job.
words.ex_cn: 没有工作，未来看起来毫无希望。
words.en: If you describe a situation as bleak, you mean that it seems unlikely to improve or get better.

words.ex: We had a cloudless sky during our hike.
words.ex_cn: 我们在徒步旅行时天空晴朗无云。
words.en: If the sky is cloudless, there are no clouds in it.

words.ex: The tree has leafy branches in summer.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在夏天有茂密的枝叶。
words.en: A leafy place has a lot of leaves on the trees or plants.

words.ex: The lunar surface is covered with dust.
words.ex_cn: 月球表面覆盖着尘土。
words.en: Of or relating to the moon.

words.tr: adj. 不能生育的；贫瘠的；
words.ex: The doctor said the man is sterile.
words.ex_cn: 医生说这个人不能生育。
words.en: Something that is sterile is completely clean and free from bacteria or other microorganisms.

chapters.name: Level 8 形容词 程度•度量衡•单位

words.tr: v. 吸收；“absorb”的现在分词； adj. 吸引人的；
words.ex: The sponge is absorbing water.
words.ex_cn: 海绵正在吸收水。
words.en: If something is absorbing, it is very interesting and holds your attention completely.

words.ex: The teacher chose an arbitrary number to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师随意选了一个数字来开始游戏。
words.en: If you describe an action, rule, or decision as arbitrary, you think that it is not based on any principle, plan, or system. It often seems unfair because of this.

words.tr: adj. 平衡的； v. （使）平衡；“balance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She eats a balanced diet to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 她吃均衡的饮食以保持健康。
words.en: If something is balanced, it has equal proportions or is arranged in a way that is not too much in one direction or another.

words.tr: adj. 绝对的；确定无疑的；分类的
words.ex: He gave a categorical no to the offer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议给出了明确的拒绝。
words.en: If you are categorical about something, you state your views very definitely and firmly.

words.ex: The water freezes at zero centigrade.
words.ex_cn: 水在零摄氏度时结冰。
words.en: Centigrade is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.tr: adj. 无可置疑的；决定性的；
words.ex: The evidence was conclusive.
words.ex_cn: 证据是无可置疑的。
words.en: If something is conclusive, it means that it proves something in a way that is certain and leaves no doubt.

words.ex: The box has a cubic shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是立方体形状的。
words.en: Relating to or involving the cube or cubes.

words.tr:
adj. 应得的
v. 值得；应得；应受惩罚；“deserve”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He worked hard and deserved the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，配得上这个奖。
words.en: If you say that someone deserved something, you mean that it was right and proper for them to have it, because of the way they have behaved or the qualities they have.

words.ex: This bag is durable and lasts for years.
words.ex_cn: 这个包很耐用，可以用很多年。
words.en: Something that is durable is strong and lasts a long time without breaking or becoming weaker.

words.tr: adj. 强调的；明确表示的；加强语气的
words.ex: He gave an emphatic no to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了坚决的否定。
words.en: An emphatic statement or response is expressed in a very forceful and clear way.

words.ex: He gave an explicit answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了明确的答案。
words.en: Something that is explicit is expressed or shown clearly and openly, without any attempt to hide anything.

words.ex: The book has a finite number of pages.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的页数是有限的。
words.en: Something that is finite has a definite fixed size or extent.

words.ex: The old man is frail and needs help to walk.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人瘦弱，需要帮助才能走路。
words.en: Someone who is frail is not very strong or healthy.

words.tr: n. 重量级选手；体重超过平均水平的人；有影响力的人或事
words.ex: He is a heavyweight boxer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名重量级拳击手。
words.en: A heavyweight is a person or thing that is of great importance or influence, especially in a particular field or area.

words.tr: adj. 不精确的；不准确的；有错误的；
words.ex: The clock is inaccurate and shows the wrong time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟不精确，显示的时间不对。
words.en: If a statement or measurement is inaccurate, it is not correct or not exact.

words.tr: adj. 不完全的；不完整的；
words.ex: The puzzle is incomplete without the last piece.
words.ex_cn: 没有最后一块，这个拼图是不完全的。
words.en: If something is incomplete, it is not yet finished, or it does not have all the parts that it should have.

words.tr: adj. 无效果的；不起作用的；不奏效的；
words.ex: The medicine was ineffective against the cold.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒无效。
words.en: If someone or something is ineffective, they do not achieve the intended result.

words.ex: The old machine is inefficient and uses too much energy.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧机器效率低，耗能太多。
words.en: If someone or something is inefficient, they do not use time, energy, or resources in the best way.

words.ex: Honesty is an integral part of a good relationship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是良好关系中不可或缺的一部分。
words.en: Something that is integral is very important or necessary. If something is an integral part of a whole, it is an essential part of that whole.

words.ex: The noise was intolerable.
words.ex_cn: 这噪音无法忍受。
words.en: If you describe something as intolerable, you mean that it is so bad or extreme that no one can bear it or tolerate it.

words.tr: adj. 无价的；非常宝贵的；
words.ex: Her advice was invaluable to me.
words.ex_cn: 她的建议对我而言是无价的。
words.en: If you describe something as invaluable, you mean that it is extremely useful.

words.ex: The boxer is a lightweight fighter.
words.ex_cn: 这位拳击手是一名轻量级选手。
words.en: Something that is lightweight weighs less than average or is less heavy than usual. It can also refer to someone who is not very important or influential.

words.ex: He gave a meaningful speech that helped many people.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一次有意义的演讲，帮助了很多人。
words.en: If you describe something as meaningful, you mean that it is important, serious, or useful in some way.

words.ex: The talk was meaningless and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这场谈话毫无意义且无聊。
words.en: If something is meaningless, it has no meaning, or seems to have no meaning.

words.ex: The country uses metric units for weight and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家使用米制单位来衡量重量和距离。
words.en: A metric is a system of measurement that uses meters, liters, and grams as its basic units.

words.ex: The error is negligible.
words.ex_cn: 这个误差可以忽略。
words.en: If you describe something as negligible, you mean that it is so small or unimportant that it is not worth considering or worrying about.

words.ex: The climb was perilous in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 在暴风雨中，这次攀登非常危险。
words.en: Full of danger or risk.

words.ex: The extra chair is redundant because we have enough seats.
words.ex_cn: 这把额外的椅子是多余的，因为我们已经有足够的座位了。
words.en: If you are made redundant, your employer tells you to leave because your job is no longer necessary or because there is no more work for you.

words.tr: adj. 不足的；欠缺的；微小的；
words.ex: There is scant evidence to support the claim.
words.ex_cn: 支持这一说法的证据不足。
words.en: If you describe something as scant, you mean that there is not enough of it or that it is not as much as it should be.

words.tr:
adj. 刺耳的；尖声的；尖厉的
v. 尖叫；发出刺耳的声音
words.ex: The baby's cry was shrill.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的哭声很尖锐。
words.en: A shrill sound is high and unpleasant to listen to.

words.tr: adj. 无条件的；无限制的；绝对的
words.ex: She gave him unconditional love.
words.ex_cn: 她给了他无条件的爱。
words.en: If you describe something as unconditional, you mean that it is not limited or affected by any conditions.

words.ex: He was unfit for the job because he lacked experience.
words.ex_cn: 他因缺乏经验而不合格。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is unfit for a particular purpose or job, you are criticizing them because they are not good enough for that purpose or job.

words.ex: The movie's world feels unreal.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的世界感觉不真实。
words.en: If you describe something as unreal, you mean that it is so strange, unusual, or extreme that it seems like something from a dream or a story rather than something real.

words.ex: The old bridge is unsafe to cross.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥过桥不安全。
words.en: If a place, situation, or activity is unsafe, it is dangerous.

chapters.name: Level 8 副词 位置•场所

words.ex: The store sells locally grown vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售本地种植的蔬菜。
words.en: In or referring to a particular area or neighborhood, especially the one where you live or are at the moment.

words.tr:
adj. 中途的；中间的
adv. 中途地；中间地
n. 娱乐场；游乐场
words.ex: He stopped midway to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他中途停下来休息。
words.en: Midway is used to describe something that is in the middle of a place or a period of time.

chapters.name: Level 8 副词 时间•频率

words.ex: Hitherto, no one has solved the problem.
words.ex_cn: 迄今为止，没有人解决过这个问题。
words.en: Until now or until the point in time under discussion.

words.tr:
adj. 每夜的；每晚的；
adv. 每夜；每晚；
words.ex: He does nightly exercises to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚做锻炼来保持健康。
words.en: Happening or done every night; relating to the night.

chapters.name: Level 8 副词 程度

words.ex: He acutely noticed the change in her tone.
words.ex_cn: 他敏锐地注意到了她语气的变化。
words.en: In a way that is very severe or intense; keenly.

words.tr: adv. 充满深情地；亲切地
words.ex: She smiled affectionately at her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她亲切地对弟弟笑了笑。
words.en: In a way that displays fondness or tenderness.

words.tr: adv. 聪明地；机灵地；巧妙地；
words.ex: He solved the puzzle cleverly.
words.ex_cn: 他聪明地解决了这个谜题。
words.en: In a clever manner; with intelligence or ingenuity.

words.ex: He duly submitted his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他适时地按时交了作业。
words.en: If something is duly done, it is done in the correct way or at the correct time; properly.

words.tr: adv. 强调地；断然地；显然地
words.ex: She emphatically denied the accusation.
words.ex_cn: 她坚决否认了这项指控。
words.en: In a forceful way that shows emphasis.

words.ex: He is exceptionally good at math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面异常出色。
words.en: To an unusual degree; extremely.

words.tr: adv. 微弱地；微细地；隐约地
words.ex: He faintly remembered his first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 他依稀记得自己第一天上学的情景。
words.en: In a faint manner; very slightly or vaguely.

words.tr: adv. 由衷地；真诚地；真正地；
words.ex: I genuinely appreciate your help.
words.ex_cn: 我由衷地感谢你的帮助。
words.en: If you describe something as genuine, you mean that it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.tr: adv. 无限地；无穷地；极大地；
words.ex: The stars are infinitely far away.
words.ex_cn: 星星离得无限远。
words.en: In a way that is without limits or bounds; extremely or immeasurably.

words.ex: The new policy substantially improved the results.
words.ex_cn: 新政策实质上改善了结果。
words.en: To a great extent or degree; considerably.

words.ex: The water is sufficiently warm to swim.
words.ex_cn: 水温足够暖和，可以游泳。
words.en: To an adequate degree; enough.

chapters.name: Level 8 副词 其他

words.tr: adv. 或者；作为一种选择；
words.ex: You can take the bus, or alternatively, walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 你可以坐公交车，或者 alternatively，走路去学校。
words.en: Used to introduce a suggestion that is different from the one already mentioned.

words.ex: They mutually agreed to end the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此同意结束争斗。
words.en: In a way that involves shared feelings or actions between two or more people or things.

words.ex: He is potentially going to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他有可能赢得比赛。
words.en: in a way that is possible or likely to happen or be true

words.tr: adv. 故意地；有目的地；特意地；
words.ex: He purposely broke the vase to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他故意打碎了花瓶以引起注意。
words.en: If you do something purposely, you do it intentionally.

words.ex: He looked suspiciously at the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 他可疑地盯着那个陌生人。
words.en: In a manner that arouses suspicion or mistrust.

chapters.name: Level 8 介词

words.ex: He stood amid the trees, quiet and still.
words.ex_cn: 他站在树木中间，安静而静止。
words.en: If something is amid other things, it is surrounded by them.

words.ex: The red team played versus the blue team.
words.ex_cn: 红队与蓝队比赛。
words.en: Used to indicate the two sides in a competition or conflict.

chapters.name: Level 8 连接词

words.tr: v. 假定；“assume”的现在分词； conj. 假定；假如；
words.ex: Assuming it rains, we will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 假定下雨，我们就待在家里。
words.en: If you describe someone as assuming, you are critical of them because they behave in a way that shows they think they are more important than other people.

chapters.name: Level 8 感叹词

words.tr:
int. （表示高兴、赞成的欢呼声）好啊，万岁
n. 欢呼声
v. 欢呼；叫好
words.ex: Hurrah! We won the game!
words.ex_cn: 万岁！我们赢了比赛！
words.en: An exclamation of joy, approval, or encouragement.

chapters.name: Level 9 状态•存在类动词

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: Loud noise aggravates his headache.
words.ex_cn: 噪音加重了他的头痛。
words.en: If someone or something aggravates a situation, they make it worse.

words.ex: The speaker will amplify the sound for everyone to hear.
words.ex_cn: 扬声器会放大声音，让每个人都能听到。
words.en: To amplify something means to make it louder, stronger, or more detailed.

words.ex: The room has good acoustic properties.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有良好的声音效果。
words.en: Relating to sound or the sense of hearing.

words.tr:
adj. 有生命的；有活力的
v. 使具活力；做成动画
words.ex: The cartoon characters are animate and full of energy.
words.ex_cn: 这些卡通角色是有生命的，充满活力。
words.en: To animate something means to give it life or to make it lively and energetic.

words.tr: adj. 不合常规的；不符合惯例的；不寻常的；
words.ex: He wears unconventional clothes to stand out.
words.ex_cn: 他穿不合常规的衣服来引人注目。
words.en: If you describe a person or their attitude or behaviour as unconventional, you mean that they do not behave in the same way as most other people in their society.

words.ex: He tries to assimilate new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力吸收新单词。
words.en: To assimilate means to take in and understand fully ideas, information, or culture, or to make something become part of a group or system.

words.ex: He made a painstaking effort to fix the small details.
words.ex_cn: 他细心地努力修正每一个小细节。
words.en: If you describe someone's work as painstaking, you mean that they do it very carefully and thoroughly, often taking a long time.

words.tr:
adj. 美国的；美洲的；
n. 美国人；美洲人；
words.ex: She bought an American car.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一辆美国车。
words.en: relating to the United States of America or its people, culture, or language

words.ex: The factory will automate the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 工厂将自动化装配线。
words.en: To automate a factory, office, or industrial process means to put in machines which can do the work instead of people.

words.ex: He works in a factory that makes semiconductors.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家生产半导体的工厂工作。
words.en: A semiconductor is a substance that can conduct electricity under some conditions but not others, making it a good medium for the control of electrical current.

words.ex: The fire blackened the pot.
words.ex_cn: 火把锅烧黑了。
words.en: To make or become black or dark, especially by the action of fire, smoke, or dirt; to defame someone's character.

words.ex: The church's steeple was visible from miles away.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的尖塔在数英里外就能看到。
words.en: A steeple is a tall pointed structure on the top of a building, especially a church.

words.ex: The old wall began to crumble after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 旧墙在雨后开始坍塌。
words.en: If something crumbles, or if you crumble it, it breaks into a lot of small pieces.

words.ex: The clock has a quartz crystal inside.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟里面有一个石英晶体。
words.en: Quartz is a hard, crystalline mineral composed of silicon and oxygen atoms. It is one of the most common minerals in the Earth's continental crust.

words.ex: The miners dug deep to find iron ore.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们深入地下寻找铁矿石。
words.en: Ore is rock or earth from which metal can be obtained.

words.ex: Gunpowder was used to make fireworks.
words.ex_cn: 火药被用来制作烟花。
words.en: A black or brown explosive substance consisting of a mixture of potassium nitrate, charcoal, and sulfur, used in gunnery and as a blasting agent in mining.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的；许多的（用于不可数名词前）
words.ex: He ate a large amount of pizza at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上吃了大量的披萨。
words.en: A large amount of something is a lot of it.

words.ex: He wore a coat made of badger.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件用獾皮毛制成的外套。
words.en: To badger someone means to repeatedly ask them to do something or to repeatedly question them about something, often in an annoying way.

words.ex: The weather will deteriorate tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天天气会恶化。
words.en: If something deteriorates, it becomes worse in some way.

words.ex: The water has a dangerous contaminant.
words.ex_cn: 这种水含有危险的污染物。
words.en: A contaminant is something that makes a place or a substance (such as water, air, or food) no longer suitable for use, often by adding harmful substances to it.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.ex: The daffodil blooms in spring.
words.ex_cn: 水仙花在春天开放。
words.en: A daffodil is a yellow flower that blooms in the spring.

words.tr:
n. 低垂；凋萎；萎靡
v. 低垂；凋萎；萎靡
words.ex: The flowers droop in the hot sun.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在烈日下低垂。
words.en: If something droops, it hangs or leans downwards with no strength or firmness.

words.tr: v. 使带电；使电气化；使激动不已
words.ex: The new train system will electrify the entire region.
words.ex_cn: 新的火车系统将使整个地区电气化。
words.en: To electrify something means to make it operate using electricity or to make it more exciting or interesting.

words.ex: The hikers walked through a deep gorge.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者走过一个深峡谷。
words.en: A gorge is a deep, narrow valley with steep sides, often carved by a river. It can also refer to the act of eating greedily.

words.ex: He is an icon of pop music.
words.ex_cn: 他是流行音乐的偶像。
words.en: An icon is a small picture or symbol on a computer screen that represents a program or a file.

words.tr: v. 体现；使具体化；包含
words.ex: He embodies kindness and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他体现了善良和耐心。
words.en: To embody means to represent a quality or an idea exactly; to include or contain something.

words.tr: n. 母性; 母亲身份; 母亲们（总称）
words.ex: She loves motherhood and enjoys taking care of her baby.
words.ex_cn: 她热爱母职，享受照顾宝宝的过程。
words.en: Motherhood is the state of being a mother, or the qualities or feelings associated with being a mother.

words.ex: The painting depicts the Virgin Mary holding the infant Jesus.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了圣母玛利亚怀抱着婴儿耶稣。
words.en: The Virgin Mary is the mother of Jesus Christ in Christian belief. She is venerated as a saint and considered to be the mother of God by many Christians.

words.ex: The volcano erupts suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 火山突然喷发。
words.en: If a volcano erupts, it throws out smoke, fire, and melted rocks.

words.ex: The fish swim near the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在珊瑚礁附近游动。
words.en: A reef is a long line of rocks or sand, the top of which is just above or just below the surface of the sea.

words.tr: adj. 人道的；仁慈的；人文的
words.ex: The shelter treats animals in a humane way.
words.ex_cn: 这个收容所以人道的方式对待动物。
words.en: If you describe something as humane, you mean that it is good and kind, especially because it decreases suffering.

words.ex: He felt enmity toward his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他对他邻居怀有敌意。
words.en: Enmity is a feeling of hostility or ill will towards someone or something.

words.ex: The sun makes the puddle evaporate quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使水坑很快蒸发。
words.en: If a liquid evaporates, or if something evaporates it, it changes from a liquid state to a gas, because its temperature has increased.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: To pay attention to someone or something in order to hear what is being said, sung, played, etc.

words.tr: v. 变新鲜；使洁净；使有精神
words.ex: She opened the window to freshen the room.
words.ex_cn: 她打开窗户让房间通风。
words.en: To make something fresh or cleaner, especially by adding water or air.

words.tr: adj. 沉闷乏味的；忧郁的；凄凉的
words.ex: The weather was dreary and rainy all day.
words.ex_cn: 天气一整天都阴沉沉的，还下着雨。
words.en: If you describe something as dreary, you mean that it is dull, lifeless, or depressing.

words.tr: n. 样品陈列室；展销厅；
words.ex: The car showroom has many new models on display.
words.ex_cn: 汽车样品陈列室里有许多新款车型展出。
words.en: A showroom is a large room used for displaying goods, especially cars, furniture, or electrical appliances, for sale.

words.tr: adj. 肌肉的；肌肉发达的；
words.ex: He has a muscular arm from lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他因为举重而拥有强壮的手臂。
words.en: Relating to or affecting the muscles; having well-developed muscles.

words.tr:
n. 纹身；刺青
v. 给…纹身
words.ex: He has a tattoo on his arm.
words.ex_cn: 他的手臂上有一个纹身。
words.en: A tattoo is a design that is drawn on someone's skin using needles to put little holes in the skin and filling them with coloured ink.

words.tr:
v. 闪光；闪耀
n. 闪光；闪耀
words.ex: The dew glistens on the grass in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨露珠在草地上闪闪发亮。
words.en: If something glistens, it shines, usually because it is wet or oily.

words.ex: He wrote a manifesto to explain his ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份宣言来解释他的观点。
words.en: A manifesto is a written statement of the beliefs, aims, and policies of an organization, especially a political party.

words.ex: He incurred a fine for speeding.
words.ex_cn: 他因超速而招致了一笔罚款。
words.en: If you incur something unpleasant, it happens to you because of something you have done.

words.ex: The public expressed condemnation for the violent act.
words.ex_cn: 公众对这一暴力行为表示谴责。
words.en: Condemnation is the act of saying that something or someone is very bad and unacceptable.

words.ex: The politician lost his constituency after the scandal.
words.ex_cn: 这位政客在丑闻后失去了他的支持者。
words.en: A constituency is a group of people in a country or area who are entitled to vote in an election, or the area itself.

words.ex: The city plans to modernize its old subway system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划现代化其老旧的地铁系统。
words.en: To modernize something means to change it so that it is more modern, for example by using more recent technology or methods.

words.tr: n. 头饰；头巾；头发编梳的式样
words.ex: She wore an elaborate headdress for the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 她为婚礼戴了一顶精致的饰头巾。
words.en: A headdress is a decorative covering or ornament worn on the head.

words.ex: Blue jeans are in vogue this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: If something is in vogue, it is very popular and fashionable.

words.ex: This style of clothing is in vogue this season.
words.ex_cn: 这种服装风格在这个季节很流行。
words.en: If something is in vogue, it is very popular and fashionable.

words.tr:
n. 成分；
adj. 构成的；
words.ex: Sugar is a constituent of soda.
words.ex_cn: 糖是苏打水的一种成分。
words.en: A constituent is a part of a whole. In politics, a constituent is a person who is represented by an elected official.

words.ex: He eats cauliflower with dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚餐都吃花椰菜。
words.en: Cauliflower is a large, round, white vegetable that is eaten cooked or raw.

words.tr: v. 使中立；中和；使无效
words.ex: The government tried to neutralize the conflict by talking to both sides.
words.ex_cn: 政府试图通过与双方交谈来使冲突中立化。
words.en: To neutralize something means to stop it from having any effect or to make it ineffective.

words.ex: He eats eggs but watches his cholesterol.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋，但注意自己的胆固醇。
words.en: Cholesterol is a substance that exists in the cells of the body and in blood, which can cause heart disease if there is too much of it.

words.ex: The vendor sells fresh fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这个商贩在市场卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A vendor is a person or company that sells goods or services.

words.ex: The dogs outnumber the cats in this neighborhood.
words.ex_cn: 这个社区里的狗比猫多。
words.en: If one group of people or things outnumbers another, the first group has more people or things in it than the second group.

words.ex: The shopper bought apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这位购物者在市场买了苹果。
words.en: A shopper is a person who is shopping or who is looking to buy goods from stores.

words.ex: He walked down the wide boulevard with many shops.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着满是商店的宽阔大马路散步。
words.en: A boulevard is a wide street in a city, usually with trees along the sides.

words.tr: adj. 种族主义的；种族歧视的；
words.ex: He made a racist comment about immigrants.
words.ex_cn: 他对移民发表了种族主义的言论。
words.en: A racist is someone who believes that people of their own race are superior to those of other races and who behaves in a way that shows this belief.

words.tr: v. 使（尤指不好的情形、体系、信仰）持续、长存；
words.ex: The system perpetuates inequality among the poor.
words.ex_cn: 这个体系使贫困人群的不平等持续存在。
words.en: To perpetuate something means to cause it to continue, especially for a long time.

words.tr: n. 至高无上；最大权力；最高地位；
words.ex: The king claimed supremacy over all other rulers.
words.ex_cn: 国王宣称自己对所有其他统治者拥有至高无上的权力。
words.en: Supremacy is the state or condition of being superior to all others in authority, power, or status.

words.tr:
adj. 激进的；好战的
n. 激进；好战
words.ex: He is a militant who protests every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个每天抗议的激进分子。
words.en: A militant person is someone who is engaged in warfare or combat, or who is aggressively active in a cause.

words.ex: The smell of bread pervades the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 面包的香味弥漫在整个厨房里。
words.en: If something pervades a place or thing, it is present throughout it.

words.ex: At the beginning of the class, the teacher gave us homework.
words.ex_cn: 在课程开始时，老师给我们布置了作业。
words.en: At the start of something; at the point when something starts.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.ex: He took a preparatory course before starting university.
words.ex_cn: 他在上大学之前参加了一个预备课程。
words.en: Preparatory means relating to or done in preparation for something.

words.ex: The apple plummeted from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上垂直落下。
words.en: If an amount, rate, or price plummets, it decreases quickly by a large amount.

words.tr: adj. 固有的；内在的；本身的；
words.ex: Honesty is an intrinsic part of her character.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是她性格中固有的部分。
words.en: belonging to a thing by its very nature

words.ex: He drank water to help his kidney work better.
words.ex_cn: 他喝水以帮助肾脏更好地工作。
words.en: One of the two organs in your lower back that separate waste products from your blood and make urine.

words.ex: The machine purifies water by removing dirt.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器通过去除杂质来净化水。
words.en: To purify something means to make it clean and pure by removing dirty or harmful substances from it.

words.ex: The doctor found a tumor in his lung.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他的肺里发现了一个肿瘤。
words.en: A tumor is a mass of tissue that's formed by an accumulation of abnormal cells. Normally, the cells in your body age, die, and are replaced by new cells. With cancer and other tumors, something disrupts this cycle. Tumor cells grow, even though the body does not need them, and unlike normal old cells, they don't die. As this process goes on, the tumor continues to grow as more and more cells are added to the mass.

words.ex: The problem recurs every week.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题每周都会再次出现。
words.en: If something recurs, it happens again, either once or several times.

words.ex: The poison is lethal to humans.
words.ex_cn: 这种毒药对人类是致命的。
words.en: Something that is lethal can kill people or animals.

words.ex: He pointed at the map with his forefinger.
words.ex_cn: 他用食指指着地图。
words.en: The forefinger is the finger next to the thumb; it is the index finger.

words.ex: The sky began to redden as the sun set.
words.ex_cn: 太阳落山时，天空开始变红。
words.en: To make or become red; to blush.

words.tr: n. 发炎；炎症；燃烧；激动
words.ex: The redness and swelling show inflammation.
words.ex_cn: 发红和肿胀表明有炎症。
words.en: Inflammation is a condition in which a part of your body becomes red, swollen, and painful as a reaction to infection or injury.

words.tr: v. 滑动；“slide”的现在分词； adj. 变化的；
words.ex: The book is sliding off the table.
words.ex_cn: 书正从桌子上滑下来。
words.en: Moving smoothly along a surface or moving gradually from one condition to another.

words.ex: The trucks stop at the depot to load goods.
words.ex_cn: 卡车在仓库停靠以装载货物。
words.en: A depot is a place where large amounts of raw materials, manufactured goods, or equipment are stored until they are needed.

words.tr:
n. 吱吱声；尖叫声
v. 短促而尖厉地叫；吱吱叫
words.ex: The mouse makes a small squeak.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠发出一声小小的吱吱声。
words.en: If something or someone squeaks, they make a short, high-pitched sound.

words.ex: The river suffered from contamination after the factory dumped waste.
words.ex_cn: 工厂倾倒废物后，这条河受到了污染。
words.en: The process of making something dirty or polluted, or the state of being dirty or polluted.

words.tr:
n. 恶臭；难闻气味；吵闹；争吵
v. 发臭；极低劣；不受欢迎
words.ex: The garbage gave off a bad stink.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾散发出一股恶臭。
words.en: To stink means to smell very unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 沙丁鱼；沙丁鱼罐头
words.ex: He ate a sardine for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一条沙丁鱼。
words.en: A small fish that is often canned and eaten as food.

words.tr:
adj. 酸的；辛辣的；尖酸的；刻薄的
n. 甜果馅饼；骚货；妓女
words.ex: The lemon taste is too tart.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬的味道太酸了。
words.en: If something such as fruit is tart, it has a sharp taste. If someone is tart, they are sharp or cutting in their manner or speech.

words.ex: She baked a batch of blueberry muffins.
words.ex_cn: 她烤了一盘蓝莓玛芬。
words.en: A muffin is a small, round, sweet cake, usually with fruit or nuts in it.

words.tr:
n. 污染；腐坏；玷污
v. 污染；使腐坏；玷污
words.ex: The water has a taint from the factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这种水因工厂废料而受到污染。
words.en: If something is tainted, it is affected by something bad or undesirable.

words.tr: v. 逐渐变细；逐渐减少；
words.ex: The candle tapers toward the top.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛向顶部逐渐变细。
words.en: A taper is a long thin candle or a gradual decrease in width or thickness.

words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.tr:
n. 批准；允许；认可；制裁；处罚
v. 批准；认可；制裁；处罚
words.ex: The company got official sanction to open a new branch.
words.ex_cn: 该公司获得了开设新分公司的正式批准。
words.en: A sanction is a penalty for disobeying a law or rule, or an official permission or approval for an action.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: He has a chronic cough that lasts for months.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个持续数月的慢性咳嗽。
words.en: A chronic illness or condition lasts for a long time and cannot be cured, but it can usually be controlled.

words.ex: He had a minor ailment and stayed home from work.
words.ex_cn: 他得了一点小病，没去上班。
words.en: An ailment is a minor illness or health problem.

words.ex: The void on the page made the text look empty.
words.ex_cn: 页面上的空白让文字看起来空荡荡的。
words.en: If you describe a situation or a feeling as a void, you mean that it seems empty because there is nothing interesting or worthwhile about it.

words.tr: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；
words.ex: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱你的信心。
words.en: To undermine something means to weaken it or make it less effective, often in a gradual or sneaky way.

words.ex: The system will validate your password.
words.ex_cn: 系统将验证你的密码。
words.en: To validate something such as a claim or statement means to prove or confirm that it is true or correct.

words.tr: n. 隔离；分离；种族隔离；
words.ex: The school practiced racial segregation in the past.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校过去实行种族隔离。
words.en: Segregation is the policy or practice of separating people of different races, sexes, or religions and treating them in a different way.

words.ex: The Holocaust killed millions of Jews during World War II.
words.ex_cn: 大屠杀在二战期间杀害了数百万犹太人。
words.en: The Holocaust refers to the genocide of European Jews and others by the Nazis during World War II.

words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

chapters.name: Level 9 沟通类动词

words.tr: n. 仔细研究；详细检查；
words.ex: The teacher examined the student's work under close scrutiny.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了仔细研究。
words.en: If someone or something is under scrutiny, they are being studied or observed very carefully.

words.ex: He attests that the document is true.
words.ex_cn: 他证明这份文件是真实的。
words.en: To attest something means to declare or affirm that it is true or genuine, often in a formal or legal context.

words.ex: The validity of the test results is important.
words.ex_cn: 测试结果的有效性很重要。
words.en: The quality of being logically or factually sound; soundness or cogency.

words.ex: The policy helps low-income, socio-economic groups.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策帮助了低收入的社会经济群体。
words.en: Relating to the interaction of social and economic factors.

words.tr: n. 物物交换；实物交易；
words.ex: They used barter to trade apples for eggs.
words.ex_cn: 他们用物物交换的方式用苹果换鸡蛋。
words.en: To trade goods or services without using money.

words.ex: He buys poultry at the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地市场买家禽。
words.en: Poultry refers to domesticated birds kept by humans for their eggs, meat, or feathers.

words.ex: They collaborate to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作完成这个项目。
words.en: to work jointly with others or together especially in an intellectual endeavor

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.ex: His converse was the opposite of what he said earlier.
words.ex_cn: 他的相反言论与他之前说的话相反。
words.en: To engage in conversation; to talk informally with someone.

words.ex: He is the organizer of the school fair.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校集市的组织者。
words.en: An organizer is a person who arranges or plans an event or activity.

words.ex: He sent a malicious email to hurt his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他发了一封怀恶意的邮件来伤害他的朋友。
words.en: If you describe someone's words or actions as malicious, you mean that they are intended to harm people or their reputation, or to cause them embarrassment and upset.

words.ex: The soil degrades over time without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 如果没有适当照料，土壤会逐渐退化。
words.en: If something degrades or is degraded, it becomes worse in quality, or weaker in power or status.

words.tr: n. 广播员；广播公司；节目主持人；电视台
words.ex: The broadcaster announced the news on TV.
words.ex_cn: 广播员在电视上宣布了新闻。
words.en: A broadcaster is a person or organization that transmits programs or information by radio or television.

words.tr: v. 公开指责；告发；揭发
words.ex: He denounces corruption in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中谴责腐败。
words.en: If you denounce a person or an action, you criticize them severely and publicly because you feel strongly that they are wrong or evil.

words.ex: He is a superstar in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球界的超级巨星。
words.en: A superstar is a person who is extremely famous and successful, especially in the entertainment industry.

words.tr: n. 不适合的东西；不适应环境的人
words.ex: That old chair is a misfit in the new room.
words.ex_cn: 那把旧椅子在这个新房间里格格不入。
words.en: A misfit is a person who is not suited to a situation or who does not fit in well with the other people in a group.

words.tr: abbr.abbr. 美国职业棒球大联盟（Major League Baseball）
words.ex: The MLB season is divided into two leagues: the American League and the National League.
words.ex_cn: 美国职业棒球大联盟的赛季分为两个联盟：美国联盟和国家联盟。
words.en: Major League Baseball, the professional baseball organization in the United States and Canada.

words.tr: v. 起绰号；把…称作；配音；译制
words.ex: They dubbed him 'Captain Cool' for his calm style.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他冷静的风格给他起了个绰号叫‘冷静队长’。
words.en: To give a name, title, or nickname to someone or something; to provide a film or television program with a soundtrack in a different language from the original.

words.tr: adj. 没头脑的；愚笨的；不留心的；无谓的
words.ex: He made a mindless mistake during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演示中犯了一个无心的错误。
words.en: If you describe a violent action as mindless, you mean that it is done without thought and will achieve nothing.

words.ex: The boy found an earthworm in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在花园里发现了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: An earthworm is a long, thin creature with no legs that lives in soil and helps to break it down, making it richer for plants to grow in.

words.ex: The manager will empower the team to make decisions.
words.ex_cn: 经理将授权团队做决定。
words.en: To give someone the authority or power to do something.

words.tr: adj. 野蛮的；无人性的；残忍的
words.ex: The prison conditions were inhuman.
words.ex_cn: 监狱的条件十分野蛮。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as inhuman, you mean that they are extremely cruel or unpleasant.

words.ex: The country values its sovereignty.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家重视它的主权。
words.en: Sovereignty is the power that a country has to govern itself or another country or state.

words.ex: The shop tries to entice customers with cheap prices.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店试图以低价吸引顾客。
words.en: If you entice someone, you attract them to a particular place or activity by making it seem attractive or interesting.

words.ex: The meek boy quietly listened to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 那个温顺的男孩静静地听老师讲课。
words.en: If you describe a person as meek, you think that they are gentle and quiet, and likely to do what other people say.

words.tr: n. 恶作剧；开玩笑；戏谑
words.ex: He played a prank on his friend with a fake spider.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个假蜘蛛捉弄了他的朋友。
words.en: A prank is a trick or practical joke that is played on someone, often to make them look foolish or to amuse others.

words.tr: phrase. 对…搞恶作剧；戏弄；捉弄
words.ex: They decided to play a prank on their teacher by hiding his chalk.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定通过藏起老师的粉笔来对他恶作剧。
words.en: To trick someone in a playful way.

words.ex: He lives in the northwestern part of the country.
words.ex_cn: 他住在国家的西北部。
words.en: Northwestern means situated in, directed towards, or facing the northwest, or relating to the northwest part of a place or region.

words.ex: The herald announced the king's arrival.
words.ex_cn: 传令官宣布了国王的到来。
words.en: A herald is someone who carries or proclaims important news; a forerunner or harbinger.

words.ex: He bought a fresh herring at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一条新鲜的青鱼。
words.en: A herring is a long silver-colored fish. Herring live in large groups in the sea.

words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.ex: The president may be impeached for lying.
words.ex_cn: 总统可能因撒谎而被弹劾。
words.en: If a government official is impeached, they are formally charged with a serious crime in a special government court.

words.tr: adj. 琐碎的；微不足道的；心胸狭窄的
words.ex: He got angry over a petty mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一个微不足道的错误生气了。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as petty, you mean that they care too much about small, unimportant things and perhaps that they are unnecessarily unkind.

words.tr: adj. 不可估量的；不可测量的；无限的
words.ex: The love between them is immeasurable.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的爱是无法衡量的。
words.en: If you describe something as immeasurable, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in size or degree.

words.ex: The constable stopped the car for speeding.
words.ex_cn: 警察因超速拦下了那辆车。
words.en: A constable is a police officer of the lowest rank, especially in a town or village.

words.ex: The police will interrogate the suspect tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 警察明天会审问嫌疑人。
words.en: To interrogate someone means to ask them a lot of questions for a long time in order to get information, sometimes using threats.

words.tr: adj. 身份不明的；未知的；未确认的；
words.ex: The police found an unidentified man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 警察在公园附近发现了一名身份不明的男子。
words.en: not recognized or known; not identified

words.ex: He takes the metro to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A metro is an underground railway system in a city.

words.tr: n. 独裁；专政；独裁政府；独裁国家
words.ex: The country suffered under a dictatorship.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家曾遭受独裁统治。
words.en: A dictatorship is a government or a social situation where one person makes all the rules and decisions without input from anyone else.

words.ex: The bully tried to intimidate the new student.
words.ex_cn: 那个霸凌者试图恐吓新生。
words.en: If you intimidate someone, you deliberately make them frightened enough to do what you want them to do.

words.tr:
n. 刻板印象；陈规老套
v. 对…存有成见；把…模式化
words.ex: He broke the stereotype that boys cannot cry.
words.ex_cn: 他打破了男孩不能哭的刻板印象。
words.en: A stereotype is a fixed general image or set of characteristics that a lot of people believe represent a particular type of person or thing.

words.tr: n. 爱国主义；爱国精神；
words.ex: He showed patriotism by serving his country in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在军队中为国家服务表现出爱国主义。
words.en: Patriotism is the love and devotion to one's country.

words.tr:
n. 怪诞行为；
adj. 不正常的；怪异的；
words.ex: His freak of wearing socks with sandals surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他穿袜子配凉鞋的怪诞行为让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A freak is a person who is considered to be unusual because of their behaviour or interests, or a sudden and unexpected event or situation.

words.ex: The child mimics her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If someone or something mimics another person or thing, they try to be like them or copy their behavior or characteristics.

words.tr: v. 影响；“affect”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 染病的；受感动的；
words.ex: The rain affected the game.
words.ex_cn: 雨影响了比赛。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as affected, you disapprove of the fact that they behave in an unnatural way that is intended to impress other people.

words.tr: adj. 不服从的；违背的；不孝的
words.ex: The child was disobedient and refused to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子不听话，拒绝打扫房间。
words.en: If someone is disobedient, they deliberately do not do what someone in authority tells them to do, or what a rule or law says they should do.

words.tr: v. 指错方向；误导；使用不当
words.ex: The instructions were misdirected and led us to the wrong location.
words.ex_cn: 这些指示误导了我们，导致我们去了错误的地方。
words.en: To direct someone or something incorrectly or towards the wrong place or purpose.

words.tr: v. 迷惑；使迷惑不解；使糊涂
words.ex: The magic trick will mystify the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术会让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: If you are mystified by something, you find it impossible to explain or understand.

words.tr: adj. 不连贯的；语无伦次的
words.ex: He was tired and gave an incoherent answer.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，给出了一个混乱的回答。
words.en: If someone is incoherent, they are talking in a confused and unclear way.

words.tr: v. 浸泡；“soak”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The clothes were soaked in water for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 衣服在水里泡了一个小时。
words.en: If something is soaked, it is extremely wet.

words.ex: The widower lives alone with his cat.
words.ex_cn: 这位丧偶的男子独自和猫住在一起。
words.en: A man whose spouse has died and who has not remarried.

words.tr: v. 不断打扰；纠缠；烦扰
words.ex: The child keeps pestering his mom for candy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子不停地缠着妈妈要糖果。
words.en: If you say that someone is pestering you, you mean that they keep asking you to do something, or keep talking to you, and you find this annoying.

words.ex: He wants to publicize his new book.
words.ex_cn: 他想宣传他的新书。
words.en: To publicize something means to make it widely known to the public, especially by using the media.

words.tr: n. 销售规划；商品促销
words.ex: The store manager improved merchandising to sell more clothes.
words.ex_cn: 商店经理改进了销售规划以卖出更多衣服。
words.en: The activity of promoting the sale of goods, especially by their presentation in retail outlets.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.tr: n. 摄影师；照相师；摄影记者
words.ex: The cameraman filmed the wedding yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 摄影师昨天拍摄了婚礼。
words.en: A cameraman is a person whose job is to operate a camera for television or film making.

words.ex: He tried to seduce her with flowers and gifts.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用鲜花和礼物引诱她。
words.en: To seduce someone means to persuade them to do something, especially something wrong or unwise, by making it seem attractive or exciting.

words.ex: The child gave a naive smile when he believed the story.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子相信这个故事时，他露出了天真的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as naïve, you think they lack experience and so expect things to be easy or people to be honest or kind.

words.tr:
v. 冷落；怠慢；不理睬；掐灭
n. 冷落；怠慢
adj. 短平而上翘的
words.ex: He snubbed his friend at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上冷落了朋友。
words.en: To snub someone means to deliberately ignore them or treat them with disrespect, often by refusing to acknowledge their presence or by failing to respond to a greeting or request.

words.ex: He wants to study psychiatry after medical school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在医学院毕业后学习精神病学。
words.en: Psychiatry is the branch of medicine concerned with the study, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental illness.

words.ex: The king's assassination shocked the whole country.
words.ex_cn: 国王的暗杀震惊了整个国家。
words.en: The act of killing someone important or famous, often for political reasons.

words.ex: The loud noise stunned him.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让他震惊了。
words.en: To stun someone means to shock or surprise them very much.

words.ex: He was the discoverer of a new species of frog.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个新蛙种的发现者。
words.en: A discoverer is someone who finds something that was not known before.

words.tr: v. 摘下面纱；揭幕；揭露
words.ex: They will unveil the statue tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将摘下雕像的面纱。
words.en: If someone unveils something such as a new statue or painting, they show it to the public for the first time.

words.ex: The affluent family bought a big house by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这个富裕的家庭在湖边买了一栋大房子。
words.en: Having a great deal of money; wealthy.

chapters.name: Level 9 动作类动词

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.tr: v. 激活；使活动；使活化；
words.ex: Press the button to activate the device.
words.ex_cn: 按下按钮来激活设备。
words.en: If a device or process is activated, it starts working or becomes operational.

words.ex: The generator provides electricity during the power outage.
words.ex_cn: 发电机在停电时提供电力。
words.en: A generator is a machine which produces electricity or another form of energy.

words.ex: The boarder eats dinner with the family.
words.ex_cn: 这个寄宿生和家人一起吃晚饭。
words.en: A boarder is someone who pays to live and receive meals in someone else's house, or a student who lives at school during the term.

words.tr:
v. 嘎吱嘎吱地动；发嘎吱嘎吱声
n. 嘎吱声；艰难局面；危急情况
words.ex: The dog crunches the bone loudly.
words.ex_cn: 狗嘎吱嘎吱地咬着骨头。
words.en: To crunch means to chew noisily with your mouth open, or to make a loud noise like the sound of something being crushed. It can also refer to a critical point or situation, especially in financial contexts.

words.tr:
n. 泡菜；腌菜；腌汁；腌制品；困境
v. 腌制（泡菜等）
words.ex: He put a pickle on his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治上放了一颗酸黄瓜。
words.en: A pickle is a vegetable or fruit that has been preserved in vinegar or salt water, or a difficult situation.

words.tr: n. 摇杆；摇椅；摇滚歌手
words.ex: He spent the evening gently rocking in his favorite rocker.
words.ex_cn: 他整个晚上都在他最喜欢的摇椅上轻轻地摇晃。
words.en: A rocker is a chair mounted on rockers or springs which allows it to move back and forth, or a musician who plays rock music.

words.ex: My granddad walks in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的爷爷每天早上都在公园散步。
words.en: Your granddad is the father of your father or mother.

words.ex: She cuddles her baby every night.
words.ex_cn: 她每天晚上都拥抱她的宝宝。
words.en: To hold someone or something close in your arms as a way of showing love or affection.

words.tr:
n. 人群；一大群；众多
v. 群集；挤满；涌进
words.ex: A throng of people waited outside the store.
words.ex_cn: 一大群人站在商店外面等候。
words.en: A large, densely packed crowd of people or animals.

words.ex: The fence encircles the garden.
words.ex_cn: 围栏围绕着花园。
words.en: To encircle something or someone means to surround them completely.

words.ex: The legislature passed a new law last week.
words.ex_cn: 立法机构上周通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A legislature is the part of a country's government that is responsible for making laws.

words.tr: phrase. 立法机关大楼；议会大厦
words.ex: The legislature building is a significant landmark in the city.
words.ex_cn: 立法机关大楼是该市的一个重要地标。
words.en: A legislature building is a structure where a legislative body, such as a parliament or congress, meets to conduct legislative business, including debating, amending, and passing laws.

words.ex: The thrush sang beautifully in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 鸫在早晨唱得很动听。
words.en: A thrush is a small to medium-sized songbird, known for its melodious song. It can also refer to a fungal infection in the mouth or throat, known as oral thrush.

words.ex: The bird hovers above the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在花上空盘旋。
words.en: To remain in one place in the air, or to stay close to someone or something.

words.ex: The caterpillar is eating leaves on the tree.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫正在树上吃叶子。
words.en: A caterpillar is a small, worm-like animal that eventually develops into a butterfly or moth.

words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.tr: n. 精神病学家；精神科医生
words.ex: He visits a psychiatrist every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去看一次精神科医生。
words.en: A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who specializes in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental illnesses and emotional disorders.

words.tr:
n. 背心；马甲；汗衫
v. 授予；使穿衣
words.ex: He wears a black vest over his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色背心，上面是衬衫。
words.en: A vest is a piece of clothing without sleeves that you wear over a shirt.

words.ex: He quickly jot down the phone number.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙记下了电话号码。
words.en: To write or mark down quickly or briefly.

words.ex: The respondent answered all the questions honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这位调查对象诚实地回答了所有问题。
words.en: A respondent is someone who replies to something such as a survey or set of questions.

words.ex: He ate a chunk of cheese for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一大块奶酪。
words.en: A chunk of something is a large piece or amount of it.

words.ex: She sat munching on a bag of crisps.
words.ex_cn: 她坐着用力咀嚼着一袋薯片。
words.en: If you munch food, you eat it by chewing it slowly and steadily.

words.ex: Eating fruits and vegetables is nutritious.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果和蔬菜是有营养的。
words.en: Nutritious food contains substances which help your body to be healthy.

words.tr:
n. 雄鹿；公羊；雄兔；美元
v. （马等）猛然弓背跃起；抵制
words.ex: The buck ran through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 雄鹿在森林中奔跑。
words.en: A buck is a male deer, antelope, rabbit, or hare. It can also refer to a dollar in American slang. As a verb, it means to jump or to resist something.

words.tr: n. 繁殖；饲养； v. “breed”的现在分词；
words.ex: The farm focuses on cattle breeding.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场专注于牛的繁殖。
words.en: The process of producing animals or plants by sexual reproduction, or the process of raising animals or plants in controlled conditions.

words.ex: The dog gave a small nip to his leg.
words.ex_cn: 狗轻轻咬了他的腿一口。
words.en: To nip means to pinch, squeeze, or bite something quickly and sharply. It can also refer to taking a small amount of a drink.

words.ex: The king was killed by an assassin.
words.ex_cn: 国王被一名刺客杀害了。
words.en: An assassin is a person who murders an important person for political or religious reasons.

words.ex: He held a revolver in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里拿着一把左轮手枪。
words.en: A revolver is a handgun that has a cylinder with several chambers, each capable of holding a cartridge, and that can be fired repeatedly without reloading by rotating the cylinder to align a new chamber with the barrel.

words.tr:
v. 偷看；窥视
n. 偷看；窥见
words.ex: He peeked through the keyhole.
words.ex_cn: 他从钥匙孔里偷看。
words.en: To peek means to look at something quickly and secretly, especially through a small opening or from behind something.

words.tr:
v. 戳；刺；捅
n. 戳；刺；捅
words.ex: He poked the fire with a stick.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子戳了戳火。
words.en: To poke means to prod or jab someone or something with a finger or a pointed object, or to move something in a particular direction with a sharp movement. It can also refer to the act of making a hole or opening in something by pushing a pointed object into it.

words.ex: He picked his tooth with a toothpick.
words.ex_cn: 他用牙签剔牙。
words.en: A toothpick is a small stick of wood, plastic, or other material, pointed at both ends, used for removing food particles from between the teeth.

words.ex: The yolk of the egg is yellow.
words.ex_cn: 鸡蛋的蛋黄是黄色的。
words.en: The yellow part in the middle of an egg.

words.ex: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以便通过考试。
words.en: Used to introduce a clause of purpose or result.

words.tr:
n. 窥探；杠杆；爱打探的人
v. 打听；窥探；用杠杆撬开
words.ex: His pry into my private messages made me angry.
words.ex_cn: 他窥探我的私信让我很生气。
words.en: To try to find out private information about someone or something in a way that is annoying or rude.

words.ex: He picked up some flowers from the roadside.
words.ex_cn: 他从路边摘了一些花。
words.en: The edge of a road, especially a country road, where people can park or walk.

words.ex: He climbed a big boulder near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他爬上了河边的一块大岩石。
words.en: A boulder is a large rounded rock.

words.ex: The actors rehearse their lines every evening.
words.ex_cn: 演员们每天晚上排练他们的台词。
words.en: To rehearse means to practice a play, piece of music, or other work for later public performance.

words.ex: The children love watching animated movies.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢看动画电影。
words.en: Animated means full of life or excitement, or made to appear to move as if by magic or technology.

words.tr: n. 独白；独角戏；长篇大论
words.ex: He gave a monologue on stage.
words.ex_cn: 他在舞台上发表了一段独白。
words.en: A monologue is a long speech by one person, especially in a play or film, or a long speech by one person during a conversation.

words.ex: The bellboy carried the luggage to the room.
words.ex_cn: 行李员把行李搬到了房间。
words.en: A bellboy is a man or boy who works in a hotel, carrying guests' luggage and running errands.

words.tr: v. 折回；追溯；沿原路返回；追想
words.ex: He retraced his steps to find the lost key.
words.ex_cn: 他折回原路寻找丢失的钥匙。
words.en: To go back over the same path or route that one has just taken.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.ex: A blizzard covered the town in snow.
words.ex_cn: 一场暴风雪将整个小镇覆盖在雪中。
words.en: A blizzard is a severe snowstorm with strong winds.

words.tr:
v. 吊起；悬挂；投掷
n. 投掷；悬带
words.ex: The nurse slung the arm in a bandage.
words.ex_cn: 护士用绷带吊起手臂。
words.en: To throw or hurl something with force; to suspend or hang something loosely.

words.ex: The snowball rolled down the hill and got bigger.
words.ex_cn: 雪球滚下山坡，变得越来越大。
words.en: A snowball is a ball of snow pressed together with the hands, often used for throwing in games. As a verb, it means to increase or accumulate at a rapidly accelerating rate.

words.ex: They go out to watch a movie on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末外出看电影。
words.en: To leave a place, especially one's home, for a short time, usually for a specific purpose such as entertainment or socializing.

words.ex: They help each other with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们互相帮助做作业。
words.en: You use each other when you are saying that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.

words.tr:
adj. 乡村的；纯朴的；土气的
n. 乡下人；乡巴佬
words.ex: They live in a rustic cabin near the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一间乡村小屋里。
words.en: Rustic is used to describe things that are typical of the countryside rather than the town, or things that are simple and old-fashioned in a way that is considered typical of the countryside.

words.ex: He is intolerant of people who are late.
words.ex_cn: 他不能容忍迟到的人。
words.en: If you describe someone as intolerant, you mean that they do not accept behavior and opinions that are different from their own.

words.tr:
v. 拍（屁股）
n. 拍打
words.ex: The parent will spank the child for lying.
words.ex_cn: 父母会因为孩子撒谎而打他。
