words.en: To spank someone means to hit them on their bottom with your hand as a punishment.

words.tr: v. 写下；示意； n. 签字；签署（文件等）；签署（文件等） v. 签字(sign的现在分词)；
words.ex: He is signing his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他正在纸上写下自己的名字。
words.en: The act of writing one's name on a document to show that you agree with its contents or that you were the person who wrote or created it.

words.ex: The two countries made a pact to stop fighting.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家达成了一项停止战斗的协议。
words.en: A pact is a formal agreement between two or more people, organizations, or governments to do a particular thing or to help each other.

words.ex: There was a surge in sales during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间销量激增。
words.en: If something surges, it increases suddenly and greatly, after having been steady or only small in size or amount.

words.ex: The hawk made a sudden swoop to catch the mouse.
words.ex_cn: 老鹰突然俯冲下来抓老鼠。
words.en: To move very quickly and easily through the air, especially down from a height in order to attack.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.ex: He caught a big carp in the river.
words.ex_cn: 他在河里钓到了一条大鲤鱼。
words.en: To complain or find fault continually, typically about trivial matters.

words.ex: The children rode a sled down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐着雪橇从积雪的山坡滑下。
words.en: A sled is a vehicle used for traveling over snow and ice, typically consisting of a light frame mounted on runners and often used for recreation or transporting goods.

words.tr:
v. 重击；捶击；发撞击声
n. 重击声；重打
words.ex: He thumped the table with his fist.
words.ex_cn: 他用拳头重击了桌子。
words.en: If you thump something, you hit it hard, usually with your fist.

words.ex: The lamppost stands by the sidewalk.
words.ex_cn: 路灯站在人行道旁。
words.en: A lamppost is a tall post with a light at the top, typically found in streets to provide illumination.

words.ex: He twitched the rope to pull the box closer.
words.ex_cn: 他猛地一拉绳子，把箱子拉近了些。
words.en: To make a sudden, small movement with a part of your body, especially because you are nervous or in pain.

words.tr: n. 一阵剧痛；突然而强烈的情感
words.ex: He felt a pang of guilt after lying.
words.ex_cn: 他说谎后感到一阵内疚。
words.en: A pang is a sudden strong feeling of physical or emotional pain.

words.ex: He hit the ball with his forearm.
words.ex_cn: 他用前臂击中了球。
words.en: The part of the arm between the elbow and the wrist.

words.ex: She wore a showy dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件显眼的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is showy is very noticeable because it is large, colorful, or exaggerated.

words.ex: She unbuttoned her coat and stepped inside.
words.ex_cn: 她解开外套的扣子，走进了屋内。
words.en: to unfasten the buttons of a piece of clothing

words.tr:
adj. 温暖舒适的；紧密的；紧身的；贴身的
n. 酒馆内的雅间
words.ex: The cottage was snug and warm, perfect for a winter retreat.
words.ex_cn: 这间小屋舒适温暖，是冬季度假的完美之地。
words.en: If you feel snug or are in a snug place, you are very warm and comfortable, especially because you are protected from cold or danger.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.ex: He sang a mournful song at the funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他在葬礼上唱了一首悲伤的歌。
words.en: If you are mournful, you are very sad.

words.tr:
n. 猫头鹰叫声；汽笛响声；叫嚣声
v. 作猫头鹰叫声；汽笛等嘟嘟响；大声叫嚣
words.ex: The hoot of an owl echoed through the night.
words.ex_cn: 猫头鹰的叫声在夜晚回荡。
words.en: To make the sound that an owl makes, or to make a similar sound as a signal or in disapproval.

words.tr:
v. 痛哭；嚎啕；尖叫
n. 痛哭；哀号；尖啸
words.ex: The baby wails when she is hungry.
words.ex_cn: 当宝宝饿的时候，她会哭喊。
words.en: To wail means to make a long, high cry, usually because you are in pain or very sad.

chapters.name: Level 9 行为类动词

words.ex: The jet flies at supersonic speed.
words.ex_cn: 这架喷气式飞机以超音速飞行。
words.en: relating to speeds that are faster than the speed of sound

words.ex: He abbreviates the word 'example' as 'ex.'.
words.ex_cn: 他把单词 'example' 缩写为 'ex.'。
words.en: To abbreviate something means to make it shorter, especially by using a particular word or phrase to represent it.

words.tr:
v. 中止；中断；放弃；堕（胎）
n. 中止计划
words.ex: He decided to abort the mission because it was too dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 他决定中止任务，因为太危险了。
words.en: If an unborn baby is aborted, the pregnancy is ended deliberately and the baby is not born alive.

words.ex: The environmentalist plants trees every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这位环保主义者每周末都植树。
words.en: An environmentalist is a person who is concerned with protecting the environment.

words.ex: He affixed a stamp to the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把邮票贴在信封上。
words.en: To attach, fasten, or join something to something else.

words.ex: The government imposed censorship on the news.
words.ex_cn: 政府对新闻实施了审查。
words.en: Censorship is the censoring of books, plays, films, or reports, especially by government officials, because they are considered immoral or secret in some way.

words.tr:
n. 无政府主义者
adj. 信奉无政府主义的
words.ex: He is an anarchist who hates all governments.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名无政府主义者，憎恨所有政府。
words.en: An anarchist is a person who believes in or tries to bring about anarchy.

words.ex: He tried to agitate the workers to strike.
words.ex_cn: 他试图鼓动工人罢工。
words.en: If you agitate something, you stir it up or shake it. If something agitates you, it makes you feel anxious or upset.

words.tr: n. 商业主义；营利主义；重商主义
words.ex: He hates commercialism in movies.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌电影中的商业主义。
words.en: Commercialism is the practices, methods, aims, and spirit of commerce or business.

words.ex: His rude behavior alienated his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的行为使朋友们疏远了他。
words.en: To cause someone to feel isolated or estranged; to transfer the ownership of property to another.

words.ex: He watches tv every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.tr: adj. 无情的；冷酷的；残忍的；
words.ex: The ruthless boss fired employees without warning.
words.ex_cn: 这位无情的老板未经警告就解雇了员工。
words.en: If you say that someone is ruthless, you mean that you disapprove of them because they are very harsh or cruel, and will do anything that is necessary to achieve what they want.

words.ex: The teacher will allot five minutes for questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师会分配五分钟提问。
words.en: If something is allotted to someone, it is given to them as their share.

words.ex: Cleaning the whole house is a laborious task.
words.ex_cn: 打扫整个房子是一项耗时费力的任务。
words.en: If you describe a task or job as laborious, you mean that it takes a lot of time and effort.

words.tr: n. 郡长；行政司法长官；警长；县治安官
words.ex: The sheriff caught the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警长昨晚抓到了小偷。
words.en: A sheriff is an elected official who is responsible for enforcing the law in a county or region.

words.ex: I couldn't apprehend the math lesson because it was too fast.
words.ex_cn: 我无法理解这节数学课，因为讲得太快了。
words.en: If the police apprehend someone, they catch them and arrest them.

words.tr: adj. 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的；
words.ex: He is a notorious thief who stole from many stores.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个声名狼藉的小偷，偷过许多商店。
words.en: Someone or something that is notorious is well known for something bad.

words.ex: The villain stole the treasure from the castle.
words.ex_cn: 坏人从城堡里偷走了宝藏。
words.en: A villain is someone who deliberately harms other people or breaks the law in order to benefit themselves.

words.ex: He was arrested on suspicion of theft.
words.ex_cn: 他因涉嫌盗窃被逮捕。
words.en: If someone is on suspicion of a crime, they are suspected of having committed that crime and are being investigated or have been arrested.

words.ex: He turned his head to avert the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他转过头去避免了事故。
words.en: If you avert something unpleasant, you prevent it from happening.

words.ex: The Tang dynasty was famous for its poetry and art.
words.ex_cn: 唐朝以诗歌和艺术而闻名。
words.en: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

words.ex: The country faced unrest after the election.
words.ex_cn: 选举后，这个国家陷入了动荡。
words.en: A state of dissatisfaction, disturbance, and agitation, typically involving public demonstrations or disorder.

words.tr:
n. 审查员；检查员
v. 检查；审查
words.ex: The censor removed the bad words from the movie.
words.ex_cn: 审查员从电影中删除了粗俗用语。
words.en: A censor is a person who supervises conduct and morals: in particular, one who examines books, films, or other material for objectionable matter.

words.ex: He used a pretext to leave the meeting early.
words.ex_cn: 他找了个借口提前离开了会议。
words.en: A pretext is a false reason that you give for doing something, usually something bad, in order to hide the real reason.

words.ex: His oversight caused the project to fail.
words.ex_cn: 他的疏忽导致项目失败。
words.en: An oversight is a mistake that is made by not noticing something or by forgetting to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 以……为借口；假借……之名
words.ex: He stayed home under the pretext of being sick.
words.ex_cn: 他以生病为借口待在家里。
words.en: If someone does something under the pretext of doing something else, they pretend to be doing that other thing in order to hide their real intentions or actions.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为借口；以…为托词
words.ex: He didn't come to the meeting on the pretext of being sick.
words.ex_cn: 他以生病为借口没有来参加会议。
words.en: If someone does something on the pretext of doing something else, they say they are doing it for one reason, but they are really doing it for a different reason.

words.tr:
n. 法令；判决
v. 判决；颁布；裁定
words.ex: The king issued a decree to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 国王发布了一项法令来停止战争。
words.en: An official order issued by a legal authority.

words.tr: v. 集中；形成中心；中央集权
words.ex: The company will centralize its offices in one city.
words.ex_cn: 公司将会把办公室集中到一个城市。
words.en: To centralize means to bring something under central control or to make something the center of attention or activity.

words.tr: adj. 不合逻辑的；不合理的
words.ex: It is illogical to say the sun is not real.
words.ex_cn: 说太阳不存在是不合逻辑的。
words.en: If you describe an action, feeling, or belief as illogical, you are critical of it because you think that it does not result from a logical and ordered way of thinking.

words.ex: We sat around the bonfire and told stories.
words.ex_cn: 我们围坐在篝火旁讲故事。
words.en: A bonfire is a large outdoor fire, often used for celebration or to dispose of waste.

words.tr:
n. 圣歌；赞美诗；喊叫
v. 吟唱；诵扬；反复叫喊
words.ex: The monks sang a traditional chant during the morning prayer.
words.ex_cn: 修道士们在晨祷时唱了一首传统圣歌。
words.en: A chant is a word or group of words that is repeated over and over again. It can also refer to a simple song, especially one that is sung in a religious service.

words.ex: The grandeur of the palace amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿的宏伟让每个人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The quality of being grand or splendid in appearance or style.

words.ex: The children played on the gravel path.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在砾石小路上玩耍。
words.en: Gravel consists of very small stones. It is often used to make paths and roads.

words.ex: The orange was squeezed into a sweet pulp.
words.ex_cn: 橙子被榨成了甜美的浆状物。
words.en: The soft, wet, shapeless mass of material that is left after the juice has been removed from fruit or vegetables, or the soft inner part of a tooth.

words.tr:
n. 厚木底皮鞋；木屐
v. 堵塞；妨碍
words.ex: She wore wooden clogs to work in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着厚木底皮鞋去花园干活。
words.en: If something clogs a hole or place, it blocks it so that nothing can pass through.

words.tr: n. 下水道；排水沟；缝纫者
words.ex: The sewer smells bad after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，下水道闻起来很难闻。
words.en: A sewer is a large underground channel that carries off waste water and refuse.

words.ex: The townspeople gathered at the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 村民们聚集在广场上参加节日。
words.en: The people living in a particular town or city.

words.ex: They plant trees to commemorate the fallen soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 他们种树以纪念阵亡的士兵。
words.en: To commemorate an important event or person means to remember them by means of a special action, ceremony, or specially created object.

words.tr:
n. 半身像；胸部；搜捕
v. 打碎；搜捕
adj. 破产的；打碎的
words.ex: The museum has a marble bust of the ancient king.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一座古代国王的大理石半身像。
words.en: A bust is a sculpture of a person's head, shoulders, and chest. As a verb, to bust means to break something, to arrest someone, or to go bankrupt.

words.tr: n. 忠诚支持者；拥护现政权者
words.ex: The loyalist supported the king during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这位保皇派在战争期间支持国王。
words.en: A loyalist is someone who remains loyal to the established ruler or government, especially in the face of a revolt.

words.ex: The strange noise confounded the children.
words.ex_cn: 奇怪的声音让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: To confuse and surprise someone, especially by being difficult to understand or deal with.

words.ex: The deceptive smile hid his true intentions.
words.ex_cn: 那欺骗性的微笑隐藏了他真正的意图。
words.en: If something is deceptive, it encourages you to believe something which is not true.

words.ex: He is a hypocrite because he says he loves peace but fights often.
words.ex_cn: 他是个伪君子，因为他声称热爱和平，却经常打架。
words.en: A hypocrite is someone who pretends to have certain beliefs or opinions that they do not really have, especially in order to deceive people.

words.tr: n. 便利设施；舒适条件；公共设施；
words.ex: The apartment has good amenities like a gym and a swimming pool.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓有健身房和游泳池等便利设施。
words.en: An amenity is something that makes a place more pleasant or comfortable to live in.

words.ex: He likes to dabble in various hobbies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢涉猎各种爱好。
words.en: If you dabble in something, you take part in it but not very seriously.

words.ex: He plays billiards every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打台球。
words.en: Billiards is a game played on a large table, in which you use a long stick called a cue to hit balls against each other and into pockets around the edge of the table.

words.ex: Her stepmother gave her a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 她的继母送了她一份生日礼物。
words.en: A stepmother is a woman who is married to one's father after the divorce or death of one's mother.

words.tr:
v. 织补
n. 织补
words.ex: She darned her socks with blue thread.
words.ex_cn: 她用蓝色线织补了她的袜子。
words.en: To darn means to repair a hole in a piece of clothing by sewing stitches across the hole.

words.tr:
n. 之字形；锯齿形；
adj. 之字形的；曲折的；锯齿形的；
words.ex: The road makes a zigzag up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这条路沿着山呈之字形向上延伸。
words.en: A zigzag is a line that has a series of angles in it, like a continuous series of 'W's. It can also describe a path or route that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

words.ex: The knife left a nick on the wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 刀在木桌上留下了一道刻痕。
words.en: A nick is a small cut or notch in a surface or edge. As a verb, to nick means to make a small cut or notch in something, or to steal something.

words.tr: adj. 延长的；扩大范围的；延伸的；
words.ex: The meeting was extended by thirty minutes.
words.ex_cn: 会议被延长了三十分钟。
words.en: Made larger or longer than usual.

words.ex: He deducts tax from his salary every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每月从工资中扣除税款。
words.en: If you deduct an amount from a total, you subtract it from the total.

words.ex: The tuition for this course is $500.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学费是500美元。
words.en: Tuition is the fee charged for instruction, especially at a college, university, or private school.

words.ex: The loading of the cargo took three hours.
words.ex_cn: 货物的装载花了三个小时。
words.en: The process of loading something, especially data or cargo, onto a vehicle, ship, or computer system.

words.ex: The heat made the metal deform.
words.ex_cn: 热量使金属变形。
words.en: To deform something means to change its shape, usually in a way that makes it less attractive or useful.

words.tr: 短语，表示“……的年数”或“多年的……”，常用于描述时间跨度或经验积累
words.ex: He has years of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有多年的英语教学经验。
words.en: A period of time spanning multiple years.

words.ex: The police will detain the suspect for questioning.
words.ex_cn: 警察将扣留嫌疑人进行审问。
words.en: If someone is detained, they are officially held in a place, especially a prison, and are not allowed to leave.

words.ex: He hired a solicitor to help with his house sale.
words.ex_cn: 他聘请了一名事务律师来帮助处理他的房屋出售。
words.en: A solicitor is a lawyer who gives legal advice and prepares legal documents, especially in England.

words.ex: He used cocaine last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚用了可卡因。
words.en: A drug obtained from the leaves of the coca plant, used as a local anesthetic and also illegally as a stimulant.

words.ex: He felt insecurity when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 当他失去工作时，他感到不安全感。
words.en: Insecurity is a feeling of uncertainty or anxiety about oneself or one's situation.

words.ex: The high fine will deter people from breaking the law.
words.ex_cn: 高额罚款会制止人们违法。
words.en: If something deters you from doing something, it makes you not want to do it or continue doing it.

words.ex: The heiress inherited a large fortune from her grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 这位女继承人从她祖父那里继承了一大笔财富。
words.en: A woman who is legally entitled to inherit property or a title from someone who has died.

words.ex: He bought a luxury car as an extravagance.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆豪华汽车作为奢侈品。
words.en: Extravagance refers to the spending of more money than is reasonable or than you can afford, or the use of more of something than is necessary.

words.ex: The contestant won the singing competition.
words.ex_cn: 这位竞争者赢得了歌唱比赛。
words.en: A contestant is someone who takes part in a competition or contest.

words.ex: The country tried to devalue its currency.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家试图使本国货币贬值。
words.en: If you devalue something, you cause it to be thought less impressive or less deserving of respect.

words.tr:
adj. 无数的；
n. 无数；
words.ex: There are myriad stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数的星星。
words.en: A myriad of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.tr:
v. 弥漫；
adj. 分散的；
words.ex: Smoke began to diffuse through the room.
words.ex_cn: 烟开始弥漫在整个房间里。
words.en: If something such as knowledge or information is diffused, or if it diffuses, it is made known over a wide area or to a lot of people.

words.ex: Carbon dioxide makes the air warm.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化碳使空气变暖。
words.en: A compound containing two atoms of oxygen combined with another element or group.

words.tr: phrase. 发达国家；指经济、技术和社会发展水平较高的国家
words.ex: Developed countries have better hospitals and schools.
words.ex_cn: 发达国家有更好的医院和学校。
words.en: Countries that have a high level of economic development and standard of living.

words.tr:
v. 稀释
adj. 经稀释的
words.ex: He dilutes the juice with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水稀释果汁。
words.en: To dilute a liquid means to make it thinner or weaker by adding water or another liquid to it.

words.ex: He eats porridge for breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃粥。
words.en: A type of food made by boiling oats or another cereal in water or milk.

words.ex: He pushed the trolley to carry the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他推着手推车来搬购物品。
words.en: A trolley is a small vehicle with wheels that can be pushed or pulled along and is used for carrying things.

words.ex: He disconnects the cable from the TV.
words.ex_cn: 他把电缆从电视上拔掉。
words.en: To disconnect something means to separate it from something else to which it is attached or connected.

words.tr:
n. 高地；山地；
adj. 高地的；山地的；
words.ex: The farmers live on the upland near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 农民们住在山边的高地上。
words.en: Upland refers to an area of high or hilly land.

words.ex: The air conditioner keeps the room cool.
words.ex_cn: 空调使房间保持凉爽。
words.en: A conditioner is a substance that you put on your hair after you have washed it to make it softer.

words.tr: v. 损毁…的外形；使变丑
words.ex: The accident disfigured his face.
words.ex_cn: 那次事故使他的脸变形了。
words.en: To disfigure someone or something means to spoil their appearance.

words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.tr: v. 蒸馏；用蒸馏法提取；蒸馏出；提炼
words.ex: They distill water to remove impurities.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过蒸馏去除水中的杂质。
words.en: To distill a liquid means to purify it by heating it until it becomes a gas and then cooling it so that it becomes a liquid again. This process can also be used to extract the essential elements or meanings from something.

words.ex: The prohibition of smoking in public places improved air quality.
words.ex_cn: 在公共场所禁止吸烟改善了空气质量。
words.en: Prohibition is the act of forbidding something, especially by law.

words.ex: The tribunal decided the case quickly.
words.ex_cn: 法庭迅速作出了裁决。
words.en: A tribunal is a special court or committee that is officially chosen to examine a particular problem or situation.

words.ex: The two roads diverge after the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 两条路在桥后分岔。
words.en: If one thing diverges from another similar thing, the first thing becomes different from the second or develops differently from it. You can also say that two things diverge.

words.ex: The jury gave a guilty verdict.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团作出了有罪裁决。
words.en: A verdict is a decision made after a lot of consideration, especially one made by a jury in a court of law.

words.tr:
v. 做实习生；扣留
n. 实习生
words.ex: He is interning at a hospital this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天在医院做实习生。
words.en: An intern is someone who works in a temporary position with an emphasis on on-the-job training rather than merely employment, often to gain experience in a particular field.

words.ex: He dozed off during the boring meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的会议上打起了瞌睡。
words.en: To doze means to sleep lightly or for a short period.

words.tr: n. 间歇；暂停；中间休息
words.ex: There is a ten-minute intermission during the play.
words.ex_cn: 这场戏中间有十分钟的中场休息。
words.en: An intermission is a short break between parts of a play, film, concert, or other performance.

words.ex: The teacher will enlighten the students about the truth.
words.ex_cn: 老师将向学生们阐明真相。
words.en: To enlighten someone means to give them more knowledge and greater understanding about something.

words.ex: The sinner asked for forgiveness.
words.ex_cn: 这个罪人请求宽恕。
words.en: A sinner is a person who commits sin or has committed sin, especially one who is not repentant.

words.ex: He reads scripture every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读经文。
words.en: The sacred writings of a religion; often used to refer to the Bible.

words.tr: adj. 漠不关心的；懵然不知的；感觉迟钝的
words.ex: He was insensitive to her feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的感受漠不关心。
words.en: If you describe someone as insensitive, you are criticizing them for being unaware of or unsympathetic to other people's feelings.

words.ex: He said it with sarcasm, even though he seemed happy.
words.ex_cn: 他说这话时带着讽刺，尽管他看起来很高兴。
words.en: Sarcasm is a sharp, bitter, or cutting expression or remark; a bitter gibe or taunt.

words.ex: The unfair rule enrage him.
words.ex_cn: 不公平的规则激怒了他。
words.en: To make someone extremely angry.

words.ex: My stepfather bought me a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 我的继父给我买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: A stepfather is a man who is married to someone's mother but who is not their biological father.

words.ex: She entrusted her keys to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她把钥匙托付给了朋友。
words.en: If you entrust something important to someone or entrust them with it, you give them the responsibility of looking after it or dealing with it.

words.ex: The caretaker cleans the building every day.
words.ex_cn: 看管人每天打扫这座大楼。
words.en: A caretaker is a person whose job is to look after a large building such as a school or a block of flats or apartments, and deal with small repairs to it.

words.tr: n. 固定物；固定装置；固定成员
words.ex: The shelf is a fixture in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 这个架子是厨房里的固定物。
words.en: A fixture is a piece of equipment or furniture which is fixed in position in a building or vehicle.

words.ex: The police told everyone to evacuate the building.
words.ex_cn: 警察让所有人撤离大楼。
words.en: To evacuate means to remove people from a place of danger to a safer place.

words.ex: The occupant of the room is sleeping.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的住户正在睡觉。
words.en: An occupant is someone who lives in or uses a particular room, building, or area of land.

words.ex: Applications arrived in an avalanche after the job posting.
words.ex_cn: 职位发布后，申请纷至沓来。
words.en: An avalanche is a large mass of snow, ice, and rocks that falls quickly down the side of a mountain.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: He tried to evade the police by driving fast.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过高速驾驶来逃避警察。
words.en: If you evade something, you find a way of not doing something that you really ought to do.

words.tr: n. 简介；情况介绍会； v. “brief”的现在分词；
words.ex: The manager gave a briefing before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议前，经理做了一个简介。
words.en: A briefing is a meeting in which people are given information or instructions.

words.tr: n. 解雇；活动停止期间
words.ex: He got a layoff last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月被裁员了。
words.en: A layoff is the termination of employment of an employee or, more commonly, a group of employees for business reasons, such as the decision of the company to downsize its operations.

words.ex: He smokes marijuana on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末吸大麻。
words.en: A drug made from the dried leaves and flowers of the hemp plant, which is smoked or eaten to induce euphoria.

words.ex: The injury impaired his ability to walk.
words.ex_cn: 这次受伤损害了他走路的能力。
words.en: If something impairs something such as an ability or the way something works, it damages it or makes it worse.

words.tr: adj. 厚脸皮的；鲁莽放肆的；大胆无礼的
words.ex: He gave a cheeky smile when he got caught.
words.ex_cn: 他被抓到时露出了调皮的微笑。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as cheeky, you mean that they are slightly rude or disrespectful but in a charming or amusing way.

words.ex: The noise infuriates my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 噪音让我的邻居非常生气。
words.en: To make someone extremely angry.

words.ex: She became the godmother of her best friend's child.
words.ex_cn: 她成为了她最好朋友孩子的教母。
words.en: A godmother is a woman who is chosen by the parents of a child to take an interest in the child's upbringing and personal development, often involving a religious context.

words.ex: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the river.
words.ex_cn: 农民用河里的水灌溉他们的田地。
words.en: To supply land or crops with water by means of channels or pipes.

words.ex: The sheep graze on the heath.
words.ex_cn: 羊在荒地上吃草。
words.en: A heath is an area of open land covered with rough grass or heather and with very few trees or bushes.

words.ex: He cooked beet soup for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他为晚餐煮了甜菜汤。
words.en: A beet is a plant with a round dark red root that is eaten as a vegetable.

words.tr: adj. 资源丰富的；机敏的；足智多谋的
words.ex: He is a resourceful man who can fix anything with little material.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个资源丰富的男人，能用很少的材料修好任何东西。
words.en: If someone is resourceful, they are good at finding ways of dealing with problems.

words.ex: She tries to juggle her job and caring for her kids.
words.ex_cn: 她努力兼顾工作和照顾孩子。
words.en: If you juggle, you keep several objects in motion in the air at the same time by repeatedly throwing and catching them. Juggle can also mean to deal with several things at the same time, often in a skillful way.

words.ex: My sibling plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的兄弟/姐妹每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A sibling is a brother or sister.

words.tr: adj. 需氧的；好氧的；有氧的；
words.ex: Running is an aerobic exercise.
words.ex_cn: 跑步是有氧运动。
words.en: Aerobic exercise is physical exercise of relatively low intensity that depends primarily on the aerobic energy-generating process.

words.tr: adj. 可爱的；讨人喜欢的
words.ex: The puppy is adorable.
words.ex_cn: 这只小狗很可爱。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is adorable, you are emphasizing that they are very attractive and you feel great affection for them.

words.tr: v. 点燃；生火；激起；发亮
words.ex: He used a match to kindle the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他用火柴点燃了火。
words.en: To kindle something means to cause it to begin burning or to arouse or inspire it.

words.ex: The bomber flew over the city at night.
words.ex_cn: 轰炸机在夜间飞越了这座城市。
words.en: A bomber is a military aircraft designed to carry and drop bombs.

words.tr: v. 使限制于局部；定位
words.ex: The virus can localize in the lungs.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒可以限制在肺部。
words.en: To localize something means to adapt it to a particular area or market, often by translating it into the local language or modifying it to suit local customs and preferences.

words.ex: The soldiers walked across the battlefield.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们走过战场。
words.en: A battlefield is a place where a battle is fought.

words.tr: v. 使发狂；使发疯；使发怒
words.ex: The loud noise madden him.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让他发狂。
words.en: To make someone extremely angry or annoyed.

words.tr: n. （棒球的）一局；（荒地等的）围垦；执政期；轮到显身手的机会
words.ex: He pitched a perfect inning in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中投出了一场完美的一局。
words.en: An inning is a division of a game during which one team has a turn to bat and score runs, especially in baseball or cricket.

words.ex: He reads the tabloid every morning on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在公交车上读通俗小报。
words.en: A tabloid is a newspaper with small pages, usually with many pictures and short, simple reports on news events, often about famous people.

words.tr: adj. 无防备的；无防御能力的
words.ex: The defenseless child cried for help.
words.ex_cn: 这个毫无防备的孩子哭着求救。
words.en: If someone or something is defenseless, they are weak and unable to protect themselves from attack or harm.

words.tr: phrase. 击昏；淘汰；使失去知觉；使筋疲力尽；使震惊 adj. 令人震惊的；杰出的 n. 淘汰赛；击倒；令人惊艳的人或事物
words.ex: The punch knocked him out.
words.ex_cn: 这一拳把他打晕了。
words.en: To defeat an opponent by knocking them unconscious or rendering them unable to continue.

words.ex: He tried to manipulate the results to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他试图操纵结果来赢得比赛。
words.en: To manipulate something means to handle or control it skillfully, often in a way that is considered unfair or dishonest.

words.ex: The subcommittee met to discuss the budget.
words.ex_cn: 小组委员会开会讨论预算。
words.en: A subcommittee is a smaller committee formed from a main committee to concentrate on a specific task or area.

words.tr: phrase. 搁置一项法案（指暂时不进行审议或表决）
words.ex: The government decided to shelve a bill because people did not agree with it.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定搁置一项法案，因为人们不同意。
words.en: To postpone consideration of a bill or proposal indefinitely.

words.tr:
n. 编年史；年代记
v. 按时间顺序记录
words.ex: He writes a chronicle of his daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他记录自己每天的生活。
words.en: A chronicle is a historical account of events arranged in chronological order, typically without analysis or interpretation.

words.tr:
n. 异教徒；无宗教信仰者
adj. 异教的；异教徒的；无宗教信仰的
words.ex: He lived in a pagan village long ago.
words.ex_cn: 他很久以前住在一个异教村庄里。
words.en: A pagan is someone who worships many gods or no god, especially one who belongs to a religion that existed before Christianity.

words.tr:
v. 屠杀 
n. 大屠杀
words.ex: The soldiers committed a massacre in the village.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在村庄里进行了大屠杀。
words.en: The indiscriminate killing of a large number of people.

words.ex: The unification of the two countries brought peace.
words.ex_cn: 两个国家的统一带来了和平。
words.en: The process of making or becoming a single unit.

words.tr: v. 使增加至最大限度；最大化；
words.ex: He tries to maximize his profit by selling more.
words.ex_cn: 他通过多卖东西来使利润达到最大。
words.en: To maximize something means to make it as great in amount, size, or importance as possible.

words.ex: He got an exemption from paying the fee.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了免交费用的豁免。
words.en: An exemption is an official permission not to do something or not to pay something that you would normally have to do or pay.

words.tr:
v. 滥用；误用；虐待
n. 滥用；误用；虐待
words.ex: He misuses his phone during class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时滥用手机。
words.en: The incorrect or improper use of something.

words.ex: Farmers use pesticide to kill insects on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的昆虫。
words.en: A pesticide is a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects, that damage crops or are harmful to human health.

words.ex: The robin sang loudly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 知更鸟在早晨大声歌唱。
words.en: A small bird with a red breast, known for its melodious song.

words.tr:
n. （军队的）团；大群；大量
v. 把...编组；严格管制
words.ex: He joined the army and was in a regiment.
words.ex_cn: 他参军了，被编入一个团。
words.en: A regiment is a large group of soldiers that is commanded by a colonel.

words.ex: The government will mobilize troops to help after the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 政府将调动军队在地震后提供帮助。
words.en: If you mobilize a group of people, or if they mobilize, they prepare to take action, especially in a military context.

words.ex: The big company tries to monopolize the market.
words.ex_cn: 这家大公司试图垄断市场。
words.en: If a company or person monopolizes something, they have complete control over it, so that other people cannot share it.

words.ex: The car runs on petroleum.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车使用石油运行。
words.en: A naturally occurring, yellow-to-black liquid found in geological formations beneath the Earth's surface, which is commonly refined into various types of fuels.

words.ex: Her performance was phenomenal.
words.ex_cn: 她的表现非常非凡。
words.en: If you describe something as phenomenal, you think it is extremely good or impressive.

words.tr:
n. 旷野地；荒野；高沼
v. （使）停泊；系泊
words.ex: The sheep graze on the moor near the village.
words.ex_cn: 羊在村庄附近的旷野地上吃草。
words.en: A moor is an area of open land, often with poor soil, that is covered with grass, heather, and low bushes. It can also refer to the act of securing a ship or boat to a fixed object or the land.

words.ex: The steamboat moved slowly on the river.
words.ex_cn: 蒸汽船在河上缓慢行驶。
words.en: A steamboat is a boat that is propelled by a steam engine, especially a paddle-wheel craft of a type used widely on rivers in the 19th century.

words.tr: adj. 朦胧的；模糊的；不清楚的
words.ex: The sky looks hazy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上天空看起来雾蒙蒙的。
words.en: If it is hazy, it is not clear because there is a lot of mist, smoke, or dust in the air.

words.ex: The gravestone was engraved with the deceased's name and dates.
words.ex_cn: 墓碑上刻着逝者的名字和日期。
words.en: A gravestone is a large stone with words carved into it, which is placed where someone is buried.

words.ex: The fallen tree obstructs the road.
words.ex_cn: 倒下的树挡住了道路。
words.en: If something obstructs a road or path, it blocks it, stopping people or vehicles from getting past.

words.ex: The children walked carefully through the bog.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们小心地走过沼泽。
words.en: A bog is an area of wet muddy ground that is too soft to support a heavy body.

words.ex: He opted to stay home instead of going out.
words.ex_cn: 他选择待在家里而不是出去。
words.en: If you opt for something, or opt to do something, you choose it or decide to do it in preference to anything else.

words.ex: He is a renowned scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有名的科学家。
words.en: Known or talked about by many people; famous.

words.ex: He enjoys recreational activities like swimming and hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢游泳和徒步等娱乐活动。
words.en: Relating to or denoting activity done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.ex: Both my mother and my father are teachers.
words.ex_cn: 我的妈妈和爸爸都是老师。
words.en: Used to emphasize that each of two things is true or happens, often to stress the inclusion of both items or ideas.

words.tr: n. 审计员；（大学课程的）旁听生；（一名）听众
words.ex: The auditor checked the company's money records.
words.ex_cn: 审计员检查了公司的财务记录。
words.en: An auditor is a person whose job is to carry out an official examination of the accounts of a business and to produce a report.

words.ex: He overestimated his ability to finish the task in one day.
words.ex_cn: 他过高估计了自己一天内完成任务的能力。
words.en: If you overestimate something, you think it is greater in amount or more important than it really is.

words.ex: The duchess walks in the garden every morning.
words.ex_cn: 公爵夫人每天早上都在花园里散步。
words.en: A duchess is the wife or widow of a duke, or a woman who holds the rank of duke in her own right.

words.ex: The superintendent of the school is very strict.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主管非常严格。
words.en: A superintendent is a person who is in charge of a particular department or activity, especially within a school, housing project, or police force.

words.ex: The manager oversees the team's daily work.
words.ex_cn: 经理监督团队的日常工作。
words.en: To oversee means to watch and direct a piece of work, the people doing it, or the way it is done in order to ensure that it is done correctly.

words.tr: n. 纺纱机；纺纱工；转盘
words.ex: The spinner turned wool into thread.
words.ex_cn: 这台纺纱机将羊毛纺成线。
words.en: A spinner is a person or machine that spins wool, cotton, or other material into thread or yarn.

words.ex: He reluctantly agreed to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他不情愿地同意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If you do something reluctantly, you do it unwillingly.

words.ex: He persevered despite many failures.
words.ex_cn: 尽管多次失败，他仍然坚持不懈。
words.en: If you persevere with something, you keep trying to do it and do not give up, even though it is difficult.

words.ex: He has diabetes and must check his blood every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有糖尿病，必须每天检查血糖。
words.en: A medical condition in which the body cannot produce enough insulin or cannot use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.ex: The GPS can pinpoint your exact location.
words.ex_cn: GPS可以精准定位你的准确位置。
words.en: To pinpoint something means to locate or identify it precisely.

words.ex: The extinction of dinosaurs happened millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的灭绝发生在数百万年前。
words.en: The state or process of a species, family, or larger group being or becoming extinct.

words.ex: He is an emigrant from China.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名来自中国的移民。
words.en: An emigrant is a person who leaves their own country to live permanently in another country.

words.tr:
n. 一层；一股；厚度
v. 定期往返；不断做；不断供应
words.ex: The plywood has three plies.
words.ex_cn: 胶合板有三层。
words.en: To ply a trade or profession means to work at it regularly. If a ship or boat plies between two places, it makes regular journeys between them.

words.tr:
n. 排水沟；阴沟；贫民区
v. 忽明忽暗；摇曳不定
words.ex: The rain water flows down the gutter.
words.ex_cn: 雨水沿着排水沟流下。
words.en: A gutter is a channel at the edge of a road or roof that collects and directs rainwater away.

words.tr: adj. 令人讨厌的；极糟的
words.ex: The weather today is horrid.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很糟糕。
words.en: If you describe something as horrid, you mean that it is very unpleasant or disagreeable.

words.tr:
n. 嘈杂声；喧闹声
v. 喧闹；喋喋不休地说
words.ex: The children made a loud din in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在教室里发出很大的嘈杂声。
words.en: A din is a loud, unpleasant, and prolonged noise.

words.tr: v. 加标点于；强调；不时打断
words.ex: She punctuates her sentences with commas.
words.ex_cn: 她用逗号给句子加标点。
words.en: To punctuate means to add punctuation marks to text in order to clarify meaning and separate structural units. It can also mean to interrupt or emphasize something at intervals.

words.tr: adj. 有特权的； v. “privilege”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a privileged student who gets free books.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有特权的学生，能免费获得书籍。
words.en: Having special rights, advantages, or immunities.

words.tr:
v. 净化；清除；清洗；整肃
n. 净化；清除；泻药
words.ex: The company purged its outdated systems.
words.ex_cn: 公司净化了其过时的系统。
words.en: To purge an organization or place of something or someone means to remove them from it because they are considered undesirable or harmful.

words.ex: He loves his fatherland deeply.
words.ex_cn: 他深深地热爱自己的祖国。
words.en: Your fatherland is the country where you or your ancestors were born and to which you feel a strong sense of belonging.

words.ex: The aggressor attacked the small village.
words.ex_cn: 侵略者袭击了那个小村庄。
words.en: An aggressor is a person, group, or country that starts a fight or war by attacking first.

words.tr:
v. 毁坏；破坏；劫掠
n. 破坏；蹂躏
words.ex: The storm ravaged the small village.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了这个小村庄。
words.en: To ravage means to cause severe and extensive damage to something.

words.tr: v. 重新排列；重新安排
words.ex: He rearranged the books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书架上的书重新排列了。
words.en: If you rearrange the objects in a place, you change the way in which they are organized or positioned.

words.tr:
n. 划分；隔离物；分割
v. 分开；隔开
words.ex: The partition of the room made it more private.
words.ex_cn: 房间的隔断让它更私密了。
words.en: A partition is a wall, screen, or divider that separates one part of a room, vehicle, or other space from another.

words.tr:
v. 指责；斥责
n. 指责；谴责
words.ex: The teacher gave him a rebuke for talking in class.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为他上课讲话而责备了他。
words.en: If you rebuke someone, you speak severely to them because they have said or done something that you do not approve of.

words.tr:
n. 司机
v. 为…当司机
words.ex: The chauffeur drove the boss to the office.
words.ex_cn: 司机载着老板去办公室。
words.en: A chauffeur is a person employed to drive a private or hired car.

words.tr: adj. 与好的品味相悖的；不合礼节的；下流的；有伤风化的
words.ex: He wore an indecent shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件不雅的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something as indecent, you mean that it is shocking or offensive, usually because it relates to sex or nakedness.

words.ex: The squad practices every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个小组每天早上训练。
words.en: A squad is a small group of people organized for a particular purpose or task.

words.ex: The pickup is at 7 PM outside the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 接人时间是晚上7点，在酒店外面。
words.en: A pickup is an improvement or recovery, especially in business or health. It can also refer to the act of collecting someone or something, or a small truck with an open back.

words.tr: v. 重获；夺回；收复；回想
words.ex: He tried to recapture his childhood joy.
words.ex_cn: 他试图重新捕捉童年的快乐。
words.en: To recapture something means to catch it again after it has escaped or been lost, or to experience again a feeling or situation that you had in the past.

words.ex: He will rectify the mistake tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会纠正这个错误。
words.en: If you rectify something that is wrong, you change it so that it becomes correct or satisfactory.

words.tr: n. 保证；保修单；保证书
words.ex: The phone comes with a one-year warranty.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一年的保修期。
words.en: A warranty is a written guarantee, often given to the purchaser of an article by its manufacturer, promising to repair or replace it if necessary within a specified period of time.

words.ex: He set the thermostat to 22 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 他把恒温器调到了22度。
words.en: A thermostat is a device that automatically regulates temperature, or that activates a device when the temperature reaches a certain point.

words.tr: v. 弥补；兑换；付清；赎回；履行
words.ex: He worked hard to redeem his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作来弥补自己的错误。
words.en: To redeem something means to get it back by paying a sum of money or by doing something to compensate for a fault or mistake.

words.ex: Smoking is harmful to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that is harmful has a bad effect on something else, especially on a person's health.

words.tr:
adj. 盛开的；旺盛的；非常的
v. 开花；“bloom”的现在分词
words.ex: The flowers are blooming in spring.
words.ex_cn: 花在春天盛开。
words.en: If something is described as blooming, it is growing or developing in a healthy and vigorous way, especially with reference to plants.

words.ex: He is late for school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都上学迟到。
words.en: To arrive somewhere after the expected or usual time.

words.tr: n. 领取退休、养老金或抚恤金的人；
words.ex: The pensioner walks his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位领取养老金的人每天早上都遛狗。
words.en: A pensioner is someone who receives a pension, especially a retirement pension.

words.tr:
v. 重新进入
n. 重进入
words.ex: After a brief break, she reentered the room.
words.ex_cn: 短暂的休息后，她再次进入了房间。
words.en: To enter again.

words.ex: He works in a lab that uses biotechnology.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个使用生物技术的实验室工作。
words.en: Biotechnology is the use of living cells and bacteria in industrial and scientific processes.

words.ex: They tried to re-establish peace after the war.
words.ex_cn: 他们试图在战争后重新建立和平。
words.en: To establish again or anew; to restore to a previous state.

words.tr:
adj. 战前的
adv. 在战前
words.ex: The house was built in the prewar era.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子建于战前时期。
words.en: Existing or occurring before a war, especially the Second World War.

words.tr: n. 教区；堂区；行政小区；
words.ex: The priest serves in a small parish.
words.ex_cn: 牧师在一个小教区服务。
words.en: A parish is a small administrative district typically having its own church and a priest or pastor.

words.tr: v. 声明放弃；与...断绝关系
words.ex: He renounced his citizenship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年放弃了国籍。
words.en: If you renounce a belief or a way of behaving, you say and show that you no longer hold that belief or will behave in that way.

words.ex: He felt tired after the exertion of running up the hill.
words.ex_cn: 在努力跑上山后，他感到很累。
words.en: The use of physical or mental energy; hard work.

words.tr: adj. 可辩解的；可证明为正当的；有理的
words.ex: His action was justifiable because he protected his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为是合理的，因为他保护了他的朋友。
words.en: If something is justifiable, there is a good reason for it.

words.tr: adj. 轻松愉快的；无忧无虑的；随便的；漫不经心的
words.ex: He gave a lighthearted laugh during the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上开心地笑了。
words.en: If someone is lighthearted, they are cheerful and happy.

words.tr:
n. 说笑；玩笑
v. 开玩笑
words.ex: He likes to jest with his friends during lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在午餐时和朋友开玩笑。
words.en: A jest is a remark that is intended to be amusing or funny, especially one that is made in a light-hearted or teasing manner.

words.ex: He tried to repress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: If you repress a feeling, you deliberately do not express it, often because it is considered unacceptable or inappropriate.

words.ex: He went back to retrieve his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他回去取回他的钥匙。
words.en: To retrieve something means to get it back from somewhere, especially after it has been lost or taken away.

words.ex: The store made an inventory of all the products.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有商品做了一份清单。
words.en: An inventory is a detailed list of all the items in a place.

words.ex: He spends weekends doing woodwork in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他周末在车库里做木工活。
words.en: The activity or skill of making things from wood.

words.tr: adv. 公认地；普遍承认地；诚然；
words.ex: Admittedly, he is not the best player, but he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 公认地，他不是最好的球员，但他很努力。
words.en: Used to express that you accept something is true or that you agree with it, even though you may not like it.

words.tr:
n. 索具装备；钻探设备；装备
v. 配备索具；操纵；舞弊
words.ex: He uses a rig to hold the camera steady.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个支架来固定相机。
words.en: To rig something means to arrange or set it up in a particular way, often in a temporary or makeshift manner. It can also refer to the equipment used in drilling for oil or gas, or the sails and ropes on a ship.

words.ex: The country fell into anarchy after the war.
words.ex_cn: 战争之后，这个国家陷入了混乱。
words.en: Anarchy is a state of disorder due to absence or nonrecognition of authority or other controlling systems.

words.tr: n. 繁殖者；饲养员；起因
words.ex: The breeder takes care of dogs every day.
words.ex_cn: 繁育者每天照顾狗。
words.en: A breeder is a person who breeds animals or plants professionally.

words.ex: The school used to segregate students by race.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校过去按种族隔离学生。
words.en: To segregate means to separate one group of people, animals, or things from another, especially because they are of different types or belong to different categories.

words.ex: The little rascal stole my cookie.
words.ex_cn: 那个顽皮的孩子偷了我的饼干。
words.en: A rascal is a person who behaves badly or dishonestly but who is usually likable.

words.ex: He tried to shoplift a shirt from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他试图从商店偷一件衬衫。
words.en: To steal goods from a shop while pretending to be a customer.

words.ex: He shuns loud parties because he is shy.
words.ex_cn: 他因为害羞而避开热闹的派对。
words.en: If you shun someone or something, you deliberately avoid them or keep away from them.

words.tr: adj. 难以获得的；不能利用的；没空的；
words.ex: The book is unavailable in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆里难以获得。
words.en: If someone or something is unavailable, they are not able to be used or contacted, often because they are busy, not present, or not working.

words.tr: phrase. 大众传媒；大众传播媒介（如电视、广播、报纸等）
words.ex: The mass media shows news every evening.
words.ex_cn: 大众媒体每天晚上播放新闻。
words.en: The mass media refers to the various channels of communication that reach large numbers of people, such as television, radio, newspapers, and the internet.

words.ex: She sifts flour through a fine mesh.
words.ex_cn: 她用细网筛面粉。
words.en: To sift means to put a fine, loose, or powdery substance through a sieve so as to remove lumps or large particles. It can also mean to examine something thoroughly so as to isolate that which is most important or useful.

words.tr: n. 抽样；取样；采样； v. “sample”的现在分词；
words.ex: The survey uses random sampling to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 这项调查使用随机抽样来收集数据。
words.en: Sampling is the act, process, or technique of selecting a suitable sample, or a representative part of a population for the purpose of determining parameters or characteristics of the whole population.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

words.tr: adj. 无法解释的；费解的
words.ex: His sudden silence was inexplicable.
words.ex_cn: 他突然的沉默无法解释。
words.en: If something is inexplicable, you cannot explain why it happens or why it is true.

words.tr:
v. 熔炼；冶炼
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；“smell”的过去式和过去分词
n. 胡瓜鱼
words.ex: They smelt iron ore to make steel.
words.ex_cn: 他们熔炼铁矿石来制造钢铁。
words.en: To smelt means to extract metal from ore by a process involving heating and melting.

words.tr: phrase. 在当时；在那些日子里；从前
words.ex: In those days, people traveled by horse and carriage.
words.ex_cn: 在过去，人们乘坐马车旅行。
words.en: In the past, during that period.

words.tr: v. 恳求；征求；（妓女）拉客
words.ex: He solicits donations for the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他为慈善机构募捐。
words.en: If you solicit money, help, support, or an opinion from someone, you ask them for it.

words.ex: The patient needed a blood transfusion after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后，病人需要输血。
words.en: The process of transferring blood or blood products from one person to another.

words.tr: abbr. 艾滋病；获得性免疫缺乏综合症；“Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome”的缩写；
words.ex: He got tested for aids last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周做了艾滋病检测。
words.en: AIDS is a disease caused by a virus that weakens a person's immune system, making them vulnerable to other infections and diseases.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with acquired immune deficiency syndrome last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有获得性免疫缺陷综合征。
words.en: A serious disease of the immune system that is caused by infection with the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). It is characterized by a decrease in the number of helper T cells, which leaves the body vulnerable to opportunistic infections and certain cancers.

words.tr: adj. 注意力分散的； v. “distract”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was distracted by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被巨大的噪音分散了注意力。
words.en: If you are distracted, you are not able to concentrate because you are worried or thinking about something else.

words.ex: The smoke began to stifle her breathing.
words.ex_cn: 烟雾开始让她窒息。
words.en: To stifle something means to prevent it from happening, continuing, or developing.

words.tr: adj. 令人作呕的；多病的；不健壮的；憔悴的
words.ex: The sickly sweet smell of the flowers made her nauseous.
words.ex_cn: 花儿那甜得令人作呕的气味让她感到恶心。
words.en: If you describe someone as sickly, you mean that they are often ill or they look as if they are often ill.

words.tr: v. 捐赠；订阅；订购；签署；认购（股份）
words.ex: He decided to subscribe $50 to the charity each month.
words.ex_cn: 他决定每月向慈善机构捐赠50美元。
words.en: If you subscribe to a magazine or a service, you pay to receive it regularly.

words.ex: He used a jigsaw to cut the wooden board.
words.ex_cn: 他用竖锯切割木板。
words.en: A jigsaw is a machine with a fine blade used for cutting shapes in wood or metal. It is also a puzzle consisting of a picture printed on cardboard or wood and cut into various pieces of different shapes that have to be fitted together.

words.ex: She is a lovable and kind-hearted person.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个可爱且心地善良的人。
words.en: If you describe someone as lovable, you mean that they have attractive qualities, and are easy to like.

words.ex: The penguin walks on the ice.
words.ex_cn: 企鹅在冰上行走。
words.en: A penguin is a type of bird that cannot fly, lives in the southern hemisphere, and swims very well.

words.ex: He stayed strong through adversity.
words.ex_cn: 他在逆境中保持坚强。
words.en: Adversity refers to a difficult or unlucky situation or event.

words.tr:
v. 交换；
n. 交换；
words.ex: They swap books every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周交换书籍。
words.en: If you swap something with someone, you give it to them and receive a different thing in exchange.

words.ex: He plays the banjo every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都弹班卓琴。
words.en: A banjo is a musical instrument with a circular body covered with a tightly stretched skin or plastic membrane, a long neck, and four to nine strings that are plucked or strummed.

words.ex: He stayed calm in the face of danger.
words.ex_cn: 他在危险面前保持冷静。
words.en: If you do something in the face of a particular situation, you do it despite the difficulties or problems that the situation causes.

words.ex: He tries to synthesize ideas from different books.
words.ex_cn: 他试图综合来自不同书籍的想法。
words.en: To synthesize means to combine different ideas, influences, or objects into a new whole, or to produce a substance by a chemical reaction in plants or animals.

words.ex: He got a vaccine last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周打了疫苗。
words.en: A vaccine is a substance containing a virus or bacterium in a form that is not harmful, given to a person or animal to prevent them from getting the disease that the virus or bacterium causes.

words.ex: Vaccines help build immunity against diseases.
words.ex_cn: 疫苗有助于增强对疾病的免疫力。
words.en: Immunity is the state of being immune from or insusceptible to a particular disease or the legal status of being exempt from certain obligations or penalties.

words.ex: The teacher will terminate the class at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 老师将在下午5点结束课程。
words.en: To terminate something means to bring it to an end or to stop it from continuing.

words.ex: The baby slept uninterrupted for six hours.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿连续睡了六个小时。
words.en: Something that is uninterrupted continues for a period of time without stopping.

words.ex: The castle endured a long siege during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡在战争中经历了长期的围攻。
words.en: A siege is a military operation in which enemy forces surround a town or building, cutting off essential supplies, with the aim of compelling those inside to surrender.

words.tr: n. 通晓数国语言的人；语言学家；
words.ex: He is a linguist who speaks five languages.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位通晓五种语言的人。
words.en: A linguist is someone who studies language or languages, especially a person who studies linguistics.

words.ex: The lab technician transcribes the DNA sequence into RNA.
words.ex_cn: 实验室技术员将DNA序列转录成RNA。
words.en: To transcribe something means to write it down or to copy it from one form of recording to another.

words.ex: He refuses to accept the dogma of the church.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝接受教会的教条。
words.en: A principle or set of principles laid down by an authority as incontrovertibly true.

words.tr:
adj. 希腊的；
n. 希腊语；
words.ex: He loves eating Greek food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃的希腊食物。
words.en: Relating to Greece, its people, or their language.

words.tr:
adj. 古罗马的；罗马人的；
n. 古罗马人；
words.ex: The ancient roman roads are still visible today.
words.ex_cn: 古老的罗马道路至今仍清晰可见。
words.en: A Roman is a person who comes from Rome or is connected with Rome. It can also refer to the style of printing or writing that uses upright letters, as opposed to italic.

words.ex: He touched the button with his fingertip.
words.ex_cn: 他用指尖按了按钮。
words.en: The very end of a finger.

words.ex: The window has a broken pane.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户有一块碎了的玻璃。
words.en: A pane is a piece of glass that is fitted into a window or door.

words.tr:
v. 滴流；慢慢移动
n. 细流；徐徐地流
words.ex: Water trickles down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 水从山上缓缓流下。
words.en: If a liquid trickles somewhere, it flows slowly in a thin stream.

words.tr: phrase. 一块玻璃，通常指窗户中的一块平板玻璃
words.ex: He accidentally broke a pane of glass.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了一块玻璃。
words.en: A single sheet of glass, typically used in a window.

words.ex: The storm unleashed heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 风暴释放出大雨。
words.en: If you say that someone or something unleashes a powerful force, feeling, activity, or group, you mean that they suddenly start it or send it to move somewhere.

words.tr: adj. 自我中心的；自私自利的
words.ex: He is egoistic and only thinks about himself.
words.ex_cn: 他很自私，只考虑自己。
words.en: Egoistic refers to someone who is excessively self-centered or self-interested.

words.tr: n. 野蛮；原始；未开化；暴虐
words.ex: The soldier was punished for his barbarism during the war.
words.ex_cn: 那名士兵因在战争中的野蛮行为而受到惩罚。
words.en: Barbarism refers to the state of being uncivilized or the act of being extremely cruel or brutal.

words.tr: phrase. 倾向于做某事；往往会做某事
words.ex: Children tend to play outside after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后喜欢在外面玩。
words.en: If someone tends to do something, they usually do it or are likely to do it.

words.ex: He unpacks his bags after arriving home.
words.ex_cn: 他到家后打开行李。
words.en: To unpack means to open and remove the contents of a container, such as a suitcase or a box, or to explain or analyze something in detail.

words.ex: He threw the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A bin is a container that you put rubbish in.

words.ex: He put mayonnaise on his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治上加了蛋黄酱。
words.en: A thick, creamy dressing consisting of egg yolks beaten with oil and vinegar and seasoned.

words.tr: phrase. 拿出；取出；去掉；取得；领到
words.ex: He took out his keys to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他拿出钥匙开门。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to take something with you when you go somewhere.

words.ex: Please verify your email address.
words.ex_cn: 请核实你的电子邮件地址。
words.en: To verify something means to check or prove that it is true, accurate, or justified.

words.ex: He owns the copyright to his novel.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这部小说的版权。
words.en: The exclusive legal right, given to an originator or an assignee to print, publish, perform, film, or record literary, artistic, or musical material, and to authorize others to do the same.

words.ex: He is studying linguistics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习语言学。
words.en: Linguistics is the scientific study of language and its structure, including the study of morphology, syntax, phonetics, and semantics.

chapters.name: Level 9 认知•思考类动词

words.ex: He is a programmer who writes code for apps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名为应用程序编写代码的程序员。
words.en: A programmer is a person who writes computer programs as a profession or hobby.

words.ex: I like to browse the internet for fun.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢上网浏览消遣。
words.en: To look through or glance at reading matter casually or randomly.

words.ex: The engineer checked the specification for the machine.
words.ex_cn: 工程师检查了机器的规格。
words.en: A specification is a detailed description of the design and materials used to make something.

words.tr:
n. 击败对手的一击；引人注目的人或物
adj. 击倒的；淘汰制的；引人注目的；迷人的
words.ex: He won the match with a knockout in the first round.
words.ex_cn: 他在第一回合以击倒获胜。
words.en: A knockout is a situation in boxing where one fighter is knocked down and unable to get up before the referee counts to ten, resulting in the other fighter winning the match. It can also refer to something that is extremely attractive or impressive.

words.ex: The magic show captivates the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演吸引了孩子们。
words.en: If you are captivated by someone or something, you find them fascinating and attractive.

words.ex: He is a famous playwright who writes plays.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的剧作家，写剧本。
words.en: A playwright is a person who writes plays.

words.ex: He craves chocolate when he is stressed.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到压力时，他渴望吃巧克力。
words.en: If you crave something, or crave for it, you want to have it very much.

words.ex: He is a scientist of great renown.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位享有盛誉的科学家。
words.en: Renown is the state of being known and talked about by many people because of your achievements, qualities, or actions.

words.tr: adj. 愤世嫉俗的；悲观的；
words.ex: He gave a cynical smile when they talked about honesty.
words.ex_cn: 当他们谈到诚实时，他露出了愤世嫉俗的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as cynical, you mean they believe that people always act selfishly.

words.ex: The symbol x denotes an unknown number.
words.ex_cn: 符号 x 表示一个未知数。
words.en: If one thing denotes another, it is a sign or indication of it.

words.ex: He waits for the gratification of winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他等待赢得比赛的满足感。
words.en: Gratification is the pleasure or satisfaction you feel when you get something you wanted or worked for.

words.tr: adj. 史诗的；叙事诗的；宏丽的；
words.ex: The movie tells an epic story of heroes and dragons.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影讲述了一个关于英雄和龙的史诗故事。
words.en: An epic is a long book, poem, or film, whose story extends over a long period of time or tells of great events.

words.ex: The song evokes happy memories of childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌唤起了对童年的美好回忆。
words.en: To evoke a particular memory, idea, emotion, or response means to cause it to occur.

words.ex: He felt a warm reminiscence of his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到了对童年的温馨回忆。
words.en: The act or process of recalling past experiences, events, etc.

words.tr:
abbr. 小号的（型号）；“small”的缩写
n. 硫（元素sulphur的符号）
words.ex: This shirt is size s.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是小号的。
words.en: A chemical element with symbol S and atomic number 16, a yellow, non-metallic solid.

words.ex: She added sage to the stuffing for Thanksgiving dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她在感恩节晚餐的填料中加入了鼠尾草。
words.en: A sage is a person who is regarded as being very wise, especially someone who is known for their good judgment and deep understanding of life.

words.ex: The ruins show the antiquity of this civilization.
words.ex_cn: 这些废墟展示了这个文明的古老。
words.en: The ancient past, especially the period before the Middle Ages.

words.ex: He can foretell the weather by looking at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他可以通过观察天空来预知天气。
words.en: To tell or indicate beforehand; predict.

words.tr: n. （教会办的）旅客招待所；临终关怀医院；临终安养院
words.ex: He spent his last days in a hospice.
words.ex_cn: 他最后的日子是在临终关怀机构度过的。
words.en: A hospice is a special hospital or home for people who are dying, where they are cared for by specially trained nurses and doctors.

words.tr: v. 骚扰；烦扰；屡次侵扰
words.ex: He harasses his coworkers with loud jokes.
words.ex_cn: 他用大声的笑话骚扰他的同事。
words.en: If someone harasses you, they trouble or annoy you, for example by attacking you repeatedly or by causing you as many problems as they can.

words.ex: Good hygiene helps prevent sickness.
words.ex_cn: 良好的卫生有助于预防疾病。
words.en: Hygiene refers to conditions and practices that help to maintain health and prevent the spread of diseases.

words.ex: He inferred that she was tired from her yawns.
words.ex_cn: 他从她的哈欠推断出她很累。
words.en: If you infer that something is the case, you decide that it is true on the basis of information that you already have.

words.tr:
n. 微粒；斑点；少量
v. 使有斑点
words.ex: There is a speck of dust on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一粒灰尘。
words.en: A speck is a very small stain, mark, or container of something.

words.ex: The butler served tea in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 管家在客厅端上了茶。
words.en: A butler is the most important male servant in a wealthy house.

words.ex: He committed a crime last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚犯下一桩罪行。
words.en: To do something illegal or wrong.

words.ex: Some people follow that cult blindly.
words.ex_cn: 有些人盲目追随那个狂热崇拜。
words.en: A cult is a group of people who have extreme admiration for a particular person, idea, or thing, often following unusual or extreme practices or beliefs.

words.ex: The teacher tried to infuse confidence into the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师试图向学生注入信心。
words.en: If you infuse a quality into someone or something, you fill them with it. If a quality infuses something, it is present throughout it.

words.ex: He showed conformity with the group's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守了小组的规定。
words.en: Conformity is the act of matching attitudes, beliefs, and behaviors to group norms or standards.

words.ex: The alpine flowers bloom in the high mountains.
words.ex_cn: 高山上的花朵在高山上绽放。
words.en: Relating to high mountains, especially the Alps.

words.tr:
v. 密谋；激起…的兴趣
n. 阴谋诡计；密谋策划
words.ex: They intrigue to take over the company.
words.ex_cn: 他们密谋接管这家公司。
words.en: If something intrigues you, it interests you a lot because it seems strange or mysterious.

words.ex: The botanist studies plants in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位植物学家在森林里研究植物。
words.en: A botanist is a scientist who studies plants.

words.ex: The archbishop gave a speech at the church.
words.ex_cn: 大主教在教堂发表了一次演讲。
words.en: An archbishop is a bishop of the highest rank who is in charge of an archdiocese.

words.ex: He sat by the window to ponder his future.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边深思自己的未来。
words.en: If you ponder something, you think about it carefully.

words.ex: They had a discord about the movie ending.
words.ex_cn: 他们对电影的结局有分歧。
words.en: Disagreement or strife between people or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 在种族之间；在比赛项目之间（根据上下文可指种族关系或赛程间隔）
words.ex: The track team relaxed and had a picnic between the races.
words.ex_cn: 田径队在比赛之间放松并野餐。
words.en: Existing or occurring in the space separating different groups or categories of people.

words.tr: adj. 无子女的；无后代的
words.ex: They are childless because they do not want children.
words.ex_cn: 他们没有孩子，因为他们不想有孩子。
words.en: Someone who is childless has no children.

words.ex: He rediscovered his love for music after years.
words.ex_cn: 多年后，他重新发现了对音乐的热爱。
words.en: To discover again something that was lost or forgotten.

words.tr: adj. 很长的；漫长的；冗长的；
words.ex: The meeting was lengthy and tiring.
words.ex_cn: 会议很长，很累人。
words.en: Something that is lengthy lasts for a long time, often longer than you want or expect.

words.ex: They are discussing marital problems.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在讨论婚姻问题。
words.en: Marital is used to describe things relating to marriage.

words.tr:
v. 臆测；猜想
n. 臆测；猜度
words.ex: He surmises that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: If you surmise that something is true, you guess it from the available evidence, although you do not know for certain.

words.tr: adj. 失控的；物价飞涨的；
words.ex: The runaway train crashed into the station.
words.ex_cn: 这列失控的火车撞上了车站。
words.en: A runaway is someone who has run away from home or an institution, or something that is out of control and moving or acting without being directed.

words.tr: n. 寄膳（宿）； v. “board”的现在分词；
words.ex: The students pay for boarding at the school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们为学校的寄宿支付费用。
words.en: Boarding refers to the act of getting on or into a vehicle, ship, or aircraft, or the provision of meals and lodging for payment.

words.tr: phrase. 登机牌；用于登机时的身份凭证
words.ex: He showed his boarding pass at the gate.
words.ex_cn: 他在登机口出示了登机牌。
words.en: A boarding pass is a document provided by an airline during check-in, giving a passenger permission to board the airplane for a particular flight.

words.ex: The photo showed an enlargement of the tiny letter.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了那个小字母的放大版。
words.en: The act of making something larger or the state of being made larger.

words.tr: v. 使心神不宁；使不安；扰乱
words.ex: The loud noise unsettled the baby.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让婴儿不安。
words.en: To make someone feel anxious or uncertain.

words.tr: adj. 平静的；宁静的；温和的；
words.ex: The lake was placid in the morning light.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的阳光下，湖面平静无波。
words.en: A placid person or animal is calm and does not easily become excited, angry, or upset.

words.tr:
n. 公社；亲密的会谈
v. 亲密地交谈；与…融为一体
words.ex: The farmers lived in a commune in the 1970s.
words.ex_cn: 这些农民在20世纪70年代住在一个公社里。
words.en: A commune is a group of people who live together and share responsibilities and possessions, or the act of communicating intimately with someone or something.

words.tr: n. 梦想家；空想家；不切实际的人；
words.ex: He is a dreamer who wants to change the world.
words.ex_cn: 他是个想要改变世界的人。
words.en: A dreamer is someone who has a lot of ideas and plans for the future but is not practical or realistic about them.

words.tr: v. 使可见；使形象化；设想；
words.ex: He uses maps to visualize the data.
words.ex_cn: 他使用地图来使数据可见。
words.en: If you visualize something, you imagine what it is like by forming a mental picture of it.

words.ex: He dreams of a perfect utopia where everyone is happy.
words.ex_cn: 他梦想一个每个人都很幸福的完美乌托邦。
words.en: An imagined place or state of things in which everything is perfect.

chapters.name: Level 9 名词 生物

words.ex: The dog has a flea on its back.
words.ex_cn: 狗的背上有一只跳蚤。
words.en: A flea is a very small jumping insect that has no wings and feeds on the blood of humans or animals.

words.ex: The grasshopper jumps high in the grass.
words.ex_cn: 蚱蜢在草丛中跳得很高。
words.en: A grasshopper is a plant-eating insect with long back legs that can jump very high and makes a sharp, high noise using its back legs or wings.

words.ex: The lioness hunts for her cubs every day.
words.ex_cn: 母狮每天为她的幼崽捕猎。
words.en: A lioness is a female lion.

words.ex: The mare grazed quietly in the field.
words.ex_cn: 那匹母马在田野里安静地吃草。
words.en: A mare is an adult female horse.

words.ex: The reindeer walks in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 驯鹿在雪地上行走。
words.en: A reindeer is a type of deer with large horns called antlers that lives in the northern parts of Europe, Asia, and North America.

chapters.name: Level 9 名词 动作•运动

words.ex: The car's acceleration increased when the driver pressed the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当司机踩油门时，汽车的加速度增加了。
words.en: Acceleration is the rate at which a car or other vehicle can increase its speed, often measured in the time it takes to go from 0 to 60 miles per hour.

words.tr:
v. 投掷；抛；“cast”的现在分词
n. 铸件
words.ex: He was casting a stone into the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把一块石头扔进湖里。
words.en: The process of selecting actors for a play or film; the process of making objects by pouring liquid material into a mold.

words.tr: n. 扭曲；歪曲；失真；畸变；
words.ex: The photo showed distortion in the lines.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中的线条出现了扭曲。
words.en: A distortion is a change, twist, or exaggeration that makes something appear different from the way it really is.

words.ex: The rubber band shows great elasticity when stretched.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋被拉伸时表现出很大的弹性。
words.en: The ability of an object or material to resume its normal shape after being stretched or compressed.

words.ex: The team gained momentum after scoring the first goal.
words.ex_cn: 球队在进第一个球后获得了势头。
words.en: Momentum is the ability of something to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful.

words.tr: n. 登山，爬山，登山运动
words.ex: He loves mountaineering in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在山里登山。
words.en: The sport or activity of climbing mountains.

words.ex: The plane's takeoff was delayed by strong wind.
words.ex_cn: 飞机的起飞因强风而延误了。
words.en: Takeoff is the beginning of a flight, when an aircraft leaves the ground.

words.ex: The transit of goods takes three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输需要三天。
words.en: The act or process of passing through or across; the conveyance of people or goods from one place to another.

chapters.name: Level 9 名词 身体•疾病•药物

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.ex: She gave birth to her baby after hours of childbirth.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的分娩，她生下了孩子。
words.en: The process of giving birth to a child.

words.ex: She wrote: 'I love reading.'
words.ex_cn: 她写道：‘我喜欢阅读。’
words.en: A colon is a punctuation mark consisting of two equally sized dots centered on the same vertical line. It is also used to refer to the part of the large intestine that extends from the cecum to the rectum.

words.ex: Washing hands can kill germs.
words.ex_cn: 洗手可以杀死病菌。
words.en: A germ is a very small organism that causes disease.

words.ex: Heredity determines eye color in humans.
words.ex_cn: 遗传决定人类的眼睛颜色。
words.en: Heredity is the process by which features and characteristics are passed on from parents to their children before the children are born.

words.ex: The intestine helps digest food.
words.ex_cn: 肠道帮助消化食物。
words.en: The part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus.

words.ex: Eating healthy food helps with longevity.
words.ex_cn: 健康饮食有助于长寿。
words.en: Longevity refers to the length or duration of an individual's life, especially when it is unusually long.

words.ex: The movie shows nudity in one scene.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影在一个场景中展示了裸体。
words.en: The state or fact of being naked.

words.ex: The receptor detects the signal from the hormone.
words.ex_cn: 受体检测激素的信号。
words.en: A receptor is a cell or a group of cells that receives stimuli.

words.ex: The recurrence of storms caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的反复出现造成了许多问题。
words.en: The return of a sign, symptom, or disease after a remission.

words.ex: Caffeine is a common stimulant.
words.ex_cn: 咖啡因是一种常见的兴奋剂。
words.en: A stimulant is a substance that raises levels of physiological or nervous activity in the body.

words.tr: n. 综合征；综合症状；典型表现；
words.ex: He was diagnosed with sleep apnea syndrome.
words.ex_cn: 他被诊断出患有睡眠呼吸暂停综合征。
words.en: A syndrome is a set of medical signs and symptoms which are correlated with each other and often associated with a particular disease or disorder.

chapters.name: Level 9 名词 感情•感觉

words.tr: n. 出神；心不在焉；抽象
words.ex: He sat by the window in abstraction, staring at the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边出神，凝视着云朵。
words.en: An abstraction is a general idea rather than one that is based on a specific real thing or event.

words.ex: The long silence caused alienation between them.
words.ex_cn: 长久的沉默导致了他们之间的离间。
words.en: Alienation refers to the state or experience of being isolated from a group or an activity to which one should belong or in which one should be involved.

words.ex: He showed apathy toward the news.
words.ex_cn: 他对这则新闻漠不关心。
words.en: Apathy is a lack of feeling, emotion, interest, or concern about something. It is a state of indifference, or the suppression of emotions such as concern, excitement, motivation, or passion.

words.tr: n. 强迫；强制；难以抗拒的冲动
words.ex: He felt a compulsion to check the door again.
words.ex_cn: 他感到一种必须再次检查门的强迫感。
words.en: A compulsion is a very strong desire to do something, which you find difficult to control.

words.ex: His conjecture was that the missing key was in the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他猜测丢失的钥匙在抽屉里。
words.en: A conjecture is a conclusion that is based on information that is not certain or complete.

words.ex: Her hug was a consolation after the loss.
words.ex_cn: 在失败之后，她的拥抱是一种安慰。
words.en: Consolation is something that makes you feel better when you are sad or disappointed.

words.ex: He showed cowardice when he ran away from the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他在打架时逃跑，表现出了懦弱。
words.en: Cowardice is the lack of courage to face danger, difficulty, opposition, or pain.

words.tr:
v. 使发昏；使迷乱
n. 恍惚； 晕眩
words.ex: The loud noise dazed him for a moment.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让他一时发昏。
words.en: If someone is in a daze, they are feeling confused and unable to think clearly, often because they have had a shock or surprise.

words.ex: He showed distaste for loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对嘈杂的声音感到反感。
words.en: If you feel distaste for someone or something, you dislike them and consider them to be unpleasant, unattractive, or morally unacceptable.

words.ex: From the clues, he made a logical inference.
words.ex_cn: 从线索中，他做出了一个合理的推论。
words.en: An inference is a conclusion that you draw about something by using information that you already have about it.

words.ex: He mistrusts strangers who ask for money.
words.ex_cn: 他不信任向他要钱的陌生人。
words.en: Mistrust is the feeling that you cannot trust someone or something.

words.ex: The reporter tried to show objectivity in the news story.
words.ex_cn: 记者试图在新闻报道中体现客观性。
words.en: Objectivity is the quality of being objective, which means not influenced by personal feelings or opinions in considering and representing facts.

words.tr: n. 痴迷；困扰；着魔；强迫观念；
words.ex: His obsession with video games made him ignore his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏的痴迷让他忽略了学业。
words.en: An obsession is an idea or thought that continually preoccupies or intrudes on a person's mind.

words.ex: He showed repentance after lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在对朋友撒谎后表现出悔意。
words.en: The action of repenting; sincere regret or remorse.

words.tr:
n. 回想
v. 回想
words.ex: In retrospect, I should have studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 回顾过去，我本该更努力学习的。
words.en: When you consider something in retrospect, you think about it afterwards, and often have a different opinion about it from the one that you had at the time.

words.ex: He answered the question with tact.
words.ex_cn: 他机智地回答了这个问题。
words.en: If you describe what someone says or does as tact, you mean that it is polite, considerate, and shows an understanding of other people's feelings.

words.tr: n. 骚动；骚乱；心烦意乱
words.ex: The crowd caused a tumult after the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛后，人群引起了混乱。
words.en: A tumult is a state of confusion, noise, and excitement, often involving a large group of people.

words.ex: His willingness to help made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 他乐于帮忙，让每个人都感到开心。
words.en: The quality or state of being prepared to do something; readiness.

words.ex: He felt great woe after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他失去狗后感到极大的悲伤。
words.en: Woe is great sadness.

words.tr:
n. 渴望；向往
adj. 渴望的；向往的
v. 渴望；渴求；“yearn”的现在分词
words.ex: He has a yearning for home.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望回家。
words.en: A yearning is a strong feeling of wanting something, especially something that you know you may not be able to have.

chapters.name: Level 9 名词 艺术•出版

words.ex: He told an anecdote about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于他童年的趣事。
words.en: An anecdote is a short, amusing or interesting story about a real incident or person.

words.ex: He has a natural aptitude for math.
words.ex_cn: 他天生有数学天赋。
words.en: An aptitude is a natural ability to do something.

words.ex: The two companies worked together in collaboration.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司通过合作一起工作。
words.en: the act of working together with someone to produce or create something

words.tr: n. 精心制作；详尽的细节；
words.ex: The chef gave an elaboration to the dish with fresh herbs.
words.ex_cn: 厨师用新鲜香草对这道菜进行了精心制作。
words.en: The process of developing or presenting a theory, policy, or system in detail.

words.tr:
n. 摘录；摘要
v. 摘录；引用
words.ex: He read an excerpt from the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的一段摘录。
words.en: An excerpt is a short piece of writing or music which is taken from a larger piece.

words.tr:
n. 脚注；次要者
v. 为…作脚注
words.ex: He added a footnote to explain the word.
words.ex_cn: 他加了一个脚注来解释这个词。
words.en: A footnote is a note at the bottom of a page in a book which provides more detailed information about something mentioned in the text above it.

words.ex: The word 'hello' is written in italic.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'hello' 是用斜体写的。
words.en: Italic refers to a style of printing or writing in which the letters slope to the right.

words.ex: The motif of love appears in many poems.
words.ex_cn: 爱的主题出现在许多诗歌中。
words.en: A motif is a design or pattern that is used in a piece of art or music, or a theme that is repeated in a work of literature.

words.ex: I need a photocopy of my passport.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一份护照的影印本。
words.en: A photocopy is a copy of a document made by a photocopier.

words.ex: He forgot the punctuation in his sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记在句子中加标点符号了。
words.en: Punctuation refers to the marks used in writing to separate sentences and their elements and to clarify meaning.

words.ex: The movie had a sequel that came out last year.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有一部去年上映的续集。
