words.en: A taboo is a social or religious custom prohibiting or restricting a particular practice or forbidding association with a particular person, place, or thing.

words.tr: adj. 暴虐的；压制的；残暴的
words.ex: The tyrannical king punished people for small mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 这个暴虐的国王因为小错误惩罚人民。
words.en: Using power in a cruel and unfair way over people in a country or group.

words.tr: adj. 未售出的；无人购买的
words.ex: The unsold books are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 未售出的书存放在仓库里。
words.en: If something is unsold, it has not been sold.

words.ex: He is learning vocational skills to become a mechanic.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习职业技能以成为一名机械师。
words.en: Relating to the skills you need to do a particular job.

chapters.name: Level 9 形容词 气候•自然

words.tr: adj. 水生的；水栖的；水中的；
words.ex: The fish live in aquatic plants.
words.ex_cn: 这些鱼生活在水生植物中。
words.en: Relating to water; living in or near water or taking place in water.

words.tr: adj. 天空的；天体的；天国的；
words.ex: The celestial lights shone brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中的光芒在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: Relating to the sky or the heavens; belonging or relating to heaven as the abode of the gods.

words.ex: The cosmic rays come from outer space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙射线来自外太空。
words.en: Relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth.

words.tr:
adj. 常绿的；常青的；
n. 常绿树；常绿植物；
words.ex: The evergreen trees stay green all year.
words.ex_cn: 常绿树一年四季都是绿色的。
words.en: An evergreen is a plant, tree, or bush that has green leaves all the year round.

words.tr: adj. 极冷的；冰冻的； v. 结冰；冻结；“freeze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The weather is freezing today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气极冷。
words.en: If you say that something is freezing, you are emphasizing that it is very cold.

chapters.name: Level 9 形容词 程度•度量衡

words.ex: He uses an astronomical telescope to watch stars.
words.ex_cn: 他用一架天文望远镜观察星星。
words.en: If you describe an amount, especially the cost of something as astronomical, you are emphasizing that it is very large indeed.

words.tr: adj. 离奇的；奇特的；奇怪的；
words.ex: The clown wore a bizarre hat with three eyes.
words.ex_cn: 小丑戴着一顶有三只眼睛的离奇帽子。
words.en: Something that is bizarre is very odd and strange.

words.ex: The ocean is a bottomless abyss.
words.ex_cn: 海洋是无底的深渊。
words.en: If you describe something as bottomless, you mean that it is so deep that it seems to have no bottom, or that it is very large or unlimited in amount.

words.tr: adj. 繁重的；累赘的；难于负担的
words.ex: The homework was burdensome and took all night.
words.ex_cn: 作业负担沉重，花了一整晚时间。
words.en: If you describe something as burdensome, you mean it is very difficult to cope with or manage because it is so heavy, large, or complex.

words.ex: The teacher spoke in a comprehensible way.
words.ex_cn: 老师用容易理解的方式讲话。
words.en: If something is comprehensible, you can understand it.

words.ex: The weather was congenial for a picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气非常适合野餐。
words.en: A congenial person, place, or environment is pleasant because it suits your character or nature.

words.tr: adj. 破坏性的；引起混乱的；
words.ex: The new technology caused disruptive changes in the market.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术给市场带来了破坏性的变化。
words.en: Causing or tending to cause disruption.

words.ex: She made the dance look effortless.
words.ex_cn: 她让舞蹈看起来毫不费力。
words.en: If you describe something as effortless, you mean that it is done or achieved with very little difficulty or work, often as a result of great skill.

words.ex: Water is an elemental part of life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本组成部分。
words.en: Something that is elemental is of a simple, basic kind.

words.tr: adj. 充满大事的；多事故的；多变故的
words.ex: It was an eventful day with many surprises.
words.ex_cn: 那是充满惊喜的一天。
words.en: If you describe a period of time as eventful, you mean that a lot of interesting, exciting, or important things have happened during it.

words.tr: v. 超过；超出；“exceed”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is exceeding the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 他正在超过限速。
words.en: Going beyond the usual, necessary, or proper limit or degree; excessive.

words.ex: The concert was fabulous!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something as fabulous, you are emphasizing that you like it a lot or think that it is very good.

words.tr: adj. 强制的；强迫的；强有力的
words.ex: The police used forcible entry to get inside.
words.ex_cn: 警察强行进入里面。
words.en: Forcible is used to describe something that is done using physical force or violence, or something that is done in a strong and effective way.

words.ex: He is frugal with his money.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱很节俭。
words.en: If you describe someone as frugal, you mean that they are careful about spending money and use things only when they need to.

words.ex: It was futile to try to fix the broken clock.
words.ex_cn: 试图修理坏掉的钟表是徒劳的。
words.en: If you say that something is futile, you mean there is no point in doing it, usually because it has no chance of succeeding.

words.ex: He bought a generic brand of painkiller.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一种普通的止痛药品牌。
words.en: Generic refers to something that is not specific or unique, often used to describe products that are not branded or are general in nature.

words.ex: The chemicals are hazardous to health.
words.ex_cn: 这些化学物质对健康有危险。
words.en: Something that is hazardous is dangerous, especially to people's health or safety.

words.ex: Her mornings are hectic with work and kids.
words.ex_cn: 她的早晨因为工作和孩子而紧张忙碌。
words.en: If you describe a situation as hectic, you mean that it is very busy and involves a lot of rushed activity.

words.tr: adj. 无力的；虚弱的；阳痿的
words.ex: He felt impotent after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到无能为力。
words.en: If someone feels impotent, they feel that they have no power to influence people or events.

words.ex: It is inconceivable that he forgot his own birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了自己生日，这简直难以想象。
words.en: If something is inconceivable, it is impossible to imagine or believe because it is so unlikely.

words.ex: The heat was inescapable in the small room.
words.ex_cn: 小房间里热得无法逃避。
words.en: If you describe a fact, situation, or activity as inescapable, you mean that it is difficult not to notice it or be affected by it.

words.tr: adj. 少有的；不经常的；罕见的；
words.ex: He makes infrequent visits to his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 他很少回老家。
words.en: If something is infrequent, it does not happen often.

words.tr: adj. 有极大诱惑力的；不可抵抗的；
words.ex: The chocolate cake looked irresistible.
words.ex_cn: 那块巧克力蛋糕看起来极具诱惑力。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as irresistible, you mean that they are so good or attractive that you cannot stop yourself from liking them or wanting them.

words.tr: adj. 微温的；不冷不热的；不热情的
words.ex: The water is lukewarm, so I didn't swim.
words.ex_cn: 水是温的，所以我没游泳。
words.en: If you describe something as lukewarm, you mean that it is only slightly warm, or that it is not very enthusiastic or interested.

words.ex: He had a meager meal after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后吃了一顿很少的饭。
words.en: If you describe an amount or quantity of something as meager, you are critical of it because it is very small or not enough.

words.ex: The movie was mediocre and not worth watching.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很平庸，不值得看。
words.en: If you describe something as mediocre, you mean that it is of average quality but you think it should be better.

words.tr: adj. 值得注意的；显著的；
words.ex: This result is noteworthy because it changes our understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个结果值得注意，因为它改变了我们的理解。
words.en: If you describe something as noteworthy, you mean that it is interesting, significant, or important enough to deserve attention or to be noticed.

words.tr: adj. 强制性的；义务的；必须的；
words.ex: Wearing a helmet is obligatory for cyclists.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是强制性的。
words.en: If something is obligatory, you must do it because of a rule or law.

words.tr: adj. 过时的；废弃的；淘汰的；
words.ex: This phone is obsolete because it doesn't work with new apps.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机已经过时了，因为它不能使用新应用。
words.en: Something that is obsolete is no longer needed because something better has been invented.

words.tr: adj. 极无礼的；粗暴的；骇人的；
words.ex: His outrageous behavior made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他极无礼的行为让所有人都生气了。
words.en: If you describe something as outrageous, you are emphasizing that it is unacceptable because it is extremely bad, immoral, or shocking.

words.tr: adj. 公开的；明显的；公然的
words.ex: His anger was overt and hard to miss.
words.ex_cn: 他的愤怒是明显的，很难忽视。
words.en: An overt action or attitude is done or shown in an open and obvious way.

words.tr: adj. 尚可的；可通行的；（钱币等）可流通的
words.ex: The road was passable but not in good condition.
words.ex_cn: 这条路尚可通行，但状况不佳。
words.en: If something is passable, it is good enough to be accepted or allowed, but not of a very high standard.

words.ex: The argument was pointless.
words.ex_cn: 这个争论毫无意义。
words.en: If you describe something as pointless, you are emphasizing that it has no purpose or is not worth doing.

words.ex: The medicine is potent and works quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物非常有效，起效很快。
words.en: Something that is potent is very effective and powerful.

words.tr: adj. 可读性强的；易于识读的；
words.ex: The book has a readable style and simple words.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的写作风格易读，用词简单。
words.en: If you say that a book or article is readable, you mean that it is enjoyable and easy to read.

words.tr: adj. 公正的；正当的；正义的
words.ex: He is a righteous man who helps the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个帮助穷人的正直的人。
words.en: If you think that someone behaves or lives in a way that is morally good, you can say that they are righteous.

words.tr: adj. 强健的；强壮的；结实的；
words.ex: The dog is robust and runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很强健，每天跑步。
words.en: Strong and healthy; vigorous. (of an object) sturdy in construction.

words.ex: We need sustainable energy to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可持续的能源来保护环境。
words.en: If something is sustainable, it can be maintained or continued at a certain rate or level without causing damage or depletion of resources.

words.tr: adj. 可触摸的；实际的；有形的；确凿的；
words.ex: The statue is tangible and can be touched.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像可以触摸，是实实在在的。
words.en: Something that is tangible is clear enough or definite enough to be easily seen, felt, or noticed.

words.tr: adj. 暂定的；不确定的；试验性的；
words.ex: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
words.ex_cn: 我们制定了一个下周见面的暂定计划。
words.en: If you make a tentative suggestion or plan, you make it without being sure that it is right or acceptable.

words.tr: adj. 不可否认的；无可辩驳的
words.ex: The evidence is undeniable.
words.ex_cn: 证据是不可否认的。
words.en: If you say that something is undeniable, you mean that it is definitely true or that it definitely exists.

words.ex: This plan is workable and cheap.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是可行的，而且便宜。
words.en: If something is workable, it can be done, used, or put into operation successfully.

chapters.name: Level 9 副词 位置•场所

words.ex: He looked afar and saw a small boat.
words.ex_cn: 他远远地望见了一条小船。
words.en: At, to, or from a great distance.

words.tr:
adj. 疏远的；冷淡的
adv. 远离地
words.ex: He stayed aloof during the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上保持冷淡。
words.en: Someone who is aloof is not very friendly and does not like to spend time with other people.

words.tr:
adv. 迷路地；误入歧途地
adj. 迷路的；误入歧途的
words.ex: The little dog went astray in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那只小狗在公园里走丢了。
words.en: If you go astray, you lose your direction when you are trying to go somewhere.

words.ex: He likes coffee; conversely, she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡；相反，她更喜欢茶。
words.en: In a way that is the opposite or reverse of something else.

words.tr: adv. 直角地；径直地；公平地；直接了当
words.ex: He stood squarely in front of the door.
words.ex_cn: 他直角地站在门前面。
words.en: If something is squarely placed or aimed, it is placed or aimed directly at something.

chapters.name: Level 9 副词 时间•频率

words.tr: adv. 在任何时间；无论何时；
words.ex: You can call me anytime.
words.ex_cn: 你随时都可以给我打电话。
words.en: at any time; whenever

words.tr: adv. 无限期地；不确定地；
words.ex: The meeting was postponed indefinitely.
words.ex_cn: 会议被无限期推迟了。
words.en: If something will happen indefinitely, it will happen for an unlimited or unknown period of time.

chapters.name: Level 9 副词 程度

words.ex: The children danced gaily at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上欢快地跳舞。
words.en: In a cheerful and light-hearted manner.

words.ex: The car moved rapidly down the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车迅速地沿着道路行驶。
words.en: If something happens rapidly, it happens very quickly.

words.ex: He is principally responsible for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他主要负责这个项目。
words.en: Mainly; for the most part.

words.ex: He spoke respectfully to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他恭敬地对老师说话。
words.en: In a way that shows respect or deference.

words.tr: adv. 无论什么；任何(用于否定句中以加强语气)；
words.ex: You can eat whatever food whatsoever.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何食物。
words.en: used to emphasize a negative statement

chapters.name: Level 9 副词 其他

words.ex: He alternately sings and dances on stage.
words.ex_cn: 他在舞台上交替地唱歌和跳舞。
words.en: If something happens alternately, it happens first in one way, then in another way that is the opposite of the first, and then in the first way again, and so on.

words.ex: They paid five dollars apiece for the tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他们每人五美元买了票。
words.en: If something is given or sold apiece, each person is given or sold one, or each thing is sold for a particular amount.

words.ex: He studied hard, thereby passing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。
words.en: You use thereby to introduce an important result or consequence of the event or action you have just mentioned.

words.ex: The students were variously dressed for the party.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿着各种不同的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: In different ways or at different times.

words.ex: He found a way whereby he could save money.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种借以省钱的方法。
words.en: You use whereby to introduce a clause in which you mention the means by which something happens.

chapters.name: Level 9 代词

words.ex: Thou shalt not steal.
words.ex_cn: 你不应偷窃。
words.en: Used in old English or in religious contexts as the singular form of 'you'.

words.ex: He asked if I wanted coffee, and I said yes.
words.ex_cn: 他问我是否想要咖啡，我说是。
words.en: Used to give an affirmative response or to agree with a positive statement.

chapters.name: Level 9 感叹词

words.tr: int. （惊奇、高兴或有所发现时用）哈；（笑声）哈
words.ex: Ha! I found my keys!
words.ex_cn: 哈！我找到我的钥匙了！
words.en: Ha is used in writing to represent a noise that people make to show they are surprised, annoyed, or excited about something.
